entries.text: إن أهل الطاعة والإخلاص الذين يؤدون حق الله، يشربون يوم القيامة مِن كأس فيها خمر ممزوجة بأحسن أنواع الطيب، وهو ماء الكافور.
entries.originalHtml: إن أهل الطاعة والإخلاص الذين يؤدون حق الله، يشربون يوم القيامة مِن كأس فيها خمر ممزوجة بأحسن أنواع الطيب، وهو ماء الكافور.

entries.text: هذا الشراب الذي مزج من الكافور هو عين يشرب منها عباد الله، يتصرفون فيها، ويُجْرونها حيث شاؤوا إجراءً سهلا. هؤلاء كانوا في الدنيا يوفون بما أوجبوا على أنفسهم من طاعة الله، ويخافون عقاب الله في يوم القيامة الذي يكون ضرره خطيرًا، وشره فاشيًا منتشرًا على الناس، إلا مَن رحم الله، ويُطْعِمون الطعام مع حبهم له وحاجتهم إليه، فقيرًا عاجزًا عن الكسب لا يملك ما يكفيه ويسد حاجته، وطفلا مات أبوه وهو دون سن البلوغ ولا مال له، وأسيرًا أُسر في الحرب من المشركين وغيرهم، ويقولون في أنفسهم: إنما نحسن إليكم ابتغاء مرضاة الله، وطلب ثوابه، لا نبتغي عوضًا ولا نقصد حمدًا ولا ثناءً منكم. إنا نخاف من ربنا يومًا شديدًا تَعْبِس فيه الوجوه، وتتقطَّبُ الجباه مِن فظاعة أمره وشدة هوله.

entries.text: فوقاهم الله من شدائد ذلك اليوم، وأعطاهم حسنًا ونورًا في وجوههم، وبهجة وفرحًا في قلوبهم، وأثابهم بصبرهم في الدنيا على الطاعة جنة عظيمة يأكلون منها ما شاؤوا، ويَلْبَسون فيها الحرير الناعم، متكئين فيها على الأسرَّة المزينة بفاخر الثياب والستور، لا يرون فيها حر شمس ولا شدة برد، وقريبة منهم أشجار الجنة مظللة عليهم، وسُهِّل لهم أَخْذُ ثمارها تسهيلا.

entries.text: ويدور عليهم الخدم بأواني الطعام الفضيَّة، وأكواب الشراب من الزجاج، زجاج من فضة، قدَّرها السقاة على مقدار ما يشتهي الشاربون لا تزيد ولا تنقص، ويُسْقَى هؤلاء الأبرار في الجنة كأسًا مملوءة خمرًا مزجت بالزنجبيل، يشربون مِن عينٍ في الجنة تسمى سلسبيلا؛ لسلامة شرابها وسهولة مساغه وطيبه.
entries.originalHtml: ويدور عليهم الخدم بأواني الطعام الفضيَّة، وأكواب الشراب من الزجاج، زجاج من فضة، قدَّرها السقاة على مقدار ما يشتهي الشاربون لا تزيد ولا تنقص، ويُسْقَى هؤلاء الأبرار في الجنة كأسًا مملوءة خمرًا مزجت بالزنجبيل، يشربون مِن عينٍ في الجنة تسمى سلسبيلا؛ لسلامة شرابها وسهولة مساغه وطيبه.

entries.text: ويدور على هؤلاء الأبرار لخدمتهم غلمان دائمون على حالهم، إذا أبصرتهم ظننتهم -لحسنهم وصفاء ألوانهم وإشراق وجوههم- اللؤلؤ المفرَّق المضيء.
entries.originalHtml: ويدور على هؤلاء الأبرار لخدمتهم غلمان دائمون على حالهم، إذا أبصرتهم ظننتهم -لحسنهم وصفاء ألوانهم وإشراق وجوههم- اللؤلؤ المفرَّق المضيء.

entries.text: وإذا أبصرت أيَّ مكان في الجنة رأيت فيه نعيمًا لا يُدْركه الوصف، ومُلْكا عظيمًا واسعًا لا غاية له.
entries.originalHtml: وإذا أبصرت أيَّ مكان في الجنة رأيت فيه نعيمًا لا يُدْركه الوصف، ومُلْكا عظيمًا واسعًا لا غاية له.

entries.text: يعلوهم ويجمل أبدانهم ثياب بطائنها من الحرير الرقيق الأخضر، وظاهرها من الحرير الغليظ، ويُحَلَّون من الحليِّ بأساور من الفضة، وسقاهم ربهم فوق ذلك النعيم شرابًا لا رجس فيه ولا دنس.

entries.text: ويقال لهم: إن هذا أُعِدَّ لكم مقابل أعمالكم الصالحة، وكان عملكم في الدنيا عند الله مرضيًا مقبولا.

entries.text: فاصبر لحكم ربك القدري واقبله، ولحكمه الديني فامض عليه، ولا تطع من المشركين من كان منغمسًا في الشهوات أو مبالغًا في الكفر والضلال، وداوم على ذكر اسم ربك ودعائه في أول النهار وآخره.

entries.text: إن هذه السورة عظة للعالمين، فمن أراد الخير لنفسه في الدنيا والآخرة اتخذ بالإيمان والتقوى طريقًا يوصله إلى مغفرة الله ورضوانه. وما تريدون أمرًا من الأمور إلا بتقدير الله ومشيئته. إن الله كان عليمًا بأحوال خلقه، حكيمًا في تدبيره وصنعه. يُدْخل مَن يشاء مِن عباده في رحمته ورضوانه، وهم المؤمنون، وأعدَّ للظالمين المتجاوزين حدود الله عذابًا موجعًا.

entries.text: أقسم الله تعالى بالرياح حين تهب متتابعة يقفو بعضها بعضًا، وبالرياح الشديدة الهبوب المهلكة، وبالملائكة الموكلين بالسحب يسوقونها حيث شاء الله، وبالملائكة التي تنزل من عند الله بما يفرق بين الحق والباطل والحلال والحرام، وبالملائكة التي تتلقى الوحي من عند الله وتنزل به على أنبيائه; إعذارًا من الله إلى خلقه وإنذارًا منه إليهم ; لئلا يكون لهم حجة. إن الذي توعدون به مِن أمر يوم القيامة وما فيه من حساب وجزاء لنازلٌ بكم لا محالة.

entries.text: فإذا النجوم طُمست وذهب ضياؤها، وإذا السماء تصدَّعت، وإذا الجبال تطايرت وتناثرت وصارت هباء تَذْروه الرياح، وإذا الرسل عُيِّن لهم وقت وأجل للفصل بينهم وبين الأمم، يقال: لأيِّ يوم عظيم أخِّرت الرسل؟ أخِّرت ليوم القضاء والفصل بين الخلائق. وما أعلمك -أيها الإنسان- أيُّ شيء هو يوم الفصل وشدته وهوله؟ هلاك عظيم في ذلك اليوم للمكذبين بهذا اليوم الموعود.

entries.text: يقال للكافرين يوم القيامة: سيروا إلى عذاب جهنم الذي كنتم به تكذبون في الدنيا، سيروا، فاستظلوا بدخان جهنم الذي يتفرع منه ثلاث قطع، لا يُظِل ذلك الظل من حر ذلك اليوم، ولا يدفع من حر اللهب شيئًا. إن جهنم تقذف من النار بشرر عظيم، كل شرارة منه كالبناء المشيد في العِظم والارتفاع. كأن شرر جهنم المتطاير منها إبل سود يميل لونها إلى الصُّفْرة.

entries.text: إن الذين خافوا ربهم في الدنيا، واتقوا عذابه بامتثال أوامره واجتناب نواهيه، هم يوم القيامة في ظلال الأشجار الوارفة وعيون الماء الجارية، وفواكه كثيرة مما تشتهيه أنفسهم يتنعمون. يقال لهم: كلوا أكلا لذيذًا، واشربوا شربًا هنيئًا؛ بسبب ما قدمتم في الدنيا من صالح الأعمال. إنا بمثل ذلك الجزاء العظيم نجزي أهل الإحسان في أعمالهم وطاعتهم لنا. هلاك وعذاب شديد يوم القيامة للمكذبين بيوم الجزاء والحساب وما فيه من النعيم والعذاب.

entries.text: إنهم كانوا لا يخافون يوم الحساب فلم يعملوا له، وكذَّبوا بما جاءتهم به الرسل تكذيبا، وكلَّ شيء علمناه وكتبناه في اللوح المحفوظ، فذوقوا -أيها الكافرون- جزاء أعمالكم، فلن نزيدكم إلا عذابًا فوق عذابكم.

entries.text: إن للذين يخافون ربهم ويعملون صالحًا، فوزًا بدخولهم الجنة. إن لهم بساتين عظيمة وأعنابًا، ولهم زوجات حديثات السن، نواهد مستويات في سن واحدة، ولهم كأس مملوءة خمرًا. لا يسمعون في هذه الجنة باطلا من القول، ولا يكذب بعضهم بعضًا.

entries.text: لهم كل ذلك جزاء ومنَّة من الله وعطاءً كثيرًا كافيًا لهم، ربِّ السموات والأرض وما بينهما، رحمنِ الدنيا والآخرة، لا يملكون أن يسألوه إلا فيما أذن لهم فيه، يوم يقوم جبريل عليه السلام والملائكة مصطفِّين، لا يشفعون إلا لمن أذن له الرحمن في الشفاعة، وقال حقًا وسدادًا. ذلك اليوم الحق الذي لا ريب في وقوعه، فمن شاء النجاة مِن أهواله فليتخذ إلى ربه مرجعًا بالعمل الصالح.

entries.text: أقسم الله تعالى بالملائكة التي تنزع أرواح الكفار نزعا شديدا، والملائكة التي تقبض أرواح المؤمنين بنشاط ورفق، والملائكة التي تَسْبَح في نزولها من السماء وصعودها إليها، فالملائكة التي تسبق وتسارع إلى تنفيذ أمر الله، فالملائكة المنفذات أمر ربها فيما أوكل إليها تدبيره من شؤون الكون -ولا يجوز للمخلوق أن يقسم بغير خالقه، فإن فعل فقد أشرك- لتُبعثَنَّ الخلائق وتُحَاسَب، يوم تضطرب الأرض بالنفخة الأولى نفخة الإماتة، تتبعها نفخة أخرى للإحياء.

entries.text: فأرى موسى فرعونَ العلامة العظمى: العصا واليد، فكذب فرعون نبيَّ الله موسى عليه السلام، وعصى ربه عزَّ وجلَّ، ثم ولَّى معرضًا عن الإيمان مجتهدًا في معارضة موسى.

entries.text: فجمع أهل مملكته وناداهم، فقال: أنا ربكم الذي لا ربَّ فوقه، فانتقم الله منه بالعذاب في الدنيا والآخرة، وجعله عبرة ونكالا لأمثاله من المتمردين. إن في فرعون وما نزل به من العذاب لموعظةً لمن يتعظ وينزجر.

entries.text: أبَعْثُكم -أيها الناس- بعد الموت أشد في تقديركم أم خلق السماء؟ رفعها فوقكم كالبناء، وأعلى سقفها في الهواء لا تفاوت فيها ولا فطور، وأظلم ليلها بغروب شمسها، وأبرز نهارها بشروقها. والأرض بعد خلق السماء بسطها، وأودع فيها منافعها، وفجَّر فيها عيون الماء، وأنبت فيها ما يُرعى من النباتات، وأثبت فيها الجبال أوتادًا لها. خلق سبحانه كل هذه النعم منفعة لكم ولأنعامكم. إن إعادة خلقكم يوم القيامة أهون على الله من خلق هذه الأشياء، وكله على الله هين يسير.

entries.text: وأمَّا من كان حريصا على لقائك، وهو يخشى الله من التقصير في الاسترشاد، فأنت عنه تتشاغل. ليس الأمر كما فعلت -أيها الرسول-، إن هذه السورة موعظة لك ولكل من شاء الاتعاظ. فمن شاء ذكر الله وَأْتَمَّ بوحيه. هذا الوحي، وهو القرآن في صحف معظمة، موقرة، عالية القدر مطهرة من الدنس والزيادة والنقص، بأيدي ملائكة كتبة، سفراء بين الله وخلقه، كرام الخلق، أخلاقهم وأفعالهم بارة طاهرة.

entries.text: لُعِنَ الإنسان الكافر وعُذِّب، ما أشدَّ كفره بربه!! ألم ير مِن أيِّ شيء خلقه الله أول مرة؟ خلقه الله من ماء قليل -وهو المَنِيُّ- فقدَّره أطوارا، ثم بين له طريق الخير والشر، ثم أماته فجعل له مكانًا يُقبر فيه، ثم إذا شاء سبحانه أحياه، وبعثه بعد موته للحساب والجزاء. ليس الأمر كما يقول الكافر ويفعل، فلم يُؤَدِّ ما أمره الله به من الإيمان والعمل بطاعته.

entries.text: فليتدبر الإنسان: كيف خلق الله طعامه الذي هو قوام حياته؟ بأنَّا صببنا الماء على الأرض صَبًّا، ثم شققناها بما أخرجنا منها من نبات شتى، فأنبتنا فيها حبًا، وعنبًا وعلفًا للدواب، وزيتونًا ونخلا وحدائق عظيمة الأشجار، وثمارًا وكلأ تَنْعَمون بها أنتم وأنعامكم.

entries.text: إذا الشمس لُفَّت وذهب ضَوْءُها، وإذا النجوم تناثرت، فذهب نورها، وإذا الجبال سيِّرت عن وجه الأرض فصارت هباءً منبثًا، وإذا النوق الحوامل تُركت وأهملت، وإذا الحيوانات الوحشية جُمعت واختلطت؛ ليقتصَّ الله من بعضها لبعض، وإذا البحار أوقدت، فصارت على عِظَمها نارًا تتوقد، وإذا النفوس قُرنت بأمثالها ونظائرها، وإذا الطفلة المدفونة حية سُئلت يوم القيامة سؤالَ تطييب لها وتبكيت لوائدها: بأيِّ ذنب كان دفنها؟ وإذا صحف الأعمال عُرضت، وإذا السماء قُلعت وأزيلت من مكانها، وإذا النار أوقدت فأضرِمت، وإذا الجنة دار النعيم قُرِّبت من أهلها المتقين، إذا وقع ذلك، تيقنتْ ووجدتْ كلُّ نفس ما قدَّمت من خير أو شر.

entries.text: أقسم الله تعالى بالنجوم المختفية أنوارها نهارًا، الجارية والمستترة في أبراجها، والليل إذا أقبل بظلامه، والصبح إذا ظهر ضياؤه، إن القرآن لَتبليغ رسول كريم -هو جبريل عليه السلام-، ذِي قوة في تنفيذ ما يؤمر به، صاحبِ مكانة رفيعة عند الله، تطيعه الملائكة، مؤتمن على الوحي الذي ينزل به.

entries.text: وما محمد الذي تعرفونه بمجنون، ولقد رأى محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم جبريل الذي يأتيه بالرسالة على صورته الحقيقية التي خلقه الله عليها في الأفق العظيم من ناحية المشرق بـ «مكة» ، وهي الرؤية الأولى الواقعة بـ «غار حراء» . وما محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم ببخيل في تبليغ الوحي. وما هذا القرآن بقول شيطان رجيم، مطرود من رحمة الله، ولكنه كلام الله ووحيه.

entries.text: عذابٌ شديد للذين يبخسون المكيال والميزان، الذين إذا اشتروا من الناس مكيلا أو موزونًا يوفون لأنفسهم، وإذا باعوا الناس مكيلا أو موزونًا يُنْقصون في المكيال والميزان، فكيف بحال من يسرقهما ويختلسهما، ويبخس الناس أشياءهم؟ إنه أولى بالوعيد من مطففي المكيال والميزان. ألا يعتقد أولئك المطففون أن الله تعالى باعثهم ومحاسبهم على أعمالهم؟

entries.text: عذاب شديد يومئذ للمكذبين، الذين يكذبون بوقوع يوم الجزاء، وما يكذِّب به إلا كل ظالم كثير الإثم، إذا تتلى عليه آيات القرآن قال: هذه أباطيل الأولين. ليس الأمر كما زعموا، بل هو كلام الله ووحيه إلى نبيه، وإنما حجب قلوبهم عن التصديق به ما غشاها من كثرة ما يرتكبون من الذنوب. ليس الأمر كما زعم الكفار، بل إنهم يوم القيامة عن رؤية ربهم -جل وعلا- لمحجوبون. وفي هذه الآية دلالة على رؤية المؤمنين ربَّهم في الجنة. ثم إنهم لداخلو النار يقاسون حرها، ثم يقال لهم: هذا الجزاء الذي كنتم به تكذبون.

entries.text: إن الذين أجرموا كانوا في الدنيا يستهزئون بالمؤمنين، وإذا مروا بهم يتغامزون سخرية بهم، وإذا رجع الذين أجرموا إلى أهلهم وذويهم تفكهوا معهم بالسخرية من المؤمنين. وإذا رأى هؤلاء الكفار أصحاب محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وقد اتبعوا الهدى قالوا: إن هؤلاء لتائهون في اتباعهم محمدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم، وما بُعث هؤلاء المجرمون رقباء على أصحاب محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم.

entries.text: إذا السماء تصدَّعت، وتفطَّرت بالغمام يوم القيامة، وأطاعت أمر ربها فيما أمرها به من الانشقاق، وحُقَّ لها أن تنقاد لأمره. وإذا الأرض بُسطت وَوُسِّعت، ودكت جبالها في ذلك اليوم، وقذفت ما في بطنها من الأموات، وتخلَّتْ عنهم، وانقادت لربها فيما أمرها به، وحُقَّ لها أن تنقاد لأمره.

entries.text: يا أيها الإنسان إنك ساعٍ إلى الله، وعامل أعمالا من خير أو شر، ثم تلاقي الله يوم القيامة، فيجازيك بعملك بفضله أو عدله. أن لن يرجع.

entries.text: فأما من أعطي صحيفة أعماله بيمينه، وهو مؤمن بربه، فسوف يحاسب حسابًا سهلا ويرجع إلى أهله في الجنة مسرورًا.
entries.originalHtml: فأما من أعطي صحيفة أعماله بيمينه، وهو مؤمن بربه، فسوف يحاسب حسابًا سهلا ويرجع إلى أهله في الجنة مسرورًا.

entries.text: وأمَّا مَن أُعطي صحيفة أعماله من وراء ظهره، وهو الكافر بالله، فسوف يدعو بالهلاك والثبور، ويدخل النار مقاسيًا حرها. إنه كان في أهله في الدنيا مسرورًا مغرورًا، لا يفكر في العواقب، إنه ظنَّ أن لن يرجع إلى خالقه حيا للحساب. بلى سيعيده الله كما بدأه ويجازيه على أعماله، إن ربه كان به بصيرًا عليمًا بحاله من يوم خلقه إلى أن بعثه.

entries.text: أقسم الله تعالى باحمرار الأفق عند الغروب، وبالليل وما جمع من الدواب والحشرات والهوام وغير ذلك، وبالقمر إذا تكامل نوره، لتركبُنَّ -أيها الناس- أطوارا متعددة وأحوالا متباينة: من النطفة إلى العلقة إلى المضغة إلى نفخ الروح إلى الموت إلى البعث والنشور. ولا يجوز للمخلوق أن يقسم بغير الله، ولو فعل ذلك لأشرك.

entries.text: فأيُّ شيء يمنعهم من الإيمان بالله واليوم الآخر بعد ما وُضِّحت لهم الآيات؟ وما لهم إذا قرئ عليهم القرآن لا يسجدون لله، ولا يسلِّمُون بما جاء فيه؟ إنما سجية الذين كفروا التكذيب ومخالفة الحق. والله أعلم بما يكتمون في صدورهم من العناد مع علمهم بأن ما جاء به القرآن حق، فبشرهم -أيها الرسول- بأن الله -عز وجل- قد أعدَّ لهم عذابًا موجعًا.

entries.text: أقسم الله تعالى بالسماء ذات المنازل التي تمر بها الشمس والقمر، وبيوم القيامة الذي وعد الله الخلق أن يجمعهم فيه، وشاهد يشهد، ومشهود يشهد عليه. ويقسم الله -سبحانه- بما يشاء من مخلوقاته، أما المخلوق فلا يجوز له أن يقسم بغير الله، فإن القسم بغير الله شرك - لُعن الذين شَقُّوا في الأرض شقًا عظيمًا؛ لتعذيب المؤمنين، وأوقدوا النار الشديدة ذات الوَقود، إذ هم قعود على الأخدود ملازمون له، وهم على ما يفعلون بالمؤمنين من تنكيل وتعذيب حضورٌ. وما أخذوهم بمثل هذا العقاب الشديد إلا أن كانوا مؤمنين بالله العزيز الذي لا يغالَب، الحميد في أقواله وأفعاله وأوصافه، الذي له ملك السماوات والأرض، وهو -سبحانه- على كل شيء شهيد، لا يخفى عليه شيء.

entries.text: إن انتقام ربك من أعدائه وعذابه لهم لَعظيم شديد، إنه هو يُبدئ الخلق ثم يعيده، وهو الغفور لمن تاب، كثير المودة والمحبة لأوليائه، صاحب العرشِ المجيدُ الذي بلغ المنتهى في الفضل والكرم، فَعَّال لما يريد، لا يمتنع عليه شيء يريده.

entries.text: هل بلغك -أيها الرسول- خبر الجموع الكافرة المكذبة لأنبيائها، فرعون وثمود، وما حلَّ بهم من العذاب والنكال، لم يعتبر القوم بذلك، بل الذين كفروا في تكذيب متواصل كدأب مَن قبلهم، والله قد أحاط بهم علما وقدرة، لا يخفى عليه منهم ومن أعمالهم شيء. وليس القرآن كما زعم المكذبون المشركون بأنه شعر وسحر، فكذَّبوا به، بل هو قرآن عظيم كريم، في لوح محفوظ، لا يناله تبديل ولا تحريف.

entries.text: فلينظر الإنسان المنكر للبعث مِمَّ خُلِقَ؟ ليعلم أن إعادة خلق الإنسان ليست أصعب من خلقه أوّلا خلق من منيٍّ منصبٍّ بسرعة في الرحم، يخرج من بين صلب الرجل وصدر المرأة. إن الذي خلق الإنسان من هذا الماء لَقادر على رجعه إلى الحياة بعد الموت.

entries.text: والسماء ذات المطر المتكرر، والأرض ذات التشقق بما يتخللها من نبات، إن القرآن لقول فصل بَيْنَ الحق والباطل، وما هو بالهزل. ولا يجوز للمخلوق أن يقسم بغير الله، وإلا فقد أشرك.

entries.text: إن المكذبين للرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم، وللقرآن، يكيدون ويدبرون؛ ليدفعوا بكيدهم الحق ويؤيدوا الباطل، وأكيد كيدًا لإظهار الحق، ولو كره الكافرون، فلا تستعجل لهم -أيها الرسول- بطلب إنزال العقاب بهم، بل أمهلهم وأنظرهم قليلا ولا تستعجل لهم، وسترى ما يحلُّ بهم من العذاب والنكال والعقوبة والهلاك.

entries.text: وجوه المؤمنين يوم القيامة ذات نعمة؛ لسعيها في الدنيا بالطاعات راضية في الآخرة، في جنة رفيعة المكان والمكانة، لا تسمع فيها كلمة لغو واحدة، فيها عين تتدفق مياهها، فيها سرر عالية، وأكواب معدة للشاربين، ووسائد مصفوفة، الواحدة جنب الأخرى، وبُسُط كثيرة مفروشة.

entries.text: هؤلاء الذين استبدُّوا، وظلموا في بلاد الله، فأكثروا فيها بظلمهم الفساد، فصب عليهم ربُّك عذابا شديدا. إنَّ ربك -أيها الرسول- لبالمرصاد لمن يعصيه، يمهله قليلا ثم يأخذه أخْذَ عزيز مقتدر.

entries.text: فأما الإنسان إذا ما اختبره ربه بالنعمة، وبسط له رزقه، وجعله في أطيب عيش، فيظن أن ذلك لكرامته عند ربه، فيقول: ربي أكرمن.

entries.text: وأما إذا ما اختبره، فضيَّق عليه رزقه، فيظن أن ذلك لهوانه على الله، فيقول: ربي أهانن.

entries.text: كذَّبت ثمود نبيها ببلوغها الغاية في العصيان، إذ نهض أكثر القبيلة شقاوة لعقر الناقة، فقال لهم رسول الله صالح عليه السلام: احذروا أن تمسوا الناقة بسوء؛ فإنها آية أرسلها الله إليكم، تدل على صدق نبيكم، واحذروا أن تعتدوا على سقيها، فإن لها شِرْب يوم ولكم شِرْب يوم معلوم. فشق عليهم ذلك، فكذبوه فيما توعَّدهم به فنحروها، فأطبق عليهم ربهم العقوبة بجرمهم، فجعلها عليهم على السواء فلم يُفْلِت منهم أحد. ولا يخاف -جلت قدرته- تبعة ما أنزله بهم من شديد العقاب.

entries.text: أقسم الله بوقت الضحى، والمراد به النهار كله، وبالليل إذا سكن بالخلق واشتد ظلامه. ويقسم الله بما يشاء من مخلوقاته، أما المخلوق فلا يجوز له أن يقسم بغير خالقه، فإن القسم بغير الله شرك. ما تركك -أيها النبي- ربك، وما أبغضك بإبطاء الوحي عنك.

entries.text: اقرأ -أيها النبي- ما أُنزل إليك من القرآن مُفْتَتِحًا باسم ربك المتفرد بالخلق، الذي خلق كل إنسان من قطعة دم غليظ أحمر. اقرأ -أيها النبي- ما أُنزل إليك، وإن ربك لكثير الإحسان واسع الجود، الذي علَّم خلقه الكتابة بالقلم، علَّم الإنسان ما لم يكن يعلم، ونقله من ظلمة الجهل إلى نور العلم.

entries.text: أرأيت أعجب مِن طغيان هذا الرجل (وهو أبو جهل) الذي ينهى عبدًا لنا إذا صلَّى لربه (وهو محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم)؟ أرأيت إن كان المنهي عن الصلاة على الهدى فكيف ينهاه؟ أو إن كان آمرًا غيره بالتقوى أينهاه عن ذلك؟ أرأيت إن كذَّب هذا الناهي بما يُدعى إليه، وأعرض عنه، ألم يعلم بأن الله يرى كل ما يفعل؟ ليس الأمر كما يزعم أبو جهل، لئن لم يرجع هذا عن شقاقه وأذاه لنأخذنَّ بمقدَّم رأسه أخذًا عنيفًا، ويُطرح في النار، ناصيته ناصية كاذبة في مقالها، خاطئة في أفعالها. فليُحْضِر هذا الطاغية أهل ناديه الذين يستنصر بهم، سندعو ملائكة العذاب. ليس الأمر على ما يظن أبو جهل، إنه لن ينالك -أيها الرسول- بسوء، فلا تطعه فيما دعاك إليه مِن تَرْك الصلاة، واسجد لربك واقترب منه بالتحبب إليه بطاعته.

entries.text: خسرت يدا أبي لهب وشقي بإيذائه رسول الله محمدا صلى الله عليه وسلم، وقد تحقق خسران أبي لهب.
entries.originalHtml: خسرت يدا أبي لهب وشقي بإيذائه رسول الله محمدا صلى الله عليه وسلم، وقد تحقق خسران أبي لهب.

entries.text: ما أغنى عنه ماله وولده، فلن يَرُدَّا عنه شيئًا من عذاب الله إذا نزل به.
entries.originalHtml: ما أغنى عنه ماله وولده، فلن يَرُدَّا عنه شيئًا من عذاب الله إذا نزل به.

entries.text: سيدخل نارًا جهنم ذات اللَّهب المشتعل، هو وامرأته التي كانت تحمل الشوك، فتطرحه في طريق النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ لأذيَّته.

entries.text: سيدخل نارًا متأججة، هو وامرأته التي كانت تحمل الشوك، فتطرحه في طريق النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ لأذيَّته.
entries.originalHtml: سيدخل نارًا متأججة، هو وامرأته التي كانت تحمل الشوك، فتطرحه في طريق النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم؛ لأذيَّته.

entries.text: في عنقها حبل محكم الفَتْلِ مِن ليف شديد خشن، تُرْفَع به في نار جهنم، ثم تُرْمى إلى أسفلها.
entries.originalHtml: في عنقها حبل محكم الفَتْلِ مِن ليف شديد خشن، تُرْفَع به في نار جهنم، ثم تُرْمى إلى أسفلها.

entries.text: قل -أيها الرسول-: هو الله المتفرد بالألوهية والربوبية والأسماء والصفات، لا يشاركه أحد فيها.
entries.originalHtml: قل -أيها الرسول-: هو الله المتفرد بالألوهية والربوبية والأسماء والصفات، لا يشاركه أحد فيها.

entries.text: الله الذي كَمُل في صفات الشَّرَف والمجد والعظمة، الذي يقصده الخلائق في قضاء الحوائج والرغائب.
entries.originalHtml: الله الذي كَمُل في صفات الشَّرَف والمجد والعظمة، الذي يقصده الخلائق في قضاء الحوائج والرغائب.

entries.text: ليس له ولد ولا والد ولا صاحبة.
entries.originalHtml: ليس له ولد ولا والد ولا صاحبة.

entries.text: ولم يكن له مماثلا ولا مشابهًا أحد من خلقه، لا في أسمائه ولا في صفاته، ولا في أفعاله، تبارك وتعالى وتقدَّس.
entries.originalHtml: ولم يكن له مماثلا ولا مشابهًا أحد من خلقه، لا في أسمائه ولا في صفاته، ولا في أفعاله، تبارك وتعالى وتقدَّس.

entries.text: قل -أيها الرسول-: أعوذ وأعتصم برب الفلق، وهو الصبح.
entries.originalHtml: قل -أيها الرسول-: أعوذ وأعتصم برب الفلق، وهو الصبح.

entries.text: من شر جميع المخلوقات وأذاها.
entries.originalHtml: من شر جميع المخلوقات وأذاها.

entries.text: ومن شر ليل شديد الظلمة إذا دخل وتغلغل، وما فيه من الشرور والمؤذيات.
entries.originalHtml: ومن شر ليل شديد الظلمة إذا دخل وتغلغل، وما فيه من الشرور والمؤذيات.

entries.text: ومن شر الساحرات اللاتي ينفخن فيما يعقدن من عُقَد بقصد السحر.
entries.originalHtml: ومن شر الساحرات اللاتي ينفخن فيما يعقدن من عُقَد بقصد السحر.

entries.text: ومن شر حاسد مبغض للناس إذا حسدهم على ما وهبهم الله من نعم، وأراد زوالها عنهم، وإيقاع الأذى بهم.
entries.originalHtml: ومن شر حاسد مبغض للناس إذا حسدهم على ما وهبهم الله من نعم، وأراد زوالها عنهم، وإيقاع الأذى بهم.

entries.text: قل -أيها الرسول-: أعوذ وأعتصم برب الناس، القادر وحده على ردِّ شر الوسواس.
entries.originalHtml: قل -أيها الرسول-: أعوذ وأعتصم برب الناس، القادر وحده على ردِّ شر الوسواس.

entries.text: ملك الناس المتصرف في كل شؤونهم، الغنيِّ عنهم.
entries.originalHtml: ملك الناس المتصرف في كل شؤونهم، الغنيِّ عنهم.

entries.text: إله الناس الذي لا معبود بحق سواه.
entries.originalHtml: إله الناس الذي لا معبود بحق سواه.

entries.text: من أذى الشيطان الذي يوسوس عند الغفلة، ويختفي عند ذكر الله.
entries.originalHtml: من أذى الشيطان الذي يوسوس عند الغفلة، ويختفي عند ذكر الله.

entries.text: الذي يبثُّ الشر والشكوك في صدور الناس.
entries.originalHtml: الذي يبثُّ الشر والشكوك في صدور الناس.

entries.text: من شياطين الجن والإنس.
entries.originalHtml: من شياطين الجن والإنس.

entries.text: In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: In the name of Allāh,<sup foot_note=195932>1</sup> the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.<sup foot_note=195931>2</sup>

entries.text: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds -
entries.originalHtml: [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord<sup foot_note=195933>1</sup> of the worlds -

entries.text: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
entries.originalHtml: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

entries.text: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
entries.originalHtml: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.<sup foot_note=195934>1</sup>

entries.text: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
entries.originalHtml: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.

entries.text: Guide us to the straight path -
entries.originalHtml: Guide us to the straight path -

entries.text: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
entries.originalHtml: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have earned [Your] anger or of those who are astray.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Meem.<sup foot_note=195935>1</sup>

entries.text: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh -
entries.originalHtml: This is the Book about which there is no doubt, a guidance for those conscious of Allāh<sup foot_note=195936>1</sup> -

entries.text: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer, and spend out of what We have provided for them,
entries.originalHtml: Who believe in the unseen, establish prayer,<sup foot_note=195938>1</sup> and spend out of what We<sup foot_note=195937>2</sup> have provided for them,

entries.text: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: And who believe in what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what was revealed before you, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

entries.text: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
entries.originalHtml: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

entries.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who disbelieve<sup foot_note=195939>1</sup> - it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

entries.text: Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil. And for them is a great punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has set a seal upon their hearts and upon their hearing, and over their vision is a veil.<sup foot_note=195940>1</sup> And for them is a great punishment.

entries.text: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.
entries.originalHtml: And of the people are some who say, "We believe in Allāh and the Last Day," but they are not believers.

entries.text: They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.
entries.originalHtml: They [think to] deceive Allāh and those who believe, but they deceive not except themselves and perceive [it] not.

entries.text: In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease; and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
entries.originalHtml: In their hearts is disease, so Allāh has increased their disease;<sup foot_note=195941>1</sup> and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Do not cause corruption on the earth," they say, "We are but reformers."

entries.text: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.
entries.originalHtml: Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters, but they perceive [it] not.

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Believe as the people have believed," they say, "Should we believe as the foolish have believed?" Unquestionably, it is they who are the foolish, but they know [it] not.

entries.text: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."
entries.originalHtml: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We believe"; but when they are alone with their evil ones, they say, "Indeed, we are with you; we were only mockers."

entries.text: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.
entries.originalHtml: [But] Allāh mocks them and prolongs them in their transgression [while] they wander blindly.

entries.text: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.

entries.text: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allāh took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.
entries.originalHtml: Their example is that of one who kindled a fire, but when it illuminated what was around him, Allāh took away their light and left them in darkness [so] they could not see.

entries.text: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].
entries.originalHtml: Deaf, dumb and blind - so they will not return [to the right path].

entries.text: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allāh is encompassing of the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allāh is encompassing<sup foot_note=195942>1</sup> of the disbelievers.

entries.text: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: The lightning almost snatches away their sight. Every time it lights [the way] for them, they walk therein; but when darkness comes over them, they stand [still]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken away their hearing and their sight. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

entries.text: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -
entries.originalHtml: O mankind, worship your Lord, who created you and those before you, that you may become righteous -

entries.text: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].
entries.originalHtml: [He] who made for you the earth a bed [spread out] and the sky a ceiling and sent down from the sky, rain and brought forth thereby fruits as provision for you. So do not attribute to Allāh equals while you know [that there is nothing similar to Him].

entries.text: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down [i.e., the Qur’ān] upon Our Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], then produce a sūrah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses [i.e., supporters] other than Allāh, if you should be truthful.
entries.originalHtml: And if you are in doubt about what We have sent down [i.e., the Qur’ān] upon Our Servant [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)], then produce a sūrah the like thereof and call upon your witnesses [i.e., supporters] other than Allāh, if you should be truthful.

entries.text: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: But if you do not - and you will never be able to - then fear the Fire, whose fuel is people and stones, prepared for the disbelievers.

entries.text: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: And give good tidings to those who believe and do righteous deeds that they will have gardens [in Paradise] beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are provided with a provision of fruit therefrom, they will say, "This is what we were provided with before." And it is given to them in likeness. And they will have therein purified spouses, and they will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh is not timid to present an example - that of a mosquito or what is smaller<sup foot_note=195943>1</sup> than it. And those who have believed know that it is the truth from their Lord. But as for those who disbelieve, they say, "What did Allāh intend by this as an example?" He misleads many thereby and guides many thereby. And He misleads not except the defiantly disobedient,

entries.text: Who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.
entries.originalHtml: Who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and cause corruption on earth. It is those who are the losers.

entries.text: How can you disbelieve in Allāh when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.
entries.originalHtml: How can you disbelieve in Allāh when you were lifeless and He brought you to life; then He will cause you to die, then He will bring you [back] to life, and then to Him you will be returned.

entries.text: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who created for you all of that which is on the earth. Then He directed Himself<sup foot_note=195944>1</sup> to the heaven, [His being above all creation], and made them seven heavens, and He is Knowing of all things.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority." They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?" He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I will make upon the earth a successive authority."<sup foot_note=195946>1</sup> They said, "Will You place upon it one who causes corruption therein and sheds blood, while we exalt You with praise and declare Your perfection?"<sup foot_note=195945>2</sup> He [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I know that which you do not know."

entries.text: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."
entries.originalHtml: And He taught Adam the names - all of them. Then He showed them to the angels and said, "Inform Me of the names of these, if you are truthful."

entries.text: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing, the Wise."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing,<sup foot_note=195948>1</sup> the Wise."<sup foot_note=195947>2</sup>

entries.text: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "O Adam, inform them of their names." And when he had informed them of their names, He said, "Did I not tell you that I know the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth? And I know what you reveal and what you have concealed."

entries.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate before Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees.<sup foot_note=195949>1</sup> He refused and was arrogant and became of the disbelievers.

entries.text: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
entries.originalHtml: And We said, "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat therefrom in [ease and] abundance from wherever you will. But do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

entries.text: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
entries.originalHtml: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

entries.text: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words,<sup foot_note=195951>1</sup> and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance,<sup foot_note=195950>2</sup> the Merciful.

entries.text: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
entries.originalHtml: We said, "Go down from it, all of you. And when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

entries.text: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieve and deny Our signs - those will be companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally."

entries.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.
entries.originalHtml: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and fulfill My covenant [upon you] that I will fulfill your covenant [from Me], and be afraid of [only] Me.

entries.text: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.
entries.originalHtml: And believe in what I have sent down confirming that which is [already] with you, and be not the first to disbelieve in it. And do not exchange My signs for a small price, and fear [only] Me.

entries.text: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].
entries.originalHtml: And do not mix the truth with falsehood or conceal the truth while you know [it].

entries.text: And establish prayer and give zakāh and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].
entries.originalHtml: And establish prayer and give zakāh<sup foot_note=195952>1</sup> and bow with those who bow [in worship and obedience].

entries.text: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?
entries.originalHtml: Do you order righteousness of the people and forget<sup foot_note=195953>1</sup> yourselves while you recite the Scripture? Then will you not reason?

entries.text: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]
entries.originalHtml: And seek help through patience and prayer; and indeed, it is difficult except for the humbly submissive [to Allāh]

entries.text: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.
entries.originalHtml: Who are certain that they will meet their Lord and that they will return to Him.

entries.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].
entries.originalHtml: O Children of Israel, remember My favor that I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds [i.e., peoples].

entries.text: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.
entries.originalHtml: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul<sup foot_note=195954>1</sup> at all, nor will intercession be accepted from it, nor will compensation be taken from it, nor will they be aided.

entries.text: And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We saved you [i.e., your forefathers] from the people of Pharaoh, who afflicted you with the worst torment, slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

entries.text: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We parted the sea for you and saved you and drowned the people of Pharaoh while you were looking on.

entries.text: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We made an appointment with Moses for forty nights. Then you took [for worship] the calf after him [i.e., his departure], while you were wrongdoers.

entries.text: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.
entries.originalHtml: Then We forgave you after that so perhaps you would be grateful.

entries.text: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion that perhaps you would be guided.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We gave Moses the Scripture and criterion<sup foot_note=195955>1</sup> that perhaps you would be guided.

entries.text: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "O my people, indeed you have wronged yourselves by your taking of the calf [for worship]. So repent to your Creator and kill yourselves [i.e., the guilty among you]. That is best for [all of] you in the sight of your Creator." Then He accepted your repentance; indeed, He is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

entries.text: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allāh outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we will never believe you until we see Allāh outright"; so the thunderbolt took you while you were looking on.

entries.text: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.
entries.originalHtml: Then We revived you after your death that perhaps you would be grateful.

entries.text: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.
entries.originalHtml: And We shaded you with clouds and sent down to you manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not - but they were [only] wronging themselves.

entries.text: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We said, "Enter this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will in [ease and] abundance, and enter the gate bowing humbly<sup foot_note=195956>1</sup> and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins].' We will [then] forgive your sins for you, and We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."

entries.text: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment [i.e., plague] from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.
entries.originalHtml: But those who wronged changed [those words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them, so We sent down upon those who wronged a punishment [i.e., plague] from the sky because they were defiantly disobeying.

entries.text: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allāh, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when Moses prayed for water for his people, so We said, "Strike with your staff the stone." And there gushed forth from it twelve springs, and every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. "Eat and drink from the provision of Allāh, and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

entries.text: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allāh [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when you said, "O Moses, we can never endure one [kind of] food. So call upon your Lord to bring forth for us from the earth its green herbs and its cucumbers and its garlic and its lentils and its onions." [Moses] said, "Would you exchange what is better for what is less? Go into [any] settlement and indeed, you will have what you have asked." And they were covered with humiliation and poverty and returned with anger from Allāh [upon them]. That was because they [repeatedly] disbelieved in the signs of Allāh and killed the prophets without right. That was because they disobeyed and were [habitually] transgressing.

entries.text: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] - those [among them] who believed in Allāh and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who believed and those who were Jews or Christians or Sabeans [before Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] - those [among them] who believed in Allāh and the Last Day and did righteousness - will have their reward with their Lord, and no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve<sup foot_note=195957>1</sup>.

entries.text: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [O Children of Israel, to abide by the Torah] and We raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that perhaps you may become righteous."

entries.text: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.
entries.originalHtml: Then you turned away after that. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, you would have been among the losers.

entries.text: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
entries.originalHtml: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

entries.text: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: And We made it a deterrent punishment for those who were present and those who succeeded [them] and a lesson for those who fear Allāh.

entries.text: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allāh commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allāh from being among the ignorant."
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when Moses said to his people, "Indeed, Allāh commands you to slaughter a cow." They said, "Do you take us in ridicule?" He said, "I seek refuge in Allāh from being among the ignorant."

entries.text: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allāh] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is." [Moses] said, "[Allāh] says, 'It is a cow which is neither old nor virgin, but median between that,' so do what you are commanded."

entries.text: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.'"
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Call upon your Lord to show us what is her color." He said, "He says, 'It is a yellow cow, bright in color - pleasing to the observers.'"

entries.text: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allāh wills, will be guided."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Call upon your Lord to make clear to us what it is. Indeed, [all] cows look alike to us. And indeed we, if Allāh wills, will be guided."

entries.text: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "He says, 'It is a cow neither trained to plow the earth nor to irrigate the field, one free from fault with no spot upon her.'" They said, "Now you have come with the truth." So they slaughtered her, but they could hardly do it.

entries.text: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when you slew a man and disputed<sup foot_note=195958>1</sup> over it, but Allāh was to bring out that which you were concealing.

entries.text: So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it." Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.
entries.originalHtml: So We said, "Strike him [i.e., the slain man] with part of it."<sup foot_note=195959>1</sup> Thus does Allāh bring the dead to life, and He shows you His signs that you might reason.

entries.text: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allāh. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: Then your hearts became hardened after that, being like stones or even harder. For indeed, there are stones from which rivers burst forth, and there are some of them that split open and water comes out, and there are some of them that fall down for fear of Allāh. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.

entries.text: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allāh and then distort it [i.e., the Torah] after they had understood it while they were knowing?
entries.originalHtml: Do you covet [the hope, O believers], that they would believe for you while a party of them used to hear the words of Allāh and then distort it [i.e., the Torah] after they had understood it while they were knowing?

entries.text: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allāh has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?
entries.originalHtml: And when they meet those who believe, they say, "We have believed"; but when they are alone with one another, they say, "Do you talk to them about what Allāh has revealed to you so they can argue with you about it before your Lord?" Then will you not reason?

entries.text: But do they not know that Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare?
entries.originalHtml: But do they not know that Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare?

entries.text: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.
entries.originalHtml: And among them are unlettered ones who do not know the Scripture except [indulgement in] wishful thinking, but they are only assuming.

entries.text: So woe to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allāh," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.
entries.originalHtml: So woe<sup foot_note=195960>1</sup> to those who write the "scripture" with their own hands, then say, "This is from Allāh," in order to exchange it for a small price. Woe to them for what their hands have written and woe to them for what they earn.

entries.text: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for [a few] numbered days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allāh? For Allāh will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "Never will the Fire touch us, except for [a few] numbered days." Say, "Have you taken a covenant with Allāh? For Allāh will never break His covenant. Or do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"

entries.text: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever earns evil and his sin has encompassed him - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: But they who believe and do righteous deeds - those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allāh; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakāh." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We took the covenant from the Children of Israel, [enjoining upon them], "Do not worship except Allāh; and to parents do good and to relatives, orphans, and the needy. And speak to people good [words] and establish prayer and give zakāh." Then you turned away, except a few of you, and you were refusing.

entries.text: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed your [i.e., each other's] blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We took your covenant, [saying], "Do not shed your [i.e., each other's] blood or evict one another from your homes." Then you acknowledged [this] while you were witnessing.

entries.text: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: Then, you are those [same ones who are] killing one another and evicting a party of your people from their homes, cooperating against them in sin and aggression. And if they come to you as captives, you ransom them, although their eviction was forbidden to you. So do you believe in part of the Scripture and disbelieve in part? Then what is the recompense for those who do that among you except disgrace in worldly life; and on the Day of Resurrection they will be sent back to the severest of punishment. And Allāh is not unaware of what you do.

entries.text: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the ones who have bought the life of this world [in exchange] for the Hereafter, so the punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be aided.

entries.text: And We did certainly give Moses the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel]. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.
entries.originalHtml: And We did certainly give Moses the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] and followed up after him with messengers. And We gave Jesus, the son of Mary, clear proofs and supported him with the Pure Spirit [i.e., the angel Gabriel]. But is it [not] that every time a messenger came to you, [O Children of Israel], with what your souls did not desire, you were arrogant? And a party [of messengers] you denied and another party you killed.

entries.text: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped." But, [in fact], Allāh has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.
entries.originalHtml: And they said, "Our hearts are wrapped."<sup foot_note=195961>1</sup> But, [in fact], Allāh has cursed them for their disbelief, so little is it that they believe.

entries.text: And when there came to them a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] from Allāh confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allāh will be upon the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: And when there came to them a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] from Allāh confirming that which was with them - although before they used to pray for victory against those who disbelieved - but [then] when there came to them that which they recognized, they disbelieved in it; so the curse of Allāh will be upon the disbelievers.

entries.text: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allāh has revealed through [their] outrage that Allāh would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
entries.originalHtml: How wretched is that for which they sold themselves - that they would disbelieve in what Allāh has revealed through [their] outrage that Allāh would send down His favor upon whom He wills from among His servants. So they returned having [earned] wrath upon wrath. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allāh has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allāh before, if you are [indeed] believers?"
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Believe in what Allāh has revealed," they say, "We believe [only] in what was revealed to us." And they disbelieve in what came after it, while it is the truth confirming that which is with them. Say, "Then why did you kill the prophets of Allāh before, if you are [indeed] believers?"

entries.text: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: And Moses had certainly brought you clear proofs. Then you took the calf [in worship] after that, while you were wrongdoers.

entries.text: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."
entries.originalHtml: And [recall] when We took your covenant and raised over you the mount, [saying], "Take what We have given you with determination and listen." They said [instead], "We hear and disobey." And their hearts absorbed [the worship of] the calf because of their disbelief. Say, "How wretched is that which your faith enjoins upon you, if you should be believers."

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allāh is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the home of the Hereafter with Allāh is for you alone and not the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: But never will they wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: But never will they wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

entries.text: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allāh. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allāh is Seeing of what they do.
entries.originalHtml: And you will surely find them the most greedy of people for life - [even] more than those who associate others with Allāh. One of them wishes that he could be granted life a thousand years, but it would not remove him in the least from the [coming] punishment that he should be granted life. And Allāh is Seeing of what they do.

entries.text: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down upon your heart, [O Muḥammad], by permission of Allāh, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Whoever is an enemy to Gabriel - it is [none but] he who has brought it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down upon your heart, [O Muḥammad], by permission of Allāh, confirming that which was before it and as guidance and good tidings for the believers."

entries.text: Whoever is an enemy to Allāh and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allāh is an enemy to the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever is an enemy to Allāh and His angels and His messengers and Gabriel and Michael - then indeed, Allāh is an enemy to the disbelievers.

entries.text: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly revealed to you verses [which are] clear proofs, and no one would deny them except the defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.
entries.originalHtml: Is it not [true] that every time they took a covenant a party of them threw it away? But, [in fact], most of them do not believe.

entries.text: And when a messenger from Allāh came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allāh [i.e., the Torah] behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].
entries.originalHtml: And when a messenger from Allāh came to them confirming that which was with them, a party of those who had been given the Scripture threw the Scripture of Allāh [i.e., the Torah] behind their backs as if they did not know [what it contained].

entries.text: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Hārūt and Mārūt. But they [i.e., the two angels] do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]." And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allāh. And they [i.e., people] learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But they [i.e., the Children of Israel] certainly knew that whoever purchased it [i.e., magic] would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.
entries.originalHtml: And they followed [instead] what the devils had recited during the reign of Solomon. It was not Solomon who disbelieved, but the devils disbelieved, teaching people magic and that which was revealed to the two angels at Babylon, Hārūt and Mārūt. But they [i.e., the two angels] do not teach anyone unless they say, "We are a trial, so do not disbelieve [by practicing magic]."<sup foot_note=195962>1</sup> And [yet] they learn from them that by which they cause separation between a man and his wife. But they do not harm anyone through it except by permission of Allāh. And they [i.e., people] learn what harms them and does not benefit them. But they [i.e., the Children of Israel] certainly knew that whoever purchased it [i.e., magic] would not have in the Hereafter any share. And wretched is that for which they sold themselves, if they only knew.

entries.text: And if they had believed and feared Allāh, then the reward from Allāh would have been [far] better, if they only knew.
entries.originalHtml: And if they had believed and feared Allāh, then the reward from Allāh would have been [far] better, if they only knew.

entries.text: O you who have believed, say not [to Allāh's Messenger], "Rāʿinā" but say, "Unẓurnā" and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, say not [to Allāh's Messenger], "Rāʿinā" but say, "Unẓurnā"<sup foot_note=195963>1</sup> and listen. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.

entries.text: Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture [i.e., the Jews and Christians] nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allāh selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: Neither those who disbelieve from the People of the Scripture [i.e., the Jews and Christians] nor the polytheists wish that any good should be sent down to you from your Lord. But Allāh selects for His mercy whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

entries.text: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allāh is over all things competent?
entries.originalHtml: We do not abrogate a verse or cause it to be forgotten except that We bring forth [one] better than it or similar to it. Do you not know that Allāh is over all things competent?

entries.text: Do you not know that to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allāh any protector or any helper?
entries.originalHtml: Do you not know that to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and [that] you have not besides Allāh any protector or any helper?

entries.text: Or do you intend to ask your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
entries.originalHtml: Or do you intend to ask<sup foot_note=195964>1</sup> your Messenger as Moses was asked before? And whoever exchanges faith for disbelief has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.

entries.text: Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allāh delivers His command. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: Many of the People of the Scripture wish they could turn you back to disbelief after you have believed, out of envy from themselves [even] after the truth has become clear to them. So pardon and overlook until Allāh delivers His command. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

entries.text: And establish prayer and give zakāh, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. Indeed Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: And establish prayer and give zakāh, and whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. Indeed Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

entries.text: And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking. Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "None will enter Paradise except one who is a Jew or a Christian." That is [merely] their wishful thinking. Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever submits his face [i.e., self] in Islām to Allāh while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.
entries.originalHtml: Yes, [on the contrary], whoever submits his face [i.e., self] in Islām to Allāh while being a doer of good will have his reward with his Lord. And no fear will there be concerning them, nor will they grieve.

entries.text: The Jews say, "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus do those who know not [i.e., the polytheists] speak the same as their words. But Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
entries.originalHtml: The Jews say, "The Christians have nothing [true] to stand on," and the Christians say, "The Jews have nothing to stand on," although they [both] recite the Scripture. Thus do those who know not [i.e., the polytheists] speak the same as their words. But Allāh will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

entries.text: And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allāh from being mentioned [i.e., praised] in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And who are more unjust than those who prevent the name of Allāh from being mentioned [i.e., praised] in His mosques and strive toward their destruction. It is not for them to enter them except in fear. For them in this world is disgrace, and they will have in the Hereafter a great punishment.

entries.text: And to Allāh belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face<sup foot_note=195965>1</sup> of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

entries.text: They say, "Allāh has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him,
entries.originalHtml: They say, "Allāh has taken a son." Exalted is He!<sup foot_note=195966>1</sup> Rather, to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth. All are devoutly obedient to Him,

entries.text: Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
entries.originalHtml: Originator of the heavens and the earth. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

entries.text: Those who do not know say, "Why does Allāh not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" Thus spoke those before them like their words. Their hearts resemble each other. We have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: Those who do not know say, "Why does Allāh not speak to us or there come to us a sign?" Thus spoke those before them like their words. Their hearts resemble each other. We have shown clearly the signs to a people who are certain [in faith].

entries.text: Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muḥammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muḥammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner, and you will not be asked about the companions of Hellfire.

entries.text: And never will the Jews and the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the [only] guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allāh no protector or helper.
entries.originalHtml: And never will the Jews and the Christians approve of you until you follow their religion. Say, "Indeed, the guidance of Allāh is the [only] guidance." If you were to follow their desires after what has come to you of knowledge, you would have against Allāh no protector or helper.

entries.text: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital. They [are the ones who] believe in it. And whoever disbelieves in it - it is they who are the losers.
entries.originalHtml: Those to whom We have given the Book recite it with its true recital.<sup foot_note=195967>1</sup> They [are the ones who] believe in it. And whoever disbelieves in it - it is they who are the losers.

entries.text: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: O Children of Israel, remember My favor which I have bestowed upon you and that I preferred you over the worlds.

entries.text: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided.
entries.originalHtml: And fear a Day when no soul will suffice for another soul<sup foot_note=195968>1</sup> at all, and no compensation will be accepted from it, nor will any intercession benefit it, nor will they be aided.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words [i.e., commands] and he fulfilled them. [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allāh] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham was tried by his Lord with words [i.e., commands] and he fulfilled them. [Allāh] said, "Indeed, I will make you a leader for the people." [Abraham] said, "And of my descendants?" [Allāh] said, "My covenant does not include the wrongdoers."

entries.text: And [mention] when We made the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when We made the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] a place of return for the people and [a place of] security. And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer. And We charged Abraham and Ishmael, [saying], "Purify My House for those who perform ṭawāf<sup foot_note=195969>1</sup> and those who are staying [there] for worship and those who bow and prostrate [in prayer]."

entries.text: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allāh and the Last Day." [Allāh] said, "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits - whoever of them believes in Allāh and the Last Day." [Allāh] said, "And whoever disbelieves - I will grant him enjoyment for a little; then I will force him to the punishment of the Fire, and wretched is the destination."

entries.text: And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when Abraham was raising the foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael, [saying], "Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed, You are the Hearing,<sup foot_note=195971>1</sup> the Knowing.<sup foot_note=195970>2</sup>

entries.text: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Our Lord, and make us Muslims [in submission] to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation [in submission] to You. And show us our rites [of worship] and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.

entries.text: Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
entries.originalHtml: Our Lord, and send among them a messenger from themselves who will recite to them Your verses and teach them the Book and wisdom and purify them. Indeed, You are the Exalted in Might,<sup foot_note=195972>1</sup> the Wise."

entries.text: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And who would be averse to the religion of Abraham except one who makes a fool of himself. And We had chosen him in this world, and indeed he, in the Hereafter, will be among the righteous.

entries.text: When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I have submitted [in Islām] to the Lord of the worlds."
entries.originalHtml: When his Lord said to him, "Submit," he said, "I have submitted [in Islām]<sup foot_note=195973>1</sup> to the Lord of the worlds."

entries.text: And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allāh has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims."
entries.originalHtml: And Abraham instructed his sons [to do the same] and [so did] Jacob, [saying], "O my sons, indeed Allāh has chosen for you this religion, so do not die except while you are Muslims."

entries.text: Or were you witnesses when death approached Jacob, when he said to his sons, "What will you worship after me?" They said, "We will worship your God and the God of your fathers, Abraham and Ishmael and Isaac - one God. And we are Muslims [in submission] to Him."
