And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them] and those upon which the name of Allāh is not mentioned - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him. He will punish them for what they were inventing.
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "These animals<sup foot_note=196276>1</sup> and crops are forbidden; no one may eat from them except whom we will," by their claim. And there are those [camels] whose backs are forbidden [by them]<sup foot_note=196275>2</sup> and those upon which the name of Allāh is not mentioned<sup foot_note=196274>3</sup> - [all of this] an invention of untruth about Him.<sup foot_note=196273>4</sup> He will punish them for what they were inventing.

entries.text: And they say, "What is in the bellies of these animals is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. But if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." He will punish them for their description. Indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "What is in the bellies of these animals<sup foot_note=196278>1</sup> is exclusively for our males and forbidden to our females. But if it is [born] dead, then all of them have shares therein." He will punish them for their description.<sup foot_note=196277>2</sup> Indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

entries.text: They will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allāh had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allāh. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided.
entries.originalHtml: They will have lost who killed their children in foolishness without knowledge and prohibited what Allāh had provided for them, inventing untruth about Allāh. They have gone astray and were not [rightly] guided.

entries.text: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakāh] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive. Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess.
entries.originalHtml: And He it is who causes gardens to grow, [both] trellised and untrellised, and palm trees and crops of different [kinds of] food and olives and pomegranates, similar and dissimilar. Eat of [each of] its fruit when it yields and give its due [zakāh] on the day of its harvest. And be not excessive.<sup foot_note=196279>1</sup> Indeed, He does not like those who commit excess.

entries.text: And of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. Eat of what Allāh has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
entries.originalHtml: And of the grazing livestock are carriers [of burdens] and those [too] small. Eat of what Allāh has provided for you and do not follow the footsteps of Satan.<sup foot_note=196280>1</sup> Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

entries.text: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: [They are] eight mates - of the sheep, two and of the goats, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Inform me with knowledge, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: And of the camels, two and of the cattle, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when Allāh charged you with this? Then who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh to mislead the people by [something] other than knowledge? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people."
entries.originalHtml: And of the camels, two and of the cattle, two. Say, "Is it the two males He has forbidden or the two females or that which the wombs of the two females contain? Or were you witnesses when Allāh charged you with this? Then who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about Allāh to mislead the people by [something] other than knowledge? Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people."

entries.text: Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allāh. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it unless it be a dead animal or blood spilled out or the flesh of swine - for indeed, it is impure - or it be [that slaughtered in] disobedience, dedicated to other than Allāh.<sup foot_note=196281>1</sup> But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], then indeed, your Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."

entries.text: And to those who are Jews We prohibited every animal of uncloven hoof; and of the cattle and the sheep We prohibited to them their fat, except what adheres to their backs or the entrails or what is joined with bone. [By] that We repaid them for their transgression. And indeed, We are truthful.
entries.originalHtml: And to those who are Jews We prohibited every animal of uncloven hoof; and of the cattle and the sheep We prohibited to them their fat, except what adheres to their backs or the entrails or what is joined with bone. [By] that We repaid them for their transgression. And indeed, We are truthful.

entries.text: So if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], say, "Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy; but His punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals."
entries.originalHtml: So if they deny you, [O Muḥammad], say, "Your Lord is the possessor of vast mercy; but His punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals."

entries.text: Those who associated [others] with Allāh will say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have associated [anything] and neither would our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything." Likewise did those before deny until they tasted Our punishment. Say, "Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow not except assumption, and you are not but misjudging."
entries.originalHtml: Those who associated [others] with Allāh will say, "If Allāh had willed, we would not have associated [anything] and neither would our fathers, nor would we have prohibited anything." Likewise did those before deny until they tasted Our punishment. Say, "Do you have any knowledge that you can produce for us? You follow not except assumption, and you are not but misjudging."

entries.text: Say, "With Allāh is the far-reaching [i.e., conclusive] argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "With Allāh is the far-reaching [i.e., conclusive] argument. If He had willed, He would have guided you all."

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Bring forward your witnesses who will testify that Allāh has prohibited this." And if they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the desires of those who deny Our verses and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, while they equate [others] with their Lord.
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Bring forward your witnesses who will testify that Allāh has prohibited this." And if they testify, do not testify with them. And do not follow the desires of those who deny Our verses and those who do not believe in the Hereafter, while they equate [others] with their Lord.

entries.text: Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Come, I will recite what your Lord has prohibited to you. [He commands] that you not associate anything with Him, and to parents, good treatment, and do not kill your children out of poverty; We will provide for you and them. And do not approach immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed. And do not kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed] except by [legal] right. This has He instructed you that you may use reason."

entries.text: And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best [i.e., intending improvement] until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. We do not charge any soul except [with that within] its capacity. And when you speak [i.e., testify], be just, even if [it concerns] a near relative. And the covenant of Allāh fulfill. This has He instructed you that you may remember.
entries.originalHtml: And do not approach the orphan's property except in a way that is best [i.e., intending improvement] until he reaches maturity. And give full measure and weight in justice. We do not charge any soul except [with that within] its capacity. And when you speak [i.e., testify], be just, even if [it concerns] a near relative. And the covenant of Allāh fulfill. This has He instructed you that you may remember.

entries.text: And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And, [moreover], this is My path, which is straight, so follow it; and do not follow [other] ways, for you will be separated from His way. This has He instructed you that you may become righteous.

entries.text: Then We gave Moses the Scripture, making complete [Our favor] upon the one who did good [i.e., Moses] and as a detailed explanation of all things and as guidance and mercy that perhaps in the meeting with their Lord they would believe.
entries.originalHtml: Then<sup foot_note=196282>1</sup> We gave Moses the Scripture, making complete [Our favor] upon the one who did good [i.e., Moses] and as a detailed explanation of all things and as guidance and mercy that perhaps in the meeting with their Lord they would believe.

entries.text: And this [Qur’ān] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
entries.originalHtml: And this [Qur’ān] is a Book We have revealed [which is] blessed, so follow it and fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

entries.text: [We revealed it] lest you say, "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, but we were of their study unaware,"
entries.originalHtml: [We revealed it] lest you say, "The Scripture was only sent down to two groups before us, but we were of their study unaware,"

entries.text: Or lest you say, "If only the Scripture had been revealed to us, we would have been better guided than they." So there has [now] come to you a clear evidence from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. Then who is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allāh and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment for their having turned away.
entries.originalHtml: Or lest you say, "If only the Scripture had been revealed to us, we would have been better guided than they." So there has [now] come to you a clear evidence from your Lord and a guidance and mercy. Then who is more unjust than one who denies the verses of Allāh and turns away from them? We will recompense those who turn away from Our verses with the worst of punishment for their having turned away.

entries.text: Do they [then] wait for anything except that the angels should come to them or your Lord should come or that there come some of the signs of your Lord? The Day that some of the signs of your Lord will come no soul will benefit from its faith as long as it had not believed before or had earned through its faith some good. Say, "Wait. Indeed, we [also] are waiting."
entries.originalHtml: Do they [then] wait for anything except that the angels should come to them or your Lord should come or that there come some of the signs<sup foot_note=196283>1</sup> of your Lord? The Day that some of the signs of your Lord will come no soul will benefit from its faith as long as it had not believed before or had earned through its faith some good. Say, "Wait. Indeed, we [also] are waiting."

entries.text: Indeed, those who have divided their religion and become sects - you, [O Muḥammad], are not [associated] with them in anything. Their affair is only [left] to Allāh; then He will inform them about what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who have divided their religion and become sects - you, [O Muḥammad], are not [associated] with them in anything. Their affair is only [left] to Allāh; then He will inform them about what they used to do.

entries.text: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof [to his credit], and whoever comes with an evil deed will not be recompensed except the like thereof; and they will not be wronged.<sup foot_note=196284>1</sup>

entries.text: Say, "Indeed, my Lord has guided me to a straight path - a correct religion - the way of Abraham, inclining toward truth. And he was not among those who associated others with Allāh."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Indeed, my Lord has guided me to a straight path - a correct religion - the way of Abraham, inclining toward truth. And he was not among those who associated others with Allāh."

entries.text: Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."
entries.originalHtml: No partner has He. And this I have been commanded, and I am the first [among you] of the Muslims."<sup foot_note=196285>1</sup>

entries.text: Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not [blame] except against itself, and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire as a lord while He is the Lord of all things? And every soul earns not [blame] except against itself, and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you concerning that over which you used to differ."

entries.text: And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who has made you successors upon the earth and has raised some of you above others in degrees [of rank] that He may try you through what He has given you. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Alif, Lām, Meem, Ṣād.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Meem, Ṣād.<sup foot_note=196286>1</sup>

entries.text: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muḥammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] a Book revealed to you, [O Muḥammad] - so let there not be in your breast distress therefrom - that you may warn thereby and as a reminder to the believers.

entries.text: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies. Little do you remember.
entries.originalHtml: Follow, [O mankind], what has been revealed to you from your Lord and do not follow other than Him any allies. Little do you remember.

entries.text: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.
entries.originalHtml: And how many cities have We destroyed, and Our punishment came to them at night or while they were sleeping at noon.

entries.text: And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers!"
entries.originalHtml: And their declaration when Our punishment came to them was only that they said, "Indeed, we were wrongdoers!"

entries.text: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.
entries.originalHtml: Then We will surely question those to whom [a message] was sent, and We will surely question the messengers.

entries.text: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.
entries.originalHtml: Then We will surely relate [their deeds] to them with knowledge, and We were not [at all] absent.

entries.text: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.
entries.originalHtml: And the weighing [of deeds] that Day will be the truth. So those whose scales are heavy - it is they who will be the successful.

entries.text: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.
entries.originalHtml: And those whose scales are light - they are the ones who will lose themselves for what injustice they were doing toward Our verses.

entries.text: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly established you upon the earth and made for you therein ways of livelihood. Little are you grateful.

entries.text: And We have certainly created you, [O mankind], and given you [human] form. Then We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was not of those who prostrated.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly created you, [O mankind], and given you [human] form. Then We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam"; so they prostrated, except for Iblees.<sup foot_note=196287>1</sup> He was not of those who prostrated.

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" [Satan] said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay [i.e., earth]."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "What prevented you from prostrating when I commanded you?" [Satan] said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay [i.e., earth]."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise], for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "Descend from it [i.e., Paradise], for it is not for you to be arrogant therein. So get out; indeed, you are of the debased."

entries.text: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
entries.originalHtml: [Satan] said, "Reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "Indeed, you are of those reprieved."

entries.text: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them [i.e., mankind] on Your straight path.
entries.originalHtml: [Satan] said, "Because You have put me in error, I will surely sit in wait for them [i.e., mankind] on Your straight path.

entries.text: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]."
entries.originalHtml: Then I will come to them from before them and from behind them and on their right and on their left, and You will not find most of them grateful [to You]."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "Depart from it [i.e., Paradise], reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "Depart from it [i.e., Paradise], reproached and expelled. Whoever follows you among them - I will surely fill Hell with you, all together."

entries.text: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."
entries.originalHtml: And "O Adam, dwell, you and your wife, in Paradise and eat from wherever you will but do not approach this tree, lest you be among the wrongdoers."

entries.text: But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal."
entries.originalHtml: But Satan whispered to them to make apparent to them that which was concealed from them of their private parts. He said, "Your Lord did not forbid you this tree except that you become angels or become of the immortal."

entries.text: And he swore [by Allāh] to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors."
entries.originalHtml: And he swore [by Allāh] to them, "Indeed, I am to you from among the sincere advisors."

entries.text: So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"
entries.originalHtml: So he made them fall, through deception. And when they tasted of the tree, their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten together over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And their Lord called to them, "Did I not forbid you from that tree and tell you that Satan is to you a clear enemy?"

entries.text: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "Descend, being to one another enemies. And for you on the earth is a place of settlement and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time."

entries.text: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Therein you will live, and therein you will die, and from it you will be brought forth."

entries.text: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allāh that perhaps they will remember.
entries.originalHtml: O children of Adam, We have bestowed upon you clothing to conceal your private parts and as adornment. But the clothing of righteousness - that is best. That is from the signs of Allāh that perhaps they will remember.

entries.text: O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing to show them their private parts. Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them. Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe.
entries.originalHtml: O children of Adam, let not Satan tempt you as he removed your parents from Paradise, stripping them of their clothing<sup foot_note=196288>1</sup> to show them their private parts. Indeed, he sees you, he and his tribe, from where you do not see them. Indeed, We have made the devils allies to those who do not believe.

entries.text: And when they commit an immorality, they say, "We found our fathers doing it, and Allāh has ordered us to do it." Say, "Indeed, Allāh does not order immorality. Do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"
entries.originalHtml: And when they commit an immorality, they say, "We found our fathers doing it, and Allāh has ordered us to do it." Say, "Indeed, Allāh does not order immorality. Do you say about Allāh that which you do not know?"

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord has ordered justice and that you direct yourselves [to the Qiblah] at every place [or time] of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return [to life] -
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord has ordered justice and that you direct yourselves [to the Qiblah] at every place [or time] of prostration, and invoke Him, sincere to Him in religion." Just as He originated you, you will return [to life] -

entries.text: A group [of you] He guided, and a group deserved [to be in] error. Indeed, they [i.e., the latter] had taken the devils as allies instead of Allāh while they thought that they were guided.
entries.originalHtml: A group [of you] He guided, and a group deserved [to be in] error. Indeed, they [i.e., the latter] had taken the devils as allies instead of Allāh while they thought that they were guided.

entries.text: O children of Adam, take your adornment [i.e., wear your clothing] at every masjid, and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.
entries.originalHtml: O children of Adam, take your adornment [i.e., wear your clothing] at every masjid,<sup foot_note=196289>1</sup> and eat and drink, but be not excessive. Indeed, He likes not those who commit excess.

entries.text: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of [i.e., from] Allāh which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believed during the life of this world, exclusively [for them] on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of [i.e., from] Allāh which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believed during the life of this world, exclusively [for them] on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know.

entries.text: Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin, and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allāh that which you do not know."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "My Lord has only forbidden immoralities - what is apparent of them and what is concealed - and sin,<sup foot_note=196290>1</sup> and oppression without right, and that you associate with Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority, and that you say about Allāh that which you do not know."

entries.text: And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
entries.originalHtml: And for every nation is a [specified] term. So when their time has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].

entries.text: O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses [i.e., scriptures and laws], then whoever fears Allāh and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
entries.originalHtml: O children of Adam, if there come to you messengers from among you relating to you My verses [i.e., scriptures and laws], then whoever fears Allāh and reforms - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

entries.text: But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: But the ones who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree until, when Our messengers [i.e., angels] come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us," and will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh a lie or denies His verses? Those will attain their portion of the decree<sup foot_note=196291>1</sup> until, when Our messengers [i.e., angels] come to them to take them in death, they will say, "Where are those you used to invoke besides Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us," and will bear witness against themselves that they were disbelievers.

entries.text: [Allāh] will say, "Enter among nations which had passed on before you of jinn and mankind into the Fire." Every time a nation enters, it will curse its sister until, when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them will say about the first of them, "Our Lord, these had misled us, so give them a double punishment of the Fire." He will say, "For each is double, but you do not know."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] will say, "Enter among nations which had passed on before you of jinn and mankind into the Fire." Every time a nation enters, it will curse its sister<sup foot_note=196294>1</sup> until, when they have all overtaken one another therein, the last of them<sup foot_note=196293>2</sup> will say about the first of them,<sup foot_note=196292>3</sup> "Our Lord, these had misled us, so give them a double punishment of the Fire." He will say, "For each is double, but you do not know."

entries.text: And the first of them will say to the last of them, "Then you had not any favor over us, so taste the punishment for what you used to earn."
entries.originalHtml: And the first of them will say to the last of them, "Then you had not any favor over us, so taste the punishment for what you used to earn."

entries.text: Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle [i.e., never]. And thus do We recompense the criminals.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who deny Our verses and are arrogant toward them - the gates of Heaven will not be opened for them, nor will they enter Paradise until a camel enters into the eye of a needle [i.e., never]. And thus do We recompense the criminals.

entries.text: They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

entries.text: But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except [within] its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: But those who believed and did righteous deeds - We charge no soul except [within] its capacity. Those are the companions of Paradise; they will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: And We will have removed whatever is within their breasts of resentment, [while] flowing beneath them are rivers. And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allāh had not guided us. Certainly the messengers of our Lord had come with the truth." And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made to inherit for what you used to do."
entries.originalHtml: And We will have removed whatever is within their breasts of resentment,<sup foot_note=196295>1</sup> [while] flowing beneath them are rivers. And they will say, "Praise to Allāh, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allāh had not guided us. Certainly the messengers of our Lord had come with the truth." And they will be called, "This is Paradise, which you have been made to inherit for what you used to do."

entries.text: And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allāh shall be upon the wrongdoers
entries.originalHtml: And the companions of Paradise will call out to the companions of the Fire, "We have already found what our Lord promised us to be true. Have you found what your Lord promised to be true?" They will say, "Yes." Then an announcer will announce among them, "The curse of Allāh shall be upon the wrongdoers

entries.text: Who averted [people] from the way of Allāh and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers."
entries.originalHtml: Who averted [people] from the way of Allāh and sought to make it [seem] deviant while they were, concerning the Hereafter, disbelievers."

entries.text: And between them will be a partition [i.e., wall], and on [its] elevations are men who recognize all by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely.
entries.originalHtml: And between them will be a partition [i.e., wall], and on [its] elevations are men<sup foot_note=196297>1</sup> who recognize all<sup foot_note=196296>2</sup> by their mark. And they call out to the companions of Paradise, "Peace be upon you." They have not [yet] entered it, but they long intensely.

entries.text: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people."
entries.originalHtml: And when their eyes are turned toward the companions of the Fire, they say, "Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people."

entries.text: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering and [the fact] that you were arrogant."
entries.originalHtml: And the companions of the Elevations will call to men [within Hell] whom they recognize by their mark, saying, "Of no avail to you was your gathering<sup foot_note=196298>1</sup> and [the fact] that you were arrogant."

entries.text: [Allāh will say], "Are these the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allāh would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O people of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh will say], "Are these<sup foot_note=196299>1</sup> the ones whom you [inhabitants of Hell] swore that Allāh would never offer them mercy? Enter Paradise, [O people of the Elevations]. No fear will there be concerning you, nor will you grieve."

entries.text: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allāh has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allāh has forbidden them both to the disbelievers
entries.originalHtml: And the companions of the Fire will call to the companions of Paradise, "Pour upon us some water or from whatever Allāh has provided you." They will say, "Indeed, Allāh has forbidden them both to the disbelievers

entries.text: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses.
entries.originalHtml: Who took their religion as distraction and amusement and whom the worldly life deluded." So today We will forget them just as they forgot the meeting of this Day of theirs and for having rejected Our verses.

entries.text: And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe.
entries.originalHtml: And We had certainly brought them a Book which We detailed by knowledge - as guidance and mercy to a people who believe.

entries.text: Do they await except its result? The Day its result comes, those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than what we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
entries.originalHtml: Do they await except its result?<sup foot_note=196300>1</sup> The Day its result comes, those who had ignored it before will say, "The messengers of our Lord had come with the truth, so are there [now] any intercessors to intercede for us or could we be sent back to do other than what we used to do?" They will have lost themselves, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

entries.text: Indeed, your Lord is Allāh, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, your Lord is Allāh, who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.<sup foot_note=196301>1</sup> He covers the night with the day, [another night] chasing it rapidly; and [He created] the sun, the moon, and the stars, subjected by His command. Unquestionably, His is the creation and the command; blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
entries.originalHtml: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.<sup foot_note=196302>1</sup>

entries.text: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: And cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. And invoke Him in fear and aspiration. Indeed, the mercy of Allāh is near to the doers of good.

entries.text: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall] until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall] until, when they have carried heavy rainclouds, We drive them to a dead land and We send down rain therein and bring forth thereby [some] of all the fruits. Thus will We bring forth the dead; perhaps you may be reminded.

entries.text: And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful.
entries.originalHtml: And the good land - its vegetation emerges by permission of its Lord; but that which is bad - nothing emerges except sparsely, with difficulty. Thus do We diversify the signs for a people who are grateful.

entries.text: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day."
entries.originalHtml: We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous Day."

entries.text: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error."
entries.originalHtml: Said the eminent among his people, "Indeed, we see you in clear error."

entries.text: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you; and I know from Allāh what you do not know.
entries.originalHtml: I convey to you the messages of my Lord and advise you; and I know from Allāh what you do not know.

entries.text: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allāh so you might receive mercy?"
entries.originalHtml: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you and that you may fear Allāh so you might receive mercy?"

entries.text: But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people.
entries.originalHtml: But they denied him, so We saved him and those who were with him in the ship. And We drowned those who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a blind people.<sup foot_note=196303>1</sup>

entries.text: And to the ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him?"
entries.originalHtml: And to the ʿAad [We sent] their brother Hūd. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. Then will you not fear Him?"

entries.text: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars."
entries.originalHtml: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "Indeed, we see you in foolishness, and indeed, we think you are of the liars."

entries.text: [Hūd] said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: [Hūd] said, "O my people, there is not foolishness in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.
entries.originalHtml: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.

entries.text: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed."
entries.originalHtml: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed."

entries.text: They said, "Have you come to us that we should worship Allāh alone and leave what our fathers have worshipped? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Have you come to us that we should worship Allāh alone and leave what our fathers have worshipped? Then bring us what you promise us,<sup foot_note=196304>1</sup> if you should be of the truthful."

entries.text: [Hūd] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."
entries.originalHtml: [Hūd] said, "Already have defilement and anger fallen upon you from your Lord. Do you dispute with me concerning [mere] names you have named them,<sup foot_note=196305>1</sup> you and your fathers, for which Allāh has not sent down any authority? Then wait; indeed, I am with you among those who wait."

entries.text: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers.
entries.originalHtml: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers.

entries.text: And to the Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allāh [sent] to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allāh's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And to the Thamūd [We sent] their brother Ṣāliḥ. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. This is the she-camel of Allāh [sent] to you as a sign. So leave her to eat within Allāh's land and do not touch her with harm, lest there seize you a painful punishment.

entries.text: And remember when He made you successors after the ʿAad and settled you in the land, [and] you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allāh and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."
entries.originalHtml: And remember when He made you successors after the ʿAad and settled you in the land, [and] you take for yourselves palaces from its plains and carve from the mountains, homes. Then remember the favors of Allāh and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption."

entries.text: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you [actually] know that Ṣāliḥ is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers."
entries.originalHtml: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people to those who were oppressed - to those who believed among them, "Do you [actually] know that Ṣāliḥ is sent from his Lord?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which he was sent, are believers."

entries.text: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."
entries.originalHtml: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."

entries.text: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers."
entries.originalHtml: So they hamstrung the she-camel and were insolent toward the command of their Lord and said, "O Ṣāliḥ, bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the messengers."

entries.text: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
entries.originalHtml: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

entries.text: And he [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you, but you do not like advisors."
entries.originalHtml: And he [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the message of my Lord and advised you, but you do not like advisors."

entries.text: And [We had sent] Lot when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds [i.e., peoples]?
entries.originalHtml: And [We had sent] Lot when he said to his people, "Do you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds [i.e., peoples]?

entries.text: Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, you approach men with desire, instead of women. Rather, you are a transgressing people."

entries.text: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure."
entries.originalHtml: But the answer of his people was only that they said, "Evict them from your city! Indeed, they are men who keep themselves pure."

entries.text: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers].
entries.originalHtml: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers].

entries.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones]. Then see how was the end of the criminals.
entries.originalHtml: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones]. Then see how was the end of the criminals.

entries.text: And to [the people of] Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. So fulfill the measure and weight and do not deprive people of their due and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. That is better for you, if you should be believers.
entries.originalHtml: And to [the people of] Madyan [We sent] their brother Shuʿayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him. There has come to you clear evidence from your Lord. So fulfill the measure and weight and do not deprive people of their due and cause not corruption upon the earth after its reformation. That is better for you, if you should be believers.

entries.text: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allāh those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters.
entries.originalHtml: And do not sit on every path, threatening and averting from the way of Allāh those who believe in Him, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. And remember when you were few and He increased you. And see how was the end of the corrupters.

entries.text: And if there should be a group among you who has believed in that with which I have been sent and a group that has not believed, then be patient until Allāh judges between us. And He is the best of judges."
entries.originalHtml: And if there should be a group among you who has believed in that with which I have been sent and a group that has not believed, then be patient until Allāh judges between us. And He is the best of judges."

entries.text: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people, "We will surely evict you, O Shuʿayb, and those who have believed with you from our city, or you must return to our religion." He said, "Even if we were unwilling?
entries.originalHtml: Said the eminent ones who were arrogant among his people, "We will surely evict you, O Shuʿayb, and those who have believed with you from our city, or you must return to our religion." He said, "Even if we were unwilling?

entries.text: We would have invented against Allāh a lie if we returned to your religion after Allāh had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allāh, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allāh we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision."
entries.originalHtml: We would have invented against Allāh a lie if we returned to your religion after Allāh had saved us from it. And it is not for us to return to it except that Allāh, our Lord, should will. Our Lord has encompassed all things in knowledge. Upon Allāh we have relied. Our Lord, decide between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of those who give decision."

entries.text: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shuʿayb, indeed, you would then be losers."
entries.originalHtml: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shuʿayb, indeed, you would then be losers."

entries.text: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
entries.originalHtml: So the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.

entries.text: Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was they who were the losers.
entries.originalHtml: Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was as though they had never resided there. Those who denied Shuʿayb - it was they who were the losers.

entries.text: And he [i.e., Shuʿayb] turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and advised you, so how could I grieve for a disbelieving people?"
entries.originalHtml: And he [i.e., Shuʿayb] turned away from them and said, "O my people, I had certainly conveyed to you the messages of my Lord and advised you, so how could I grieve for a disbelieving people?"

entries.text: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: And We sent to no city a prophet [who was denied] except that We seized its people with poverty and hardship that they might humble themselves [to Allāh].

entries.text: Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched with hardship and ease." So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.
entries.originalHtml: Then We exchanged in place of the bad [condition], good, until they increased [and prospered] and said, "Our fathers [also] were touched with hardship and ease."<sup foot_note=196307>1</sup> So We seized them suddenly while they did not perceive.<sup foot_note=196306>2</sup>

entries.text: And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allāh, We would have opened [i.e., bestowed] upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied [the messengers], so We seized them for what they were earning.
entries.originalHtml: And if only the people of the cities had believed and feared Allāh, We would have opened [i.e., bestowed] upon them blessings from the heaven and the earth; but they denied [the messengers], so We seized them for what they were earning.<sup foot_note=196308>1</sup>

entries.text: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?
entries.originalHtml: Then, did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them at night while they were asleep?

entries.text: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play?
entries.originalHtml: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play?<sup foot_note=196309>1</sup>

entries.text: Then, did they feel secure from the plan of Allāh? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allāh except the losing people.
entries.originalHtml: Then, did they feel secure from the plan of Allāh? But no one feels secure from the plan of Allāh except the losing people.

entries.text: Has it not become clear to those who inherited the earth after its [previous] people that if We willed, We could afflict them for their sins? But We seal over their hearts so they do not hear.
entries.originalHtml: Has it not become clear to those who inherited the earth after its [previous] people that if We willed, We could afflict them for their sins? But We seal over their hearts so they do not hear.<sup foot_note=196310>1</sup>

entries.text: Those cities - We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before. Thus does Allāh seal over the hearts of the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: Those cities - We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], some of their news. And certainly did their messengers come to them with clear proofs, but they were not to believe in that which they had denied before.<sup foot_note=196311>1</sup> Thus does Allāh seal over the hearts of the disbelievers.

entries.text: And We did not find for most of them any covenant; but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not find for most of them any covenant;<sup foot_note=196312>1</sup> but indeed, We found most of them defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: Then We sent after them Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were unjust toward them. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
entries.originalHtml: Then We sent after them Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were unjust toward them.<sup foot_note=196313>1</sup> So see how was the end of the corrupters.

entries.text: And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds
entries.originalHtml: And Moses said, "O Pharaoh, I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds

entries.text: [Who is] obligated not to say about Allāh except the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so send with me the Children of Israel."
entries.originalHtml: [Who is] obligated not to say about Allāh except the truth. I have come to you with clear evidence from your Lord, so send with me the Children of Israel."<sup foot_note=196314>1</sup>

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said, "If you have come with a sign, then bring it forth, if you should be of the truthful."

entries.text: So he [i.e., Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.
entries.originalHtml: So he [i.e., Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, manifest.<sup foot_note=196315>1</sup>

entries.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.
entries.originalHtml: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white [with radiance] for the observers.

entries.text: Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician
entries.originalHtml: Said the eminent among the people of Pharaoh, "Indeed, this is a learned magician

entries.text: Who wants to expel you from your land [through magic], so what do you instruct?"
entries.originalHtml: Who wants to expel you from your land [through magic], so what do you instruct?"

entries.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
entries.originalHtml: They said,<sup foot_note=196316>1</sup> "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

entries.text: Who will bring you every learned magician."
entries.originalHtml: Who will bring you every learned magician."

entries.text: And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, "Indeed for us is a reward if we are the predominant."
entries.originalHtml: And the magicians came to Pharaoh. They said, "Indeed for us is a reward if we are the predominant."

entries.text: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Yes, and, [moreover], you will be among those made near [to me]."

entries.text: They said, "O Moses, either you throw [your staff], or we will be the ones to throw [first]."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O Moses, either you throw [your staff], or we will be the ones to throw [first]."

entries.text: He said, "Throw," and when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they presented a great [feat of] magic.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Throw," and when they threw, they bewitched the eyes of the people and struck terror into them, and they presented a great [feat of] magic.<sup foot_note=196317>1</sup>

entries.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying.
entries.originalHtml: And We inspired to Moses, "Throw your staff," and at once it devoured what they were falsifying.

entries.text: So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing.
entries.originalHtml: So the truth was established, and abolished was what they were doing.

entries.text: And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.
entries.originalHtml: And they [i.e., Pharaoh and his people] were overcome right there and became debased.

entries.text: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: And the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

entries.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

entries.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
entries.originalHtml: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

entries.text: Said Pharaoh, "You believed in him before I gave you permission. Indeed, this is a conspiracy which you conspired in the city to expel therefrom its people. But you are going to know.
entries.originalHtml: Said Pharaoh, "You believed in him<sup foot_note=196318>1</sup> before I gave you permission. Indeed, this is a conspiracy which you conspired in the city to expel therefrom its people. But you are going to know.

entries.text: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."
entries.originalHtml: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."

entries.text: They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

entries.text: And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]."
entries.originalHtml: And you do not resent us except because we believed in the signs of our Lord when they came to us. Our Lord, pour upon us patience<sup foot_note=196319>1</sup> and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You]."

entries.text: And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said, "Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" [Pharaoh] said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them."
entries.originalHtml: And the eminent among the people of Pharaoh said, "Will you leave Moses and his people to cause corruption in the land and abandon you and your gods?" [Pharaoh] said, "We will kill their sons and keep their women alive; and indeed, we are subjugators over them."

entries.text: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allāh and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allāh. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous."
entries.originalHtml: Said Moses to his people, "Seek help through Allāh and be patient. Indeed, the earth belongs to Allāh. He causes to inherit it whom He wills of His servants. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous."

entries.text: They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We have been harmed before you came to us and after you have come to us." He said, "Perhaps your Lord will destroy your enemy and grant you succession in the land and see how you will do."

entries.text: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.
entries.originalHtml: And We certainly seized<sup foot_note=196320>1</sup> the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.

entries.text: But when good [i.e., provision] came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allāh, but most of them do not know.
entries.originalHtml: But when good [i.e., provision] came to them, they said, "This is ours [by right]." And if a bad [condition] struck them, they saw an evil omen in Moses and those with him. Unquestionably, their fortune is with Allāh, but most of them do not know.

entries.text: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you."
entries.originalHtml: And they said, "No matter what sign you bring us with which to bewitch us, we will not be believers in you."

entries.text: So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people.
entries.originalHtml: So We sent upon them the flood and locusts and lice and frogs and blood as distinct signs, but they were arrogant and were a criminal people.

entries.text: And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Moses, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you [can] remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel."
entries.originalHtml: And when the punishment descended upon them, they said, "O Moses, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. If you [can] remove the punishment from us, we will surely believe you, and we will send with you the Children of Israel."

entries.text: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.
entries.originalHtml: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach,<sup foot_note=196321>1</sup> then at once they broke their word.

entries.text: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them.
entries.originalHtml: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them.

entries.text: And We caused the people who had been oppressed to inherit the eastern regions of the land and the western ones, which We had blessed. And the good word [i.e., decree] of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of what they had patiently endured. And We destroyed [all] that Pharaoh and his people were producing and what they had been building.
entries.originalHtml: And We caused the people who had been oppressed to inherit the eastern regions of the land and the western ones, which We had blessed. And the good word [i.e., decree] of your Lord was fulfilled for the Children of Israel because of what they had patiently endured. And We destroyed [all] that Pharaoh and his people were producing and what they had been building.

entries.text: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They [the Children of Israel] said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly.
entries.originalHtml: And We took the Children of Israel across the sea; then they came upon a people intent in devotion to [some] idols of theirs. They [the Children of Israel] said, "O Moses, make for us a god just as they have gods." He said, "Indeed, you are a people behaving ignorantly.

entries.text: Indeed, those [worshippers] - destroyed is that in which they are [engaged], and worthless is whatever they were doing."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those [worshippers] - destroyed is that in which they are [engaged], and worthless is whatever they were doing."

entries.text: He said, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire for you as a god while He has preferred you over the worlds?"
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Is it other than Allāh I should desire for you as a god<sup foot_note=196322>1</sup> while He has preferred you over the worlds?"

entries.text: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when We saved you from the people of Pharaoh, [who were] afflicting you with the worst torment - killing your sons and keeping your women alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

entries.text: And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights and perfected them by [the addition of] ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Take my place among my people, do right [by them], and do not follow the way of the corrupters."
entries.originalHtml: And We made an appointment with Moses for thirty nights and perfected them by [the addition of] ten; so the term of his Lord was completed as forty nights. And Moses said to his brother Aaron, "Take my place among my people, do right [by them],<sup foot_note=196323>1</sup> and do not follow the way of the corrupters."

entries.text: And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [Allāh] said, "You will not see Me, but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level, and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first [among my people] of the believers."
entries.originalHtml: And when Moses arrived at Our appointed time and his Lord spoke to him, he said, "My Lord, show me [Yourself] that I may look at You." [Allāh] said, "You will not see Me,<sup foot_note=196326>1</sup> but look at the mountain; if it should remain in place, then you will see Me." But when his Lord appeared to the mountain, He rendered it level,<sup foot_note=196325>2</sup> and Moses fell unconscious. And when he awoke, he said, "Exalted are You! I have repented to You, and I am the first [among my people] of the believers."<sup foot_note=196324>3</sup>

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "O Moses, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My words [to you]. So take what I have given you and be among the grateful."
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "O Moses, I have chosen you over the people with My messages and My words [to you]. So take what I have given you and be among the grateful."

entries.text: And We wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient."
entries.originalHtml: And We wrote for him on the tablets [something] of all things - instruction and explanation for all things, [saying], "Take them with determination and order your people to take the best of it. I will show you the home of the defiantly disobedient."<sup foot_note=196327>1</sup>

entries.text: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness, they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them.
entries.originalHtml: I will turn away from My signs those who are arrogant upon the earth without right; and if they should see every sign, they will not believe in it. And if they see the way of consciousness,<sup foot_note=196328>1</sup> they will not adopt it as a way; but if they see the way of error, they will adopt it as a way. That is because they have denied Our signs and they were heedless of them.

entries.text: Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do?
entries.originalHtml: Those who denied Our signs and the meeting of the Hereafter - their deeds have become worthless. Are they recompensed except for what they used to do?

entries.text: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: And the people of Moses made, after [his departure], from their ornaments a calf - an image having a lowing sound. Did they not see that it could neither speak to them nor guide them to a way? They took it [for worship], and they were wrongdoers.

entries.text: And when regret overcame them and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers."
entries.originalHtml: And when regret overcame them<sup foot_note=196329>1</sup> and they saw that they had gone astray, they said, "If our Lord does not have mercy upon us and forgive us, we will surely be among the losers."

entries.text: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after [my departure]. Were you impatient over the matter of your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets and seized his brother by [the hair of] his head, pulling him toward him. [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, indeed the people overpowered me and were about to kill me, so let not the enemies rejoice over me and do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
entries.originalHtml: And when Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved, he said, "How wretched is that by which you have replaced me after [my departure]. Were you impatient over the matter of your Lord?" And he threw down the tablets and seized his brother by [the hair of] his head, pulling him toward him. [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, indeed the people overpowered me and were about to kill me, so let not the enemies rejoice over me<sup foot_note=196330>1</sup> and do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

entries.text: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy, for You are the most merciful of the merciful."

entries.text: Indeed, those who took the calf [for worship] will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors [of falsehood].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who took the calf [for worship] will obtain anger from their Lord and humiliation in the life of this world, and thus do We recompense the inventors [of falsehood].

entries.text: But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: But those who committed misdeeds and then repented after them and believed - indeed your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.
entries.originalHtml: And when the anger subsided in Moses, he took up the tablets; and in their inscription was guidance and mercy for those who are fearful of their Lord.

entries.text: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment. And when the earthquake seized them, he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.
entries.originalHtml: And Moses chose from his people seventy men for Our appointment.<sup foot_note=196332>1</sup> And when the earthquake seized them,<sup foot_note=196331>2</sup> he said, "My Lord, if You had willed, You could have destroyed them before and me [as well]. Would You destroy us for what the foolish among us have done? This is not but Your trial by which You send astray whom You will and guide whom You will. You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us; and You are the best of forgivers.

entries.text: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [Allāh] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakāh and those who believe in Our verses-
entries.originalHtml: And decree for us in this world [that which is] good and [also] in the Hereafter; indeed, we have turned back to You." [Allāh] said, "My punishment - I afflict with it whom I will, but My mercy encompasses all things." So I will decree it [especially] for those who fear Me and give zakāh and those who believe in Our verses-

entries.text: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written [i.e., described] in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and prohibits them from what is wrong and makes lawful for them what is good and forbids them from what is evil and relieves them of their burden and the shackles which were upon them. So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful.
entries.originalHtml: Those who follow the Messenger, the unlettered prophet, whom they find written [i.e., described] in what they have of the Torah and the Gospel, who enjoins upon them what is right and prohibits them from what is wrong and makes lawful for them what is good and forbids them from what is evil and relieves them of their burden<sup foot_note=196334>1</sup> and the shackles which were upon them.<sup foot_note=196333>2</sup> So they who have believed in him, honored him, supported him and followed the light which was sent down with him - it is those who will be the successful.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allāh to you all, [from Him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death." So believe in Allāh and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allāh and His words, and follow him that you may be guided.
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of Allāh to you all, [from Him] to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death."
