So believe in Allāh and His Messenger, the unlettered prophet, who believes in Allāh and His words, and follow him that you may be guided.

entries.text: And among the people of Moses is a community which guides by truth and by it establishes justice.
entries.originalHtml: And among the people of Moses is a community<sup foot_note=196335>1</sup> which guides by truth and by it establishes justice.

entries.text: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves.
entries.originalHtml: And We divided them into twelve descendant tribes<sup foot_note=196336>1</sup> [as distinct] nations. And We inspired to Moses when his people implored him for water, "Strike with your staff the stone," and there gushed forth from it twelve springs. Every people [i.e., tribe] knew its watering place. And We shaded them with clouds and sent down upon them manna and quails, [saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you." And they wronged Us not, but they were [only] wronging themselves.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins],' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when it was said to them, "Dwell in this city [i.e., Jerusalem] and eat from it wherever you will and say, 'Relieve us of our burdens [i.e., sins],' and enter the gate bowing humbly; We will [then] forgive you your sins. We will increase the doers of good [in goodness and reward]."

entries.text: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing.
entries.originalHtml: But those who wronged among them changed [the words] to a statement other than that which had been said to them. So We sent upon them a punishment from the sky for the wrong that they were doing.

entries.text: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: And ask them about the town that was by the sea - when they transgressed in [the matter of] the sabbath - when their fish came to them openly on their sabbath day, and the day they had no sabbath they did not come to them. Thus did We give them trial because they were defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise [or warn] a people whom Allāh is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him."
entries.originalHtml: And when a community among them said, "Why do you advise [or warn] a people whom Allāh is [about] to destroy or to punish with a severe punishment?" they [the advisors] said, "To be absolved before your Lord and perhaps they may fear Him."

entries.text: And when they [i.e., those advised] forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying.
entries.originalHtml: And when they [i.e., those advised] forgot that by which they had been reminded, We saved those who had forbidden evil and seized those who wronged, with a wretched punishment, because they were defiantly disobeying.

entries.text: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised."
entries.originalHtml: So when they were insolent about that which they had been forbidden, We said to them, "Be apes, despised."

entries.text: And [mention] when your Lord declared that He would surely [continue to] send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when your Lord declared that He would surely [continue to] send upon them until the Day of Resurrection those who would afflict them with the worst torment. Indeed, your Lord is swift in penalty; but indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience].
entries.originalHtml: And We divided them throughout the earth into nations. Of them some were righteous, and of them some were otherwise. And We tested them with good [times] and bad that perhaps they would return [to obedience].

entries.text: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] taken from them that they would not say about Allāh except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allāh, so will you not use reason?
entries.originalHtml: And there followed them successors who inherited the Scripture [while] taking the commodities<sup foot_note=196338>1</sup> of this lower life and saying, "It will be forgiven for us." And if an offer like it<sup foot_note=196337>2</sup> comes to them, they will [again] take it. Was not the covenant of the Scripture [i.e., the Torah] taken from them that they would not say about Allāh except the truth, and they studied what was in it? And the home of the Hereafter is better for those who fear Allāh, so will you not use reason?

entries.text: But those who hold fast to the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.
entries.originalHtml: But those who hold fast to the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.

entries.text: And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them, [and Allāh said], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allāh."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when We raised the mountain above them as if it was a dark cloud and they were certain that it would fall upon them,<sup foot_note=196339>1</sup> [and Allāh said], "Take what We have given you with determination and remember what is in it that you might fear Allāh."

entries.text: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when your Lord took from the children of Adam - from their loins - their descendants and made them testify of themselves, [saying to them], "Am I not your Lord?" They said, "Yes, we have testified." [This] - lest you should say on the Day of Resurrection, "Indeed, we were of this unaware."

entries.text: Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allāh before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?"
entries.originalHtml: Or [lest] you say, "It was only that our fathers associated [others in worship] with Allāh before, and we were but descendants after them. Then would You destroy us for what the falsifiers have done?"

entries.text: And thus do We [explain in] detail the verses, and perhaps they will return.
entries.originalHtml: And thus do We [explain in] detail the verses, and perhaps they will return.<sup foot_note=196340>1</sup>

entries.text: And recite to them, [O Muḥammad], the news of him to whom We gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators.
entries.originalHtml: And recite to them, [O Muḥammad], the news of him<sup foot_note=196342>1</sup> to whom We gave [knowledge of] Our signs, but he detached himself from them; so Satan pursued him, and he became of the deviators.<sup foot_note=196341>2</sup>

entries.text: And if We had willed, We could have elevated him thereby, but he adhered [instead] to the earth and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs. So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.
entries.originalHtml: And if We had willed, We could have elevated him thereby,<sup foot_note=196345>1</sup> but he adhered [instead] to the earth<sup foot_note=196344>2</sup> and followed his own desire. So his example is like that of the dog: if you chase him, he pants, or if you leave him, he [still] pants. That is the example of the people who denied Our signs.<sup foot_note=196343>3</sup> So relate the stories that perhaps they will give thought.

entries.text: How evil an example [is that of] the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves.
entries.originalHtml: How evil an example [is that of] the people who denied Our signs and used to wrong themselves.

entries.text: Whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - it is those who are the losers.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever Allāh guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray<sup foot_note=196346>1</sup> - it is those who are the losers.

entries.text: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray. It is they who are the heedless.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly created for Hell many of the jinn and mankind. They have hearts with which they do not understand, they have eyes with which they do not see, and they have ears with which they do not hear. Those are like livestock; rather, they are more astray.<sup foot_note=196347>1</sup> It is they who are the heedless.

entries.text: And to Allāh belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names. They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belong the best names, so invoke Him by them. And leave [the company of] those who practice deviation concerning His names.<sup foot_note=196348>1</sup> They will be recompensed for what they have been doing.

entries.text: And among those We created is a community which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice.
entries.originalHtml: And among those We created is a community<sup foot_note=196349>1</sup> which guides by truth and thereby establishes justice.

entries.text: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction] from where they do not know.
entries.originalHtml: But those who deny Our signs - We will progressively lead them [to destruction]<sup foot_note=196350>1</sup> from where they do not know.

entries.text: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
entries.originalHtml: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

entries.text: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.
entries.originalHtml: Then do they not give thought? There is in their companion [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] no madness. He is not but a clear warner.

entries.text: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allāh has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement [i.e., message] hereafter will they believe?
entries.originalHtml: Do they not look into the realm of the heavens and the earth and everything that Allāh has created and [think] that perhaps their appointed time has come near? So in what statement [i.e., message] hereafter will they believe?

entries.text: Whoever Allāh sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever Allāh sends astray - there is no guide for him. And He leaves them in their transgression, wandering blindly.

entries.text: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival? Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allāh, but most of the people do not know."
entries.originalHtml: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?<sup foot_note=196352>1</sup> Say, "Its knowledge is only with my Lord. None will reveal its time except Him. It lays heavily<sup foot_note=196351>2</sup> upon the heavens and the earth. It will not come upon you except unexpectedly." They ask you as if you are familiar with it. Say, "Its knowledge is only with Allāh, but most of the people do not know."

entries.text: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allāh has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "I hold not for myself [the power of] benefit or harm, except what Allāh has willed. And if I knew the unseen, I could have acquired much wealth, and no harm would have touched me. I am not except a warner and a bringer of good tidings to a people who believe."

entries.text: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he might dwell in security with her. And when he [i.e., man] covers her, she carries a light burden [i.e., a pregnancy] and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allāh, their Lord, "If You should give us a good [child], we will surely be among the grateful."
entries.originalHtml: It is He who created you from one soul and created from it its mate that he<sup foot_note=196355>1</sup> might dwell in security with her. And when he [i.e., man] covers her,<sup foot_note=196354>2</sup> she carries a light burden [i.e., a pregnancy] and continues therein. And when it becomes heavy, they both invoke Allāh, their Lord, "If You should give us a good<sup foot_note=196353>3</sup> [child], we will surely be among the grateful."

entries.text: But when He gives them a good [child], they ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allāh above what they associate with Him.
entries.originalHtml: But when He gives them a good [child], they<sup foot_note=196356>1</sup> ascribe partners to Him concerning that which He has given them. Exalted is Allāh above what they associate with Him.

entries.text: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created?
entries.originalHtml: Do they associate with Him those who create nothing and they are [themselves] created?

entries.text: And they [i.e., the false deities] are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.
entries.originalHtml: And they [i.e., the false deities] are unable to [give] them help, nor can they help themselves.

entries.text: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent.
entries.originalHtml: And if you [believers] invite them to guidance, they will not follow you. It is all the same for you whether you invite them or you are silent.

entries.text: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allāh are servants [i.e., creations] like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those you [polytheists] call upon besides Allāh are servants [i.e., creations] like you. So call upon them and let them respond to you, if you should be truthful.

entries.text: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite.
entries.originalHtml: Do they have feet by which they walk? Or do they have hands by which they strike? Or do they have eyes by which they see? Or do they have ears by which they hear? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Call your 'partners' and then conspire against me and give me no respite.

entries.text: Indeed, my protector is Allāh, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, my protector is Allāh, who has sent down the Book; and He is an ally to the righteous.

entries.text: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves."
entries.originalHtml: And those you call upon besides Him are unable to help you, nor can they help themselves."

entries.text: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see.
entries.originalHtml: And if you invite them to guidance, they do not hear; and you see them looking at you while they do not see.

entries.text: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
entries.originalHtml: Take what is given freely,<sup foot_note=196357>1</sup> enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.

entries.text: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And if an evil suggestion comes to you from Satan, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: Indeed, those who fear Allāh - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who fear Allāh - when an impulse touches them from Satan, they remember [Him] and at once they have insight.

entries.text: But their brothers - they [i.e., the devils] increase them in error; then they do not stop short.
entries.originalHtml: But their brothers<sup foot_note=196358>1</sup> - they [i.e., the devils] increase them in error; then they do not stop short.

entries.text: And when you, [O Muḥammad], do not bring them a sign [i.e., miracle], they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."
entries.originalHtml: And when you, [O Muḥammad], do not bring them a sign [i.e., miracle], they say, "Why have you not contrived it?" Say, "I only follow what is revealed to me from my Lord. This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment from your Lord and guidance and mercy for a people who believe."

entries.text: So when the Qur’ān is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.
entries.originalHtml: So when the Qur’ān is recited, then listen to it and pay attention that you may receive mercy.

entries.text: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.
entries.originalHtml: And remember your Lord within yourself in humility and in fear without being apparent in speech - in the mornings and the evenings. And do not be among the heedless.

entries.text: Indeed, those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, and they exalt Him, and to Him they prostrate.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allāh and the Messenger." So fear Allāh and amend that which is between you and obey Allāh and His Messenger, if you should be believers.
entries.originalHtml: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the bounties [of war]. Say, "The [decision concerning] bounties is for Allāh and the Messenger." So fear Allāh and amend that which is between you and obey Allāh and His Messenger, if you should be believers.

entries.text: The believers are only those who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely -
entries.originalHtml: The believers are only those who, when Allāh is mentioned, their hearts become fearful, and when His verses are recited to them, it increases them in faith; and upon their Lord they rely -

entries.text: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
entries.originalHtml: The ones who establish prayer, and from what We have provided them, they spend.

entries.text: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the believers, truly. For them are degrees [of high position] with their Lord and forgiveness and noble provision.

entries.text: [It is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,
entries.originalHtml: [It<sup foot_note=196359>1</sup> is] just as when your Lord brought you out of your home [for the battle of Badr] in truth, while indeed, a party among the believers were unwilling,

entries.text: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.
entries.originalHtml: Arguing with you concerning the truth after it had become clear, as if they were being driven toward death while they were looking on.

entries.text: [Remember, O believers], when Allāh promised you one of the two groups - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allāh intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers
entries.originalHtml: [Remember, O believers], when Allāh promised you one of the two groups<sup foot_note=196360>1</sup> - that it would be yours - and you wished that the unarmed one would be yours. But Allāh intended to establish the truth by His words and to eliminate the disbelievers

entries.text: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
entries.originalHtml: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.

entries.text: [Remember] when you were asking help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."
entries.originalHtml: [Remember] when you were asking help of your Lord, and He answered you, "Indeed, I will reinforce you with a thousand from the angels, following one another."

entries.text: And Allāh made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh made it not but good tidings and so that your hearts would be assured thereby. And victory is not but from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.
entries.originalHtml: [Remember] when He overwhelmed you with drowsiness [giving] security from Him and sent down upon you from the sky, rain by which to purify you and remove from you the evil [suggestions] of Satan and to make steadfast your hearts and plant firmly thereby your feet.

entries.text: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."
entries.originalHtml: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."<sup foot_note=196361>1</sup>

entries.text: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh and His Messenger - indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
entries.originalHtml: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh and His Messenger - indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

entries.text: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.
entries.originalHtml: "That [is yours], so taste it." And indeed for the disbelievers is the punishment of the Fire.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when you meet those who disbelieve advancing [in battle], do not turn to them your backs [in flight].

entries.text: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allāh, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever turns his back to them on such a day, unless swerving [as a strategy] for war or joining [another] company, has certainly returned with anger [upon him] from Allāh, and his refuge is Hell - and wretched is the destination.

entries.text: And you did not kill them, but it was Allāh who killed them. And you threw not, [O Muḥammad], when you threw, but it was Allāh who threw that He might test the believers with a good test. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And you did not kill them, but it was Allāh who killed them.<sup foot_note=196364>1</sup> And you threw not, [O Muḥammad], when you threw, but it was Allāh who threw<sup foot_note=196363>2</sup> that He might test the believers with a good test.<sup foot_note=196362>3</sup> Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: That [is so], and [also] that Allāh will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: That [is so], and [also] that Allāh will weaken the plot of the disbelievers.

entries.text: If you [disbelievers] seek the decision [i.e., victory] - the decision [i.e., defeat] has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allāh is with the believers.
entries.originalHtml: If you [disbelievers] seek the decision [i.e., victory] - the decision [i.e., defeat] has come to you. And if you desist [from hostilities], it is best for you; but if you return [to war], We will return, and never will you be availed by your [large] company at all, even if it should increase; and [that is] because Allāh is with the believers.

entries.text: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and His Messenger and do not turn from him while you hear [his order].

entries.text: And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear.
entries.originalHtml: And do not be like those who say, "We have heard," while they do not hear.

entries.text: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason [i.e., the disbelievers].

entries.text: Had Allāh known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.
entries.originalHtml: Had Allāh known any good in them, He would have made them hear. And if He had made them hear, they would [still] have turned away, while they were refusing.

entries.text: O you who have believed, respond to Allāh and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allāh intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, respond to Allāh and to the Messenger when he calls you to that which gives you life. And know that Allāh intervenes between a man and his heart and that to Him you will be gathered.

entries.text: And fear a trial which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allāh is severe in penalty.
entries.originalHtml: And fear a trial<sup foot_note=196365>1</sup> which will not strike those who have wronged among you exclusively, and know that Allāh is severe in penalty.

entries.text: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.
entries.originalHtml: And remember when you were few and oppressed in the land, fearing that people might abduct you, but He sheltered you, supported you with His victory, and provided you with good things - that you might be grateful.

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not betray Allāh and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence].
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not betray Allāh and the Messenger or betray your trusts while you know [the consequence].

entries.text: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allāh has with Him a great reward.
entries.originalHtml: And know that your properties and your children are but a trial and that Allāh has with Him a great reward.

entries.text: O you who have believed, if you fear Allāh, He will grant you a criterion and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, if you fear Allāh, He will grant you a criterion<sup foot_note=196366>1</sup> and will remove from you your misdeeds and forgive you. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

entries.text: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allāh plans. And Allāh is the best of planners.
entries.originalHtml: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when those who disbelieved plotted against you to restrain you or kill you or evict you [from Makkah]. But they plan, and Allāh plans. And Allāh is the best of planners.

entries.text: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
entries.originalHtml: And when Our verses are recited to them, they say, "We have heard. If we willed, we could say [something] like this. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

entries.text: And [remember] when they said, "O Allāh, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."
entries.originalHtml: And [remember] when they said, "O Allāh, if this should be the truth from You, then rain down upon us stones from the sky or bring us a painful punishment."

entries.text: But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.
entries.originalHtml: But Allāh would not punish them while you, [O Muḥammad], are among them, and Allāh would not punish them while they seek forgiveness.

entries.text: But why should Allāh not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.
entries.originalHtml: But why should Allāh not punish them while they obstruct [people] from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and they were not [fit to be] its guardians? Its [true] guardians are not but the righteous, but most of them do not know.

entries.text: And their prayer at the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved [i.e., practiced of deviations].
entries.originalHtml: And their prayer at the House [i.e., the Kaʿbah] was not except whistling and handclapping. So taste the punishment for what you disbelieved [i.e., practiced of deviations].

entries.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allāh. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to avert [people] from the way of Allāh. So they will spend it; then it will be for them a [source of] regret; then they will be overcome. And those who have disbelieved - unto Hell they will be gathered.

entries.text: [It is] so that Allāh may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] so that Allāh may distinguish the wicked from the good and place the wicked some of them upon others and heap them all together and put them into Hell. It is those who are the losers.

entries.text: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.
entries.originalHtml: Say to those who have disbelieved [that] if they cease, what has previously occurred will be forgiven for them. But if they return [to hostility] - then the precedent of the former [rebellious] peoples has already taken place.<sup foot_note=196367>1</sup>

entries.text: And fight against them until there is no fitnah and [until] the religion [i.e., worship], all of it, is for Allāh. And if they cease - then indeed, Allāh is Seeing of what they do.
entries.originalHtml: And fight against them until there is no fitnah<sup foot_note=196369>1</sup> and [until] the religion [i.e., worship], all of it, is for Allāh.<sup foot_note=196368>2</sup> And if they cease - then indeed, Allāh is Seeing of what they do.

entries.text: But if they turn away - then know that Allāh is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
entries.originalHtml: But if they turn away - then know that Allāh is your protector. Excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

entries.text: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allāh is one fifth of it and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler, if you have believed in Allāh and in that which We sent down to Our Servant on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allāh, over all things, is competent.
entries.originalHtml: And know that anything you obtain of war booty - then indeed, for Allāh is one fifth of it and for the Messenger<sup foot_note=196373>1</sup> and for [his] near relatives<sup foot_note=196372>2</sup> and the orphans, the needy, and the [stranded] traveler,<sup foot_note=196371>3</sup> if you have believed in Allāh and in that which We sent down to Our Servant<sup foot_note=196370>4</sup> on the day of criterion [i.e., decisive encounter] - the day when the two armies met [at Badr]. And Allāh, over all things, is competent.

entries.text: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: [Remember] when you were on the near side of the valley, and they were on the farther side, and the caravan was lower [in position] than you. If you had made an appointment [to meet], you would have missed the appointment. But [it was] so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined - that those who perished [through disbelief] would perish upon evidence and those who lived [in faith] would live upon evidence; and indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: [Remember, O Muḥammad], when Allāh showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allāh saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
entries.originalHtml: [Remember, O Muḥammad], when Allāh showed them to you in your dream as few; and if He had shown them to you as many, you [believers] would have lost courage and would have disputed in the matter [of whether to fight], but Allāh saved [you from that]. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.text: And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allāh are [all] matters returned.
entries.originalHtml: And [remember] when He showed them to you, when you met, as few in your eyes, and He made you [appear] as few in their eyes so that Allāh might accomplish a matter already destined. And to Allāh are [all] matters returned.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allāh much that you may be successful.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when you encounter a company [from the enemy forces], stand firm and remember Allāh much that you may be successful.

entries.text: And obey Allāh and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.
entries.originalHtml: And obey Allāh and His Messenger, and do not dispute and [thus] lose courage and [then] your strength would depart; and be patient. Indeed, Allāh is with the patient.

entries.text: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allāh. And Allāh is encompassing of what they do.
entries.originalHtml: And do not be like those who came forth from their homes insolently and to be seen by people and avert [them] from the way of Allāh. And Allāh is encompassing<sup foot_note=196374>1</sup> of what they do.

entries.text: And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allāh. And Allāh is severe in penalty."
entries.originalHtml: And [remember] when Satan made their deeds pleasing to them and said, "No one can overcome you today from among the people, and indeed, I am your protector." But when the two armies sighted each other, he turned on his heels and said, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I see what you do not see; indeed, I fear Allāh. And Allāh is severe in penalty."

entries.text: [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease [i.e., arrogance and disbelief] said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: [Remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts was disease [i.e., arrogance and disbelief] said, "Their religion has deluded those [Muslims]." But whoever relies upon Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved... They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.
entries.originalHtml: And if you could but see when the angels take the souls of those who disbelieved...<sup foot_note=196375>1</sup> They are striking their faces and their backs and [saying], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire.

entries.text: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
entries.originalHtml: That is for what your hands have put forth [of evil] and because Allāh is not ever unjust to [His] servants."

entries.text: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allāh, so Allāh seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and severe in penalty.
entries.originalHtml: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They disbelieved in the signs of Allāh, so Allāh seized them for their sins. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and severe in penalty.

entries.text: That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: That is because Allāh would not change a favor which He had bestowed upon a people until they change what is within themselves. And indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and of those before them. They denied the signs of their Lord, so We destroyed them for their sins, and We drowned the people of Pharaoh. And all [of them] were wrongdoers.

entries.text: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe-
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allāh are those who have disbelieved, and they will not [ever] believe-

entries.text: The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: The ones with whom you made a treaty but then they break their pledge every time, and they do not fear Allāh.

entries.text: So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.
entries.originalHtml: So if you, [O Muḥammad], gain dominance over them in war, disperse by [means of] them those behind them that perhaps they will be reminded.<sup foot_note=196376>1</sup>

entries.text: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms. Indeed, Allāh does not like traitors.
entries.originalHtml: If you [have reason to] fear from a people betrayal, throw [their treaty] back to them, [putting you] on equal terms.<sup foot_note=196377>1</sup> Indeed, Allāh does not like traitors.

entries.text: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: And let not those who disbelieve think they will escape. Indeed, they will not cause failure [to Allāh].

entries.text: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war by which you may terrify the enemy of Allāh and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allāh knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allāh will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.
entries.originalHtml: And prepare against them whatever you are able of power and of steeds of war<sup foot_note=196378>1</sup> by which you may terrify the enemy of Allāh and your enemy and others besides them whom you do not know [but] whom Allāh knows. And whatever you spend in the cause of Allāh will be fully repaid to you, and you will not be wronged.

entries.text: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing.

entries.text: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allāh. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers
entries.originalHtml: But if they intend to deceive you - then sufficient for you is Allāh. It is He who supported you with His help and with the believers

entries.text: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allāh brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And brought together their hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have brought their hearts together; but Allāh brought them together. Indeed, He is Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, sufficient for you is Allāh and for whoever follows you of the believers.

entries.text: O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are steadfast], they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, urge the believers to battle. If there are among you twenty [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you one hundred [who are steadfast], they will overcome a thousand of those who have disbelieved because they are a people who do not understand.

entries.text: Now, Allāh has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the steadfast.
entries.originalHtml: Now, Allāh has lightened [the hardship] for you, and He knows that among you is weakness. So if there are from you one hundred [who are] steadfast, they will overcome two hundred. And if there are among you a thousand, they will overcome two thousand by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the steadfast.

entries.text: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allāh's enemies] in the land. You [i.e., some Muslims] desire the commodities of this world, but Allāh desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: It is not for a prophet to have captives [of war] until he inflicts a massacre [upon Allāh's enemies] in the land. You [i.e., some Muslims] desire the commodities of this world,<sup foot_note=196379>1</sup> but Allāh desires [for you] the Hereafter. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: If not for a decree from Allāh that preceded, you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment.
entries.originalHtml: If not for a decree from Allāh that preceded,<sup foot_note=196380>1</sup> you would have been touched for what you took by a great punishment.

entries.text: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: So consume what you have taken of war booty [as being] lawful and good, and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allāh knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, say to whoever is in your hands of the captives, "If Allāh knows [any] good in your hearts, He will give you [something] better than what was taken from you, and He will forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."

entries.text: But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allāh before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: But if they intend to betray you - then they have already betrayed Allāh before, and He empowered [you] over them. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who have believed and emigrated and fought with their wealth and lives in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - they are allies of one another. But those who believed and did not emigrate - for you there is no support of them until they emigrate. And if they seek help of you for the religion, then you must help, except against a people between yourselves and whom is a treaty. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

entries.text: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so [i.e., ally yourselves with other believers], there will be fitnah [i.e., disbelief and oppression] on earth and great corruption.

entries.text: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
entries.originalHtml: But those who have believed and emigrated and fought in the cause of Allāh and those who gave shelter and aided - it is they who are the believers, truly. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

entries.text: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.
entries.originalHtml: And those who believed after [the initial emigration] and emigrated and fought with you - they are of you. But those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh.<sup foot_note=196381>1</sup> Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of all things.
