entries.text: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the clear Book.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Rā.<sup foot_note=196500>1</sup> These are the verses of the clear Book.

entries.text: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān<sup foot_note=196501>1</sup> that you might understand.

entries.text: We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.
entries.originalHtml: We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.

entries.text: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me."
entries.originalHtml: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father,<sup foot_note=196502>1</sup> "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me."

entries.text: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.

entries.text: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives [i.e., events or dreams] and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."
entries.originalHtml: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives [i.e., events or dreams] and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."

entries.text: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]
entries.originalHtml: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask, [such as]

entries.text: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.
entries.originalHtml: When they said, "Joseph and his brother<sup foot_note=196503>1</sup> are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.

entries.text: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance [i.e., attention] of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."
entries.originalHtml: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance [i.e., attention] of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."<sup foot_note=196504>1</sup>

entries.text: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]."
entries.originalHtml: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]."

entries.text: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?

entries.text: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians."
entries.originalHtml: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians."

entries.text: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."
entries.originalHtml: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."

entries.text: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers."

entries.text: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."
entries.originalHtml: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well...<sup foot_note=196505>1</sup> But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."

entries.text: And they came to their father at night, weeping.
entries.originalHtml: And they came to their father at night, weeping.

entries.text: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful."

entries.text: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allāh is the one sought for help against that which you describe."
entries.originalHtml: And they brought upon his shirt false blood.<sup foot_note=196506>1</sup> [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allāh is the one sought for help against that which you describe."

entries.text: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allāh was Knowing of what they did.
entries.originalHtml: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise;<sup foot_note=196507>1</sup> and Allāh was Knowing of what they did.

entries.text: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
entries.originalHtml: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.

entries.text: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.
entries.originalHtml: And the one from Egypt<sup foot_note=196508>1</sup> who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.

entries.text: And when he [i.e., Joseph] reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: And when he [i.e., Joseph] reached maturity, We gave him judgement and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.

entries.text: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."
entries.originalHtml: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh. Indeed, he<sup foot_note=196509>1</sup> is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."

entries.text: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof [i.e., sign] of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.
entries.originalHtml: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof [i.e., sign] of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.

entries.text: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment?"
entries.originalHtml: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment?"

entries.text: [Joseph] said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified, "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars.
entries.originalHtml: [Joseph] said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified, "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars.

entries.text: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."

entries.text: So when he [i.e., her husband] saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of your [i.e., women's] plan. Indeed, your plan is great [i.e., vehement].
entries.originalHtml: So when he [i.e., her husband] saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of your [i.e., women's] plan. Indeed, your plan is great [i.e., vehement].

entries.text: Joseph, ignore this. And, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful."
entries.originalHtml: Joseph, ignore this.<sup foot_note=196510>1</sup> And, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful."

entries.text: And women in the city said, "The wife of al-ʿAzeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. Indeed, we see her [to be] in clear error."
entries.originalHtml: And women in the city said, "The wife of al-ʿAzeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. Indeed, we see her [to be] in clear error."

entries.text: So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said [to Joseph], "Come out before them." And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands and said, "Perfect is Allāh! This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel."
entries.originalHtml: So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said [to Joseph], "Come out before them." And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands<sup foot_note=196512>1</sup> and said, "Perfect is Allāh!<sup foot_note=196511>2</sup> This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel."

entries.text: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."
entries.originalHtml: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."

entries.text: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."

entries.text: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

entries.text: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] should surely imprison him for a time.
entries.originalHtml: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs<sup foot_note=196514>1</sup> that he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] should surely imprison him for a time.<sup foot_note=196513>2</sup>

entries.text: And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing [grapes for] wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."
entries.originalHtml: And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing [grapes for] wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."

entries.text: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allāh, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allāh, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers.

entries.text: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. And it was not for us to associate anything with Allāh. That is from the favor of Allāh upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful.
entries.originalHtml: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. And it was not for us to associate anything with Allāh. That is from the favor of Allāh upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful.

entries.text: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allāh, the One, the Prevailing?
entries.originalHtml: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allāh, the One,<sup foot_note=196516>1</sup> the Prevailing?<sup foot_note=196515>2</sup>

entries.text: You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allāh has sent down no evidence. Legislation is not but for Allāh. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
entries.originalHtml: You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them,<sup foot_note=196517>1</sup> you and your fathers, for which Allāh has sent down no evidence. Legislation is not but for Allāh. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

entries.text: O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire."
entries.originalHtml: O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire."

entries.text: And he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "Mention me before your master." But Satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and he [i.e., Joseph] remained in prison several years.
entries.originalHtml: And he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "Mention me before your master." But Satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and he [i.e., Joseph] remained in prison several years.

entries.text: And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions."
entries.originalHtml: And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions."

entries.text: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."

entries.text: But the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth."
entries.originalHtml: But the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth."

entries.text: [He said], "Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people [i.e., the king and his court]; perhaps they will know [about you]."
entries.originalHtml: [He said], "Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people [i.e., the king and his court]; perhaps they will know [about you]."

entries.text: [Joseph] said, "You will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat.
entries.originalHtml: [Joseph] said, "You will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat.

entries.text: Then will come after that seven difficult [years] which will consume what you advanced [i.e., saved] for them, except a little from which you will store.
entries.originalHtml: Then will come after that seven difficult [years] which will consume what you advanced [i.e., saved] for them, except a little from which you will store.

entries.text: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."
entries.originalHtml: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."

entries.text: And the king said, "Bring him to me." But when the messenger came to him, [Joseph] said, "Return to your master and ask him what is the case of the women who cut their hands. Indeed, my Lord is Knowing of their plan."
entries.originalHtml: And the king said, "Bring him to me." But when the messenger came to him, [Joseph] said, "Return to your master and ask him what is the case of the women who cut their hands. Indeed, my Lord is Knowing of their plan."

entries.text: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful.
entries.originalHtml: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh!<sup foot_note=196518>1</sup> We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful.

entries.text: That is so he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] will know that I did not betray him in [his] absence and that Allāh does not guide the plan of betrayers.
entries.originalHtml: That is so he [i.e., al-ʿAzeez] will know that I did not betray him in [his] absence and that Allāh does not guide the plan of betrayers.

entries.text: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."<sup foot_note=196519>1</sup>

entries.text: And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted."
entries.originalHtml: And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted."

entries.text: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."
entries.originalHtml: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."

entries.text: And thus We established Joseph in the land to settle therein wherever he willed. We touch with Our mercy whom We will, and We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
entries.originalHtml: And thus We established Joseph in the land to settle therein wherever he willed. We touch with Our mercy whom We will, and We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

entries.text: And the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: And the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing Allāh.

entries.text: And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.
entries.originalHtml: And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.<sup foot_note=196520>1</sup>

entries.text: And when he had furnished them with their supplies, he said, "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do you not see that I give full measure and that I am the best of accommodators?
entries.originalHtml: And when he had furnished them with their supplies, he said, "Bring me a brother of yours from your father.<sup foot_note=196521>1</sup> Do you not see that I give full measure and that I am the best of accommodators?

entries.text: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."
entries.originalHtml: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."

entries.text: They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]."

entries.text: And [Joseph] said to his servants, "Put their merchandise into their saddlebags so they might recognize it when they have gone back to their people that perhaps they will [again] return."
entries.originalHtml: And [Joseph] said to his servants, "Put their merchandise<sup foot_note=196522>1</sup> into their saddlebags so they might recognize it when they have gone back to their people that perhaps they will [again] return."

entries.text: So when they returned to their father, they said, "O our father, [further] measure has been denied to us, so send with us our brother [that] we will be given measure. And indeed, we will be his guardians."
entries.originalHtml: So when they returned to their father, they said, "O our father, [further] measure has been denied to us, so send with us our brother [that] we will be given measure. And indeed, we will be his guardians."

entries.text: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allāh is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allāh is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."

entries.text: And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. And we will obtain supplies [i.e., food] for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement."
entries.originalHtml: And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. And we will obtain supplies [i.e., food] for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement."<sup foot_note=196523>1</sup>

entries.text: [Jacob] said, "Never will I send him with you until you give me a promise [i.e., oath] by Allāh that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded [i.e., overcome by enemies]." And when they had given their promise, he said, "Allāh, over what we say, is Entrusted."
entries.originalHtml: [Jacob] said, "Never will I send him with you until you give me a promise [i.e., oath] by Allāh that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded [i.e., overcome by enemies]." And when they had given their promise, he said, "Allāh, over what we say, is Entrusted."<sup foot_note=196524>1</sup>

entries.text: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against [the decree of] Allāh at all. The decision is only for Allāh; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
entries.originalHtml: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against [the decree of] Allāh at all. The decision is only for Allāh; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let those who would rely [indeed] rely."

entries.text: And when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against Allāh at all except [it was] a need [i.e., concern] within the soul of Jacob, which he satisfied. And indeed, he was a possessor of knowledge because of what We had taught him, but most of the people do not know.
entries.originalHtml: And when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against Allāh at all except [it was] a need [i.e., concern] within the soul of Jacob, which he satisfied. And indeed, he was a possessor of knowledge because of what We had taught him, but most of the people do not know.

entries.text: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his brother to himself; he said, "Indeed, I am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do [to me]."
entries.originalHtml: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his brother to himself; he said, "Indeed, I am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do [to me]."

entries.text: So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves."
entries.originalHtml: So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves."

entries.text: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"
entries.originalHtml: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"

entries.text: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."

entries.text: They said, "By Allāh, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "By Allāh, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves."

entries.text: They [the accusers] said, "Then what would be its recompense if you should be liars?"
entries.originalHtml: They [the accusers] said, "Then what would be its recompense<sup foot_note=196525>1</sup> if you should be liars?"

entries.text: [The brothers] said, "Its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense. Thus do we recompense the wrongdoers."
entries.originalHtml: [The brothers] said, "Its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense.<sup foot_note=196526>1</sup> Thus do we recompense the wrongdoers."

entries.text: So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion [i.e., law] of the king except that Allāh willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.
entries.originalHtml: So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion [i.e., law] of the king except that Allāh willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.<sup foot_note=196527>1</sup>

entries.text: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them. He said, "You are worse in position, and Allāh is most knowing of what you describe."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them.<sup foot_note=196528>1</sup> He said, "You are worse in position, and Allāh is most knowing of what you describe."

entries.text: They said, "O ʿAzeez, indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O ʿAzeez,<sup foot_note=196529>1</sup> indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good."

entries.text: He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allāh [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust."

entries.text: So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allāh and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] Joseph? So I will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or Allāh decides for me, and He is the best of judges.
entries.originalHtml: So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allāh and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] Joseph? So I will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or Allāh decides for me,<sup foot_note=196530>1</sup> and He is the best of judges.

entries.text: Return to your father and say, 'O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen.
entries.originalHtml: Return to your father and say, 'O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen.<sup foot_note=196531>1</sup>

entries.text: And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful.'"
entries.originalHtml: And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful.'"

entries.text: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allāh will bring them to me all together. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise."
entries.originalHtml: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allāh will bring them to me all together. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise."

entries.text: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.
entries.originalHtml: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white<sup foot_note=196533>1</sup> from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.<sup foot_note=196532>2</sup>

entries.text: They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish."

entries.text: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.

entries.text: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."
entries.originalHtml: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allāh. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allāh except the disbelieving people."

entries.text: So when they entered upon him [i.e., Joseph], they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allāh rewards the charitable."
entries.originalHtml: So when they entered upon him [i.e., Joseph], they said, "O ʿAzeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allāh rewards the charitable."

entries.text: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"

entries.text: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said, "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allāh has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allāh and is patient, then indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said, "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allāh has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allāh and is patient, then indeed, Allāh does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."

entries.text: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners."

entries.text: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allāh forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. May Allāh forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.

entries.text: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."
entries.originalHtml: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."

entries.text: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said, "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind."
entries.originalHtml: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said,<sup foot_note=196534>1</sup> "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind."

entries.text: They said, "By Allāh, indeed you are in your [same] old error."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "By Allāh, indeed you are in your [same] old error."

entries.text: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?"
entries.originalHtml: And when the bearer of good tidings<sup foot_note=196535>1</sup> arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?"

entries.text: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners."

entries.text: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

entries.text: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself [i.e., embraced them] and said, "Enter Egypt, Allāh willing, safe [and secure]."
entries.originalHtml: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself [i.e., embraced them] and said, "Enter Egypt, Allāh willing, safe [and secure]."

entries.text: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration.<sup foot_note=196537>1</sup> And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle<sup foot_note=196536>2</sup> in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise.

entries.text: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."
entries.originalHtml: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

entries.text: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.
entries.originalHtml: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muḥammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.

entries.text: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.
entries.originalHtml: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.

entries.text: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.

entries.text: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.
entries.originalHtml: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.

entries.text: And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.
entries.originalHtml: And most of them believe not in Allāh except while they associate others with Him.

entries.text: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?
entries.originalHtml: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allāh or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?

entries.text: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allāh with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allāh; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allāh with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allāh; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."

entries.text: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh; then will you not reason?
entries.originalHtml: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they<sup foot_note=196538>1</sup> not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allāh; then will you not reason?

entries.text: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.
entries.originalHtml: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.

entries.text: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
entries.originalHtml: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

entries.text: Alif, Lām, Meem, Rā. These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Meem, Rā.<sup foot_note=196539>1</sup> These are the verses of the Book; and what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth, but most of the people do not believe.

entries.text: It is Allāh who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne and made subject the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who erected the heavens without pillars that you [can] see; then He established Himself above the Throne<sup foot_note=196541>1</sup> and made subject<sup foot_note=196540>2</sup> the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. He arranges [each] matter; He details the signs that you may, of the meeting with your Lord, be certain.

entries.text: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who spread the earth and placed therein firmly set mountains and rivers; and from all of the fruits He made therein two mates; He causes the night to cover the day. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

entries.text: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise, watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
entries.originalHtml: And within the land are neighboring plots and gardens of grapevines and crops and palm trees, [growing] several from a root or otherwise,<sup foot_note=196542>1</sup> watered with one water; but We make some of them exceed others in [quality of] fruit. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

entries.text: And if you are astonished, [O Muḥammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: And if you are astonished,<sup foot_note=196544>1</sup> [O Muḥammad] - then astonishing is their saying, "When we are dust, will we indeed be [brought] into a new creation?" Those are the ones who have disbelieved in their Lord, and those will have shackles<sup foot_note=196543>2</sup> upon their necks, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good, while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.
entries.originalHtml: They impatiently urge you to bring about evil before good,<sup foot_note=196545>1</sup> while there has already occurred before them similar punishments [to what they demand]. And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of forgiveness for the people despite their wrongdoing, and indeed, your Lord is severe in penalty.

entries.text: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" You are only a warner, and for every people is a guide.

entries.text: Allāh knows what every female carries and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed. And everything with Him is by due measure.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh knows what every female carries<sup foot_note=196547>1</sup> and what the wombs lose [prematurely] or exceed.<sup foot_note=196546>2</sup> And everything with Him is by due measure.

entries.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
entries.originalHtml: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

entries.text: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.
entries.originalHtml: It is the same [to Him] concerning you whether one conceals [his] speech or publicizes it and whether one is hidden by night or conspicuous [among others] by day.

entries.text: For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels] before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill, there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.
entries.originalHtml: For him [i.e., each one] are successive [angels]<sup foot_note=196550>1</sup> before and behind him who protect him by the decree of Allāh.<sup foot_note=196549>2</sup> Indeed, Allāh will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves. And when Allāh intends for a people ill,<sup foot_note=196548>3</sup> there is no repelling it. And there is not for them besides Him any patron.

entries.text: It is He who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who shows you lightning, [causing] fear and aspiration, and generates the heavy clouds.

entries.text: And the thunder exalts [Allāh] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.
entries.originalHtml: And the thunder exalts [Allāh] with praise of Him - and the angels [as well] from fear of Him - and He sends thunderbolts and strikes therewith whom He wills while they dispute about Allāh; and He is severe in assault.

entries.text: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus]. And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].
entries.originalHtml: To Him [alone] is the supplication of truth. And those they call upon besides Him do not respond to them with a thing, except as one who stretches his hands toward water [from afar, calling it] to reach his mouth, but it will not reach it [thus].<sup foot_note=196551>1</sup> And the supplication of the disbelievers is not but in error [i.e., futility].

entries.text: And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.

entries.text: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allāh." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allāh partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allāh." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allāh partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?"<sup foot_note=196553>1</sup> Say, "Allāh is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."<sup foot_note=196552>2</sup>

entries.text: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allāh presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allāh present examples.
entries.originalHtml: He sends down from the sky, rain, and valleys flow according to their capacity, and the torrent carries a rising foam. And from that [ore] which they heat in the fire, desiring adornments and utensils, is a foam like it. Thus Allāh presents [the example of] truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it vanishes, [being] cast off; but as for that which benefits the people, it remains on the earth. Thus does Allāh present examples.

entries.text: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.
entries.originalHtml: For those who have responded to their Lord is the best [reward], but those who did not respond to Him - if they had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby. Those will have the worst account, and their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place.

entries.text: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -
entries.originalHtml: Then is he who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth like one who is blind? They will only be reminded who are people of understanding -

entries.text: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,
entries.originalHtml: Those who fulfill the covenant of Allāh and do not break the contract,

entries.text: And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,
entries.originalHtml: And those who join that which Allāh has ordered to be joined<sup foot_note=196554>1</sup> and fear their Lord and are afraid of the evil of [their] account,

entries.text: And those who are patient, seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home -
entries.originalHtml: And those who are patient, seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of their Lord, and establish prayer and spend from what We have provided for them secretly and publicly and prevent evil with good - those will have the good consequence of [this] home<sup foot_note=196555>1</sup> -

entries.text: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],
entries.originalHtml: Gardens of perpetual residence; they will enter them with whoever were righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their descendants. And the angels will enter upon them from every gate, [saying],

entries.text: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."
entries.originalHtml: "Peace [i.e., security] be upon you for what you patiently endured. And excellent is the final home."

entries.text: But those who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.
entries.originalHtml: But those who break the covenant of Allāh after contracting it and sever that which Allāh has ordered to be joined and spread corruption on earth - for them is the curse, and they will have the worst home.<sup foot_note=196556>1</sup>

entries.text: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. And they rejoice in the worldly life, while the worldly life is not, compared to the Hereafter, except [brief] enjoyment.

entries.text: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, Allāh leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him] -
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieved say, "Why has a sign not been sent down to him from his Lord?" Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, Allāh leaves astray whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him] -

entries.text: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."
entries.originalHtml: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured."

entries.text: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.
entries.originalHtml: Those who have believed and done righteous deeds - a good state is theirs and a good return.

entries.text: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."
entries.originalHtml: Thus have We sent you to a community before which [other] communities have passed on so you might recite to them that which We revealed to you, while they disbelieve in the Most Merciful. Say, "He is my Lord; there is no deity except Him. Upon Him I rely, and to Him is my return."

entries.text: And if there was any Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak, [it would be this Qur’ān], but to Allāh belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allāh willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.
entries.originalHtml: And if there was any Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] by which the mountains would be removed or the earth would be broken apart or the dead would be made to speak,<sup foot_note=196557>1</sup> [it would be this Qur’ān], but to Allāh belongs the affair entirely. Then have those who believed not accepted that had Allāh willed, He would have guided the people, all of them? And those who disbelieve do not cease to be struck, for what they have done, by calamity - or it will descend near their home - until there comes the promise of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh does not fail in [His] promise.

entries.text: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
entries.originalHtml: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.

entries.text: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?" Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.
entries.originalHtml: Then is He who is a maintainer of every soul, [knowing] what it has earned, [like any other]? But to Allāh they have attributed partners. Say, "Name them. Or do you inform Him of that<sup foot_note=196559>1</sup> which He knows not upon the earth or of what is apparent [i.e., alleged] of speech?"<sup foot_note=196558>2</sup> Rather, their [own] plan has been made attractive to those who disbelieve, and they have been averted from the way. And whomever Allāh sends astray - there will be for him no guide.

entries.text: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allāh any protector.
entries.originalHtml: For them will be punishment in the life of [this] world, and the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe. And they will not have from Allāh any protector.

entries.text: The example [i.e., description] of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.
entries.originalHtml: The example [i.e., description] of Paradise, which the righteous have been promised, is [that] beneath it rivers flow. Its fruit is lasting, and its shade. That is the consequence for the righteous, and the consequence for the disbelievers is the Fire.

entries.text: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allāh and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return."
entries.originalHtml: And [the believers among] those to whom We have given the [previous] Scripture rejoice at what has been revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], but among the [opposing] factions are those who deny part of it [i.e., the Qur’ān]. Say, "I have only been commanded to worship Allāh and not associate [anything] with Him. To Him I invite, and to Him is my return."

entries.text: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation. And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allāh any ally or any protector.
entries.originalHtml: And thus We have revealed it as an Arabic legislation.<sup foot_note=196560>1</sup> And if you should follow their inclinations after what has come to you of knowledge, you would not have against Allāh any ally or any protector.

entries.text: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allāh. For every term is a decree.
entries.originalHtml: And We have already sent messengers before you and assigned to them wives and descendants. And it was not for a messenger to come with a sign except by permission of Allāh. For every term is a decree.

entries.text: Allāh eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.<sup foot_note=196561>1</sup>

entries.text: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account.
entries.originalHtml: And whether We show you part of what We promise them or take you in death, upon you is only the [duty of] notification, and upon Us is the account.

entries.text: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? And Allāh decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account.
entries.originalHtml: Have they not seen that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders?<sup foot_note=196562>1</sup> And Allāh decides; there is no adjuster of His decision. And He is swift in account.

entries.text: And those before them had plotted, but to Allāh belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home.
entries.originalHtml: And those before them had plotted, but to Allāh belongs the plan entirely. He knows what every soul earns, and the disbelievers will know for whom is the final home.

entries.text: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muḥammad], "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture."
entries.originalHtml: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muḥammad], "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture."<sup foot_note=196563>1</sup>

entries.text: Alif, Lām, Rā. [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Rā.<sup foot_note=196564>1</sup> [This is] a Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that you might bring mankind out of darknesses into the light by permission of their Lord - to the path of the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy -

entries.text: Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe [i.e., destruction] to the disbelievers from a severe punishment -
entries.originalHtml: Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And woe [i.e., destruction] to the disbelievers from a severe punishment -

entries.text: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.
entries.originalHtml: The ones who prefer the worldly life over the Hereafter and avert [people] from the way of Allāh, seeking to make it [seem] deviant. Those are in extreme error.

entries.text: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allāh sends astray [thereby] whom He wills<sup foot_note=196565>1</sup> and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days of Allāh." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
entries.originalHtml: And We certainly sent Moses with Our signs, [saying], "Bring out your people from darknesses into the light and remind them of the days<sup foot_note=196566>1</sup> of Allāh." Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

entries.text: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to his people, "Remember the favor of Allāh upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
entries.originalHtml: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to his people, "Remember the favor of Allāh upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.

entries.text: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'"
entries.originalHtml: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favor]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.'"

entries.text: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy."
entries.originalHtml: And Moses said, "If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy."

entries.text: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them? No one knows them [i.e., their number] but Allāh. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
entries.originalHtml: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them? No one knows them [i.e., their number] but Allāh. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths<sup foot_note=196567>1</sup> and said, "Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."

entries.text: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allāh, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays you [i.e., your death] for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority [i.e., evidence]."
entries.originalHtml: Their messengers said, "Can there be doubt about Allāh, Creator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays you [i.e., your death] for a specified term." They said, "You are not but men like us who wish to avert us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority [i.e., evidence]."

entries.text: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allāh confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
entries.originalHtml: Their messengers said to them, "We are only men like you, but Allāh confers favor upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

entries.text: And why should we not rely upon Allāh while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allāh let those who would rely [indeed] rely."
entries.originalHtml: And why should we not rely upon Allāh while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon Allāh let those who would rely [indeed] rely."

entries.text: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, "We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion." So their Lord inspired to them, "We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.

entries.text: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat."
entries.originalHtml: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position<sup foot_note=196568>1</sup> and fears My threat."

entries.text: And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
entries.originalHtml: And they requested decision [i.e., victory from Allāh], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.

entries.text: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.
entries.originalHtml: Before him<sup foot_note=196570>1</sup> is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.<sup foot_note=196569>2</sup>

entries.text: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.
entries.originalHtml: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.

entries.text: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.
entries.originalHtml: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.

entries.text: Have you not seen [i.e., considered] that Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.
entries.originalHtml: Have you not seen [i.e., considered] that Allāh created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.

entries.text: And that is not difficult for Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: And that is not difficult for Allāh.

entries.text: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allāh all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allāh?" They will say, "If Allāh had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."
entries.originalHtml: And they will come out [for judgement] before Allāh all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, "Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of Allāh?" They will say, "If Allāh had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape."

entries.text: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allāh had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allāh] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."
entries.originalHtml: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, "Indeed, Allāh had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with Allāh] before.<sup foot_note=196571>1</sup> Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment."

entries.text: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"
entries.originalHtml: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, "Peace!"

entries.text: Have you not considered how Allāh presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered how Allāh presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?

entries.text: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allāh presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
entries.originalHtml: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And Allāh presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.

entries.text: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
entries.originalHtml: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.

entries.text: Allāh keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And Allāh sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allāh does what He wills.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word,<sup foot_note=196573>1</sup> in worldly life and in the Hereafter.<sup foot_note=196572>2</sup> And Allāh sends astray the wrongdoers. And Allāh does what He wills.

entries.text: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allāh for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favor of Allāh for disbelief<sup foot_note=196574>1</sup> and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?

entries.text: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.

entries.text: And they have attributed to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."
entries.originalHtml: And they have attributed to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire."

entries.text: [O Muḥammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.
entries.originalHtml: [O Muḥammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.

entries.text: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you<sup foot_note=196575>1</sup> the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.

entries.text: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
entries.originalHtml: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.

entries.text: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favor [i.e., blessings] of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
