entries.text: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.

entries.text: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh, if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
entries.originalHtml: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse<sup foot_note=196880>1</sup> - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes,<sup foot_note=196879>2</sup> and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh,<sup foot_note=196878>3</sup> if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.

entries.text: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.
entries.originalHtml: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator<sup foot_note=196881>1</sup> or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.

entries.text: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
entries.originalHtml: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,

entries.text: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.
entries.originalHtml: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them<sup foot_note=196882>1</sup> [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.

entries.text: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.
entries.originalHtml: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.

entries.text: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.
entries.originalHtml: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.

entries.text: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.
entries.originalHtml: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.

entries.text: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy...<sup foot_note=196883>1</sup> and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.

entries.text: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who came with falsehood<sup foot_note=196885>1</sup> are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof<sup foot_note=196884>2</sup> - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].

entries.text: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
entries.originalHtml: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?

entries.text: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.
entries.originalHtml: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.

entries.text: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
entries.originalHtml: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment

entries.text: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.
entries.originalHtml: When you received it with your tongues<sup foot_note=196886>1</sup> and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.

entries.text: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?
entries.originalHtml: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?

entries.text: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.

entries.text: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows and you do not know.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who like that immorality<sup foot_note=196888>1</sup> should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows<sup foot_note=196887>2</sup> and you do not know.

entries.text: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy...<sup foot_note=196889>1</sup> and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment

entries.text: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

entries.text: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].
entries.originalHtml: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].

entries.text: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
entries.originalHtml: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words.<sup foot_note=196890>1</sup> Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet<sup foot_note=196891>1</sup> their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].

entries.text: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back,"<sup foot_note=196892>1</sup> then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.

entries.text: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
entries.originalHtml: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience<sup foot_note=196893>1</sup> for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.

entries.text: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.
entries.originalHtml: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision<sup foot_note=196895>1</sup> and guard their private parts.<sup foot_note=196894>2</sup> That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.

entries.text: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
entries.originalHtml: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision<sup foot_note=196899>1</sup> and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment<sup foot_note=196898>2</sup> except that which [necessarily] appears thereof<sup foot_note=196897>3</sup> and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire,<sup foot_note=196896>4</sup> or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.

entries.text: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, Allāh will enrich them from His bounty, and Allāh is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

entries.text: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until Allāh enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess<sup foot_note=196900>1</sup> - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of Allāh which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, Allāh is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses<sup foot_note=196901>1</sup> and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear Allāh.

entries.text: Allāh is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp; the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh is the Light<sup foot_note=196904>1</sup> of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light<sup foot_note=196903>2</sup> is like a niche within which is a lamp;<sup foot_note=196902>3</sup> the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allāh guides to His light whom He wills. And Allāh presents examples for the people, and Allāh is Knowing of all things.

entries.text: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings
entries.originalHtml: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which Allāh has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned [i.e., praised] therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings<sup foot_note=196905>1</sup>

entries.text: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -
entries.originalHtml: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of Allāh and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -

entries.text: That Allāh may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allāh gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].
entries.originalHtml: That Allāh may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And Allāh gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].

entries.text: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allāh before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allāh is swift in account.
entries.originalHtml: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allāh before him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allāh is swift in account.

entries.text: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allāh has not granted light - for him there is no light.
entries.originalHtml: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom Allāh has not granted light - for him there is no light.

entries.text: Do you not see that Allāh is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allāh is Knowing of what they do.
entries.originalHtml: Do you not see that Allāh is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and Allāh is Knowing of what they do.

entries.text: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to Allāh is the destination.

entries.text: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.
entries.originalHtml: Do you not see that Allāh drives clouds? Then He brings them together; then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightning almost takes away the eyesight.

entries.text: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.

entries.text: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. Allāh creates what He wills. Indeed, Allāh is over all things competent.

entries.text: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And Allāh guides whom He wills to a straight path.

entries.text: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.
entries.originalHtml: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, "We have believed in Allāh and in the Messenger, and we obey"; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not believers.

entries.text: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].
entries.originalHtml: And when they are called to [the words of] Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].

entries.text: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
entries.originalHtml: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.

entries.text: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].
entries.originalHtml: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that Allāh will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].

entries.text: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.
entries.originalHtml: The only statement of the [true] believers when they are called to Allāh and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, "We hear and we obey." And those are the successful.

entries.text: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger and fears Allāh and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.

entries.text: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."
entries.originalHtml: And they swear by Allāh their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in Allāh's cause]. Say, "Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known.<sup foot_note=196906>1</sup> Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of that which you do."

entries.text: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility for] clear notification."

entries.text: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves<sup foot_note=196907>1</sup> after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
entries.originalHtml: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.

entries.text: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
entries.originalHtml: Never think that the disbelievers are causing failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.

entries.text: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy<sup foot_note=196908>1</sup> for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses; and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.
entries.originalHtml: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame constraint nor upon the ill constraint nor upon yourselves when you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your father's brothers or the houses of your father's sisters or the houses of your mother's brothers or the houses of your mother's sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace<sup foot_note=196909>1</sup> upon each other - a greeting from Allāh, blessed and good. Thus does Allāh make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.

entries.text: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: The believers are only those who believe in Allāh and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muḥammad] - those are the ones who believe in Allāh and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission due to something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already Allāh knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet's] order,<sup foot_note=196911>1</sup> lest fitnah<sup foot_note=196910>2</sup> strike them or a painful punishment.

entries.text: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
entries.originalHtml: Unquestionably, to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand]<sup foot_note=196913>1</sup> and [knows] the Day<sup foot_note=196912>2</sup> when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

entries.text: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
entries.originalHtml: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -

entries.text: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
entries.originalHtml: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.

entries.text: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
entries.originalHtml: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.

entries.text: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieve say, "This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it." But they have committed an injustice and a lie.

entries.text: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon."

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful."

entries.text: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?

entries.text: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."
entries.originalHtml: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

entries.text: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
entries.originalHtml: Look how they strike for you comparisons;<sup foot_note=196914>1</sup> but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

entries.text: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
entries.originalHtml: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

entries.text: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
entries.originalHtml: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

entries.text: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
entries.originalHtml: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

entries.text: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
entries.originalHtml: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

entries.text: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."
entries.originalHtml: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

entries.text: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

entries.text: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
entries.originalHtml: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.<sup foot_note=196915>1</sup>

entries.text: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

entries.text: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

entries.text: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
entries.originalHtml: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say,<sup foot_note=196917>1</sup> and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice<sup foot_note=196916>2</sup> among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.

entries.text: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

entries.text: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
entries.originalHtml: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves<sup foot_note=196918>1</sup> and [become] insolent with great insolence.

entries.text: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."
entries.originalHtml: The day they see the angels<sup foot_note=196920>1</sup> - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."<sup foot_note=196919>2</sup>

entries.text: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
entries.originalHtml: And We will approach [i.e., regard]<sup foot_note=196921>1</sup> what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

entries.text: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
entries.originalHtml: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

entries.text: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds,<sup foot_note=196922>1</sup> and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

entries.text: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
entries.originalHtml: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

entries.text: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
entries.originalHtml: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.<sup foot_note=196923>1</sup>

entries.text: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
entries.originalHtml: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one<sup foot_note=196924>1</sup> as a friend.

entries.text: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
entries.originalHtml: He led me away from the remembrance<sup foot_note=196926>1</sup> after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."<sup foot_note=196925>2</sup>

entries.text: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."
entries.originalHtml: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."<sup foot_note=196927>1</sup>

entries.text: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
entries.originalHtml: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

entries.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.<sup foot_note=196928>1</sup>

entries.text: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
entries.originalHtml: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

entries.text: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
entries.originalHtml: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

entries.text: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
entries.originalHtml: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.

entries.text: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
entries.originalHtml: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

entries.text: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers,<sup foot_note=196929>1</sup> We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

entries.text: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
entries.originalHtml: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well<sup foot_note=196930>1</sup> and many generations between them.

entries.text: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
entries.originalHtml: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.

entries.text: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
entries.originalHtml: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.<sup foot_note=196931>1</sup>

entries.text: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?
entries.originalHtml: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?

entries.text: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
entries.originalHtml: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.

entries.text: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
entries.originalHtml: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?

entries.text: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
entries.originalHtml: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock.<sup foot_note=196932>1</sup> Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

entries.text: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.<sup foot_note=196933>1</sup>

entries.text: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.
entries.originalHtml: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.<sup foot_note=196934>1</sup>

entries.text: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing<sup foot_note=196936>1</sup> and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.<sup foot_note=196935>2</sup>

entries.text: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water

entries.text: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
entries.originalHtml: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

entries.text: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded,<sup foot_note=196937>1</sup> but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

entries.text: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
entries.originalHtml: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.<sup foot_note=196938>1</sup>

entries.text: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
entries.originalHtml: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.

entries.text: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

entries.text: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

entries.text: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
entries.originalHtml: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

entries.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
entries.originalHtml: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

entries.text: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

entries.text: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -
entries.originalHtml: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -

entries.text: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].
entries.originalHtml: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne<sup foot_note=196939>1</sup> - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.

entries.text: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
entries.originalHtml: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.

entries.text: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

entries.text: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
entries.originalHtml: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily,<sup foot_note=196941>1</sup> and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,<sup foot_note=196940>2</sup>

entries.text: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
entries.originalHtml: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

entries.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
entries.originalHtml: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;

entries.text: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

entries.text: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
entries.originalHtml: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

entries.text: And those who do not invoke with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
entries.originalHtml: And those who do not invoke<sup foot_note=196942>1</sup> with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

entries.text: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
entries.originalHtml: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

entries.text: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.
entries.originalHtml: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.

entries.text: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
entries.originalHtml: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

entries.text: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
entries.originalHtml: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

entries.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."
entries.originalHtml: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes<sup foot_note=196943>1</sup> and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."

entries.text: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
entries.originalHtml: Those will be awarded the Chamber<sup foot_note=196944>1</sup> for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,

entries.text: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
entries.originalHtml: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

entries.text: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?"<sup foot_note=196946>1</sup> For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.<sup foot_note=196945>2</sup>
