entries.text: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.<sup foot_note=196947>1</sup>

entries.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.
entries.originalHtml: These are the verses of the clear Book.

entries.text: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

entries.text: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
entries.originalHtml: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.<sup foot_note=196948>1</sup>

entries.text: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
entries.originalHtml: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

entries.text: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
entries.originalHtml: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

entries.text: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
entries.originalHtml: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

entries.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

entries.text: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"
entries.originalHtml: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"

entries.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

entries.text: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
entries.originalHtml: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

entries.text: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
entries.originalHtml: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

entries.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
entries.originalHtml: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers<sup foot_note=196949>1</sup> of the Lord of the worlds,

entries.text: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
entries.originalHtml: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

entries.text: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
entries.originalHtml: And [then] you did your deed which you did,<sup foot_note=196950>1</sup> and you were of the ungrateful."

entries.text: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].

entries.text: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
entries.originalHtml: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

entries.text: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
entries.originalHtml: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

entries.text: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
entries.originalHtml: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

entries.text: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

entries.text: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said,<sup foot_note=196951>1</sup> "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

entries.text: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

entries.text: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

entries.text: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
entries.originalHtml: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.<sup foot_note=196952>1</sup>

entries.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
entries.originalHtml: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

entries.text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
entries.originalHtml: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

entries.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

entries.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
entries.originalHtml: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

entries.text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
entries.originalHtml: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.<sup foot_note=196953>1</sup>

entries.text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.
entries.originalHtml: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.

entries.text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
entries.originalHtml: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

entries.text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
entries.originalHtml: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

entries.text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

entries.text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
entries.originalHtml: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

entries.text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
entries.originalHtml: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

entries.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
entries.originalHtml: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

entries.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

entries.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

entries.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
entries.originalHtml: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

entries.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
entries.originalHtml: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

entries.text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

entries.text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

entries.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
entries.originalHtml: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

entries.text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
entries.originalHtml: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers<sup foot_note=196954>1</sup>

entries.text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
entries.originalHtml: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

entries.text: And indeed, they are enraging us,
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, they are enraging us,

entries.text: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."

entries.text: So We removed them from gardens and springs
entries.originalHtml: So We removed them from gardens and springs

entries.text: And treasures and honorable station -
entries.originalHtml: And treasures and honorable station<sup foot_note=196955>1</sup> -

entries.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
entries.originalHtml: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

entries.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.
entries.originalHtml: So they pursued them at sunrise.

entries.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
entries.originalHtml: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

entries.text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
entries.originalHtml: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

entries.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
entries.originalHtml: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

entries.text: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
entries.originalHtml: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].

entries.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
entries.originalHtml: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

entries.text: Then We drowned the others.
entries.originalHtml: Then We drowned the others.

entries.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
entries.originalHtml: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

entries.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
entries.originalHtml: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

entries.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

entries.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

entries.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
entries.originalHtml: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

entries.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

entries.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

entries.text: You and your ancient forefathers?
entries.originalHtml: You and your ancient forefathers?

entries.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,<sup foot_note=196956>1</sup>

entries.text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
entries.originalHtml: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

entries.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

entries.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
entries.originalHtml: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

entries.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
entries.originalHtml: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

entries.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
entries.originalHtml: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

entries.text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

entries.text: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
entries.originalHtml: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.

entries.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
entries.originalHtml: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

entries.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
entries.originalHtml: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

entries.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
entries.originalHtml: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

entries.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
entries.originalHtml: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

entries.text: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
entries.originalHtml: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

entries.text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

entries.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
entries.originalHtml: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

entries.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
entries.originalHtml: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

entries.text: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
entries.originalHtml: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

entries.text: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
entries.originalHtml: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

entries.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
entries.originalHtml: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

entries.text: They will say while they dispute therein,
entries.originalHtml: They will say while they dispute therein,

entries.text: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
entries.originalHtml: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

entries.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
entries.originalHtml: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

entries.text: So now we have no intercessors
entries.originalHtml: So now we have no intercessors

entries.text: And not a devoted friend.
entries.originalHtml: And not a devoted friend.

entries.text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."
entries.originalHtml: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."<sup foot_note=196957>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers
entries.originalHtml: The people of Noah denied the messengers<sup foot_note=196958>1</sup>

entries.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
entries.originalHtml: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

entries.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me."
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me."

entries.text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

entries.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
entries.originalHtml: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

entries.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
entries.originalHtml: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

entries.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
entries.originalHtml: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

entries.text: I am only a clear warner."
entries.originalHtml: I am only a clear warner."

entries.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

entries.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

entries.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
entries.originalHtml: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

entries.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
entries.originalHtml: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

entries.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
entries.originalHtml: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

entries.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: ʿAad denied the messengers
entries.originalHtml: ʿAad denied the messengers

entries.text: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
entries.originalHtml: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

entries.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
entries.originalHtml: Do you construct on every elevation a sign,<sup foot_note=196959>1</sup> amusing yourselves,

entries.text: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
entries.originalHtml: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?

entries.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
entries.originalHtml: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
entries.originalHtml: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

entries.text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
entries.originalHtml: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

entries.text: And gardens and springs.
entries.originalHtml: And gardens and springs.

entries.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

entries.text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

entries.text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
entries.originalHtml: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

entries.text: And we are not to be punished."
entries.originalHtml: And we are not to be punished."

entries.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: Thamūd denied the messengers
entries.originalHtml: Thamūd denied the messengers

entries.text: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
entries.originalHtml: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

entries.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
entries.originalHtml: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

entries.text: Within gardens and springs
entries.originalHtml: Within gardens and springs

entries.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
entries.originalHtml: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

entries.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
entries.originalHtml: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
entries.originalHtml: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

entries.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
entries.originalHtml: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

entries.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

entries.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

entries.text: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "This is a she-camel.<sup foot_note=196960>1</sup> For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

entries.text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
entries.originalHtml: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."

entries.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
entries.originalHtml: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

entries.text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers
entries.originalHtml: The people of Lot denied the messengers

entries.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
entries.originalHtml: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

entries.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Do you approach males among the worlds
entries.originalHtml: Do you approach males among the worlds<sup foot_note=196961>1</sup>

entries.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
entries.originalHtml: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."

entries.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."

entries.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

entries.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
entries.originalHtml: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

entries.text: So We saved him and his family, all,
entries.originalHtml: So We saved him and his family, all,

entries.text: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
entries.originalHtml: Except an old woman<sup foot_note=196962>1</sup> among those who remained behind.

entries.text: Then We destroyed the others.
entries.originalHtml: Then We destroyed the others.

entries.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
entries.originalHtml: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

entries.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers
entries.originalHtml: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers

entries.text: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
entries.originalHtml: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

entries.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

entries.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
entries.originalHtml: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.

entries.text: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
entries.originalHtml: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.

entries.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
entries.originalHtml: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.

entries.text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
entries.originalHtml: And fear He who created you and the former creation."<sup foot_note=196963>1</sup>

entries.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

entries.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
entries.originalHtml: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.

entries.text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."

entries.text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

entries.text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
entries.originalHtml: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.

entries.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
entries.originalHtml: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down

entries.text: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners -
entries.originalHtml: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners -

entries.text: In a clear Arabic language.
entries.originalHtml: In a clear Arabic language.

entries.text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

entries.text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
entries.originalHtml: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?

entries.text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
entries.originalHtml: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners<sup foot_note=196964>1</sup>

entries.text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
entries.originalHtml: And he had recited it to them [perfectly],<sup foot_note=196965>1</sup> they would [still] not have been believers in it.

entries.text: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
entries.originalHtml: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.

entries.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.

entries.text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
entries.originalHtml: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

entries.text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
entries.originalHtml: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

entries.text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
entries.originalHtml: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

entries.text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
entries.originalHtml: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

entries.text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
entries.originalHtml: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

entries.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
entries.originalHtml: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.

entries.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
entries.originalHtml: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners

entries.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
entries.originalHtml: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

entries.text: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
entries.originalHtml: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.<sup foot_note=196966>1</sup>

entries.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
entries.originalHtml: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

entries.text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.<sup foot_note=196967>1</sup>

entries.text: So do not invoke with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
entries.originalHtml: So do not invoke<sup foot_note=196968>1</sup> with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.

entries.text: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.
entries.originalHtml: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

entries.text: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
entries.originalHtml: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.

entries.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
entries.originalHtml: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."

entries.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
entries.originalHtml: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

entries.text: Who sees you when you arise
entries.originalHtml: Who sees you when you arise<sup foot_note=196969>1</sup>

entries.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.
entries.originalHtml: And your movement among those who prostrate.<sup foot_note=196970>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

entries.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
entries.originalHtml: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?

entries.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.
entries.originalHtml: They descend upon every sinful liar.

entries.text: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
entries.originalHtml: They pass on what is heard,<sup foot_note=196971>1</sup> and most of them are liars.

entries.text: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
entries.originalHtml: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

entries.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
entries.originalHtml: Do you not see that in every valley they roam<sup foot_note=196972>1</sup>

entries.text: And that they say what they do not do? -
entries.originalHtml: And that they say what they do not do? -

entries.text: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
entries.originalHtml: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims]<sup foot_note=196973>1</sup> after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.

entries.text: Ṭā, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
entries.originalHtml: Ṭā, Seen.<sup foot_note=196974>1</sup> These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book

entries.text: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
entries.originalHtml: As guidance and good tidings for the believers

entries.text: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].

entries.text: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.

entries.text: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.

entries.text: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.

entries.text: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
entries.originalHtml: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."

entries.text: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
entries.originalHtml: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

entries.text: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
entries.originalHtml: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return.<sup foot_note=196975>1</sup> [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.

entries.text: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
entries.originalHtml: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

entries.text: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
entries.originalHtml: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."

entries.text: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
entries.originalHtml: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.

entries.text: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
entries.originalHtml: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."

entries.text: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
entries.originalHtml: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."

entries.text: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
entries.originalHtml: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows

entries.text: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
entries.originalHtml: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."

entries.text: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
entries.originalHtml: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me<sup foot_note=196977>1</sup> to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."<sup foot_note=196976>2</sup>

entries.text: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
entries.originalHtml: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?

entries.text: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
entries.originalHtml: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."<sup foot_note=196978>1</sup>

entries.text: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
entries.originalHtml: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

entries.text: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

entries.text: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
entries.originalHtml: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,

entries.text: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
entries.originalHtml: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -

entries.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
entries.originalHtml: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."

entries.text: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
entries.originalHtml: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

entries.text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
entries.originalHtml: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

entries.text: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
entries.originalHtml: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

entries.text: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

entries.text: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
entries.originalHtml: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"

entries.text: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
entries.originalHtml: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."<sup foot_note=196979>1</sup>

entries.text: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."

entries.text: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
entries.originalHtml: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.

entries.text: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
entries.originalHtml: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."

entries.text: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
entries.originalHtml: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

entries.text: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
entries.originalHtml: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

entries.text: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
entries.originalHtml: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

entries.text: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
entries.originalHtml: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."

entries.text: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
entries.originalHtml: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

entries.text: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."

entries.text: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].

entries.text: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
entries.originalHtml: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."

entries.text: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
entries.originalHtml: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water<sup foot_note=196980>1</sup> and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

entries.text: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
entries.originalHtml: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting.

entries.text: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"
entries.originalHtml: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil before [i.e., instead of] good?<sup foot_note=196981>1</sup> Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allāh that you may receive mercy?"

entries.text: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with Allāh. Rather, you are a people being tested."<sup foot_note=196982>1</sup>

entries.text: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
entries.originalHtml: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].

entries.text: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allāh that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor,<sup foot_note=196983>1</sup> 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.'"

entries.text: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
entries.originalHtml: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.

entries.text: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
entries.originalHtml: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.

entries.text: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
entries.originalHtml: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.

entries.text: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.

entries.text: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality<sup foot_note=196985>1</sup> while you are seeing?<sup foot_note=196984>2</sup>

entries.text: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
entries.originalHtml: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."

entries.text: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
entries.originalHtml: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."

entries.text: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
entries.originalHtml: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.

entries.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
entries.originalHtml: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Praise be to Allāh, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allāh better or what they associate with Him?"

entries.text: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
entries.originalHtml: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allāh?<sup foot_note=196986>1</sup> [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].

entries.text: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.
entries.originalHtml: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allāh? [No], but most of them do not know.

entries.text: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.
entries.originalHtml: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth?<sup foot_note=196987>1</sup> Is there a deity with Allāh? Little do you remember.

entries.text: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
entries.originalHtml: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allāh? High is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

entries.text: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allāh? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allāh, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."

entries.text: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
entries.originalHtml: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.

entries.text: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?

entries.text: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
entries.originalHtml: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."

entries.text: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
entries.originalHtml: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.

entries.text: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"

entries.text: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you are impatient.

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful."

entries.text: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

entries.text: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
entries.originalHtml: And there is nothing concealed<sup foot_note=196989>1</sup> within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.<sup foot_note=196988>2</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.

entries.text: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.

entries.text: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

entries.text: So rely upon Allāh; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
entries.originalHtml: So rely upon Allāh; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.

entries.text: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.

entries.text: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [i.e., submitting to Allāh].

entries.text: And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them,<sup foot_note=196990>1</sup> We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].

entries.text: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
entries.originalHtml: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows

entries.text: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
entries.originalHtml: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"

entries.text: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
entries.originalHtml: And the decree will befall them<sup foot_note=196991>1</sup> for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.

entries.text: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
entries.originalHtml: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

entries.text: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allāh wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
entries.originalHtml: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allāh wills. And all will come to Him humbled.

entries.text: And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allāh, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do.
entries.originalHtml: And you see the mountains, thinking them motionless,<sup foot_note=196992>1</sup> while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allāh, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Aware of that which you do.

entries.text: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.

entries.text: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
entries.originalHtml: And whoever comes with an evil deed<sup foot_note=196993>1</sup> - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"

entries.text: [Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: [Say, O Muḥammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city,<sup foot_note=196994>1</sup> who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to Allāh].

entries.text: And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
entries.originalHtml: And to recite the Qur’ān." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."

entries.text: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
entries.originalHtml: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
