entries.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Meem.<sup foot_note=197038>1</sup>

entries.text: The Byzantines have been defeated
entries.originalHtml: The Byzantines have been defeated<sup foot_note=197039>1</sup>

entries.text: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome
entries.originalHtml: In the nearest land.<sup foot_note=197040>1</sup> But they, after their defeat, will overcome

entries.text: Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
entries.originalHtml: Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice

entries.text: In the victory of Allāh. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: In the victory of Allāh.<sup foot_note=197041>1</sup> He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.

entries.text: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
entries.originalHtml: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.

entries.text: Do they not contemplate within themselves? Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: Do they not contemplate within themselves?<sup foot_note=197042>1</sup> Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.

entries.text: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
entries.originalHtml: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.

entries.text: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.
entries.originalHtml: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.

entries.text: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.

entries.text: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
entries.originalHtml: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.

entries.text: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
entries.originalHtml: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.

entries.text: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
entries.originalHtml: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.

entries.text: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
entries.originalHtml: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.

entries.text: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
entries.originalHtml: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].

entries.text: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
entries.originalHtml: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.

entries.text: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
entries.originalHtml: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.

entries.text: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.
entries.originalHtml: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.<sup foot_note=197043>1</sup>

entries.text: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].

entries.text: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

entries.text: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.

entries.text: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

entries.text: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.

entries.text: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.

entries.text: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
entries.originalHtml: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.

entries.text: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
entries.originalHtml: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?<sup foot_note=197044>1</sup> Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.

entries.text: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
entries.originalHtml: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.

entries.text: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
entries.originalHtml: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah<sup foot_note=197046>1</sup> of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh.<sup foot_note=197045>2</sup> That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

entries.text: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh
entries.originalHtml: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh

entries.text: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
entries.originalHtml: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.<sup foot_note=197047>1</sup>

entries.text: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
entries.originalHtml: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,

entries.text: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
entries.originalHtml: So that they will deny what We have granted them.<sup foot_note=197048>1</sup> Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

entries.text: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
entries.originalHtml: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?

entries.text: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
entries.originalHtml: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.

entries.text: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
entries.originalHtml: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

entries.text: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
entries.originalHtml: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.

entries.text: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh, desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.
entries.originalHtml: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people<sup foot_note=197051>1</sup> will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh,<sup foot_note=197050>2</sup> desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.<sup foot_note=197049>3</sup>

entries.text: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

entries.text: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
entries.originalHtml: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].

entries.text: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.
entries.originalHtml: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.<sup foot_note=197052>1</sup>

entries.text: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
entries.originalHtml: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,

entries.text: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.

entries.text: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.

entries.text: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support of the believers.
entries.originalHtml: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support<sup foot_note=197053>1</sup> of the believers.

entries.text: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice

entries.text: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
entries.originalHtml: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.

entries.text: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

entries.text: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.<sup foot_note=197054>1</sup>

entries.text: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
entries.originalHtml: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.

entries.text: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].

entries.text: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

entries.text: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
entries.originalHtml: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

entries.text: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."
entries.originalHtml: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."<sup foot_note=197055>1</sup>

entries.text: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

entries.text: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."

entries.text: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.
entries.originalHtml: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.<sup foot_note=197056>1</sup>

entries.text: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].

entries.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Meem.<sup foot_note=197057>1</sup>

entries.text: These are verses of the wise Book,
entries.originalHtml: These are verses of the wise<sup foot_note=197058>1</sup> Book,

entries.text: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good
entries.originalHtml: As guidance and mercy for the doers of good

entries.text: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and they, of the Hereafter, are certain [in faith].

entries.text: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
entries.originalHtml: Those are on [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.

entries.text: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And of the people is he who buys the amusement of speech<sup foot_note=197059>1</sup> to mislead [others] from the way of Allāh without knowledge and who takes it [i.e., His way] in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

entries.text: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And when Our verses are recited to him, he turns away arrogantly as if he had not heard them, as if there was in his ears deafness. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

entries.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them are the Gardens of Pleasure,

entries.text: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Wherein they abide eternally; [it is] the promise of Allāh [which is] truth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.
entries.originalHtml: He created the heavens without pillars that you see and has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with you, and dispersed therein from every creature. And We sent down rain from the sky and made grow therein [plants] of every noble kind.

entries.text: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.
entries.originalHtml: This is the creation of Allāh. So show Me what those other than Him have created. Rather, the wrongdoers are in clear error.

entries.text: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Luqmān said to his son while he was instructing him, "O my son, do not associate [anything] with Allāh. Indeed, association [with Him] is great injustice."

entries.text: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.
entries.originalHtml: And We have enjoined upon man [care] for his parents. His mother carried him, [increasing her] in weakness upon weakness, and his weaning is in two years. Be grateful to Me and to your parents; to Me is the [final] destination.

entries.text: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
entries.originalHtml: But if they endeavor to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge,<sup foot_note=197060>1</sup> do not obey them but accompany them in [this] world with appropriate kindness and follow the way of those who turn back to Me [in repentance]. Then to Me will be your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.

entries.text: [And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
entries.originalHtml: [And Luqmān said], "O my son, indeed if it [i.e., a wrong] should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allāh will bring it forth. Indeed, Allāh is Subtle<sup foot_note=197061>1</sup> and Aware.

entries.text: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.
entries.originalHtml: O my son, establish prayer, enjoin what is right, forbid what is wrong, and be patient over what befalls you. Indeed, [all] that is of the matters [requiring] resolve.<sup foot_note=197062>1</sup>

entries.text: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.
entries.originalHtml: And do not turn your cheek [in contempt] toward people<sup foot_note=197063>1</sup> and do not walk through the earth exultantly. Indeed, Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful.

entries.text: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."
entries.originalHtml: And be moderate in your pace and lower your voice; indeed, the most disagreeable of sounds is the voice of donkeys."

entries.text: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].
entries.originalHtml: Do you not see that Allāh has made subject to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth and amply bestowed upon you His favors, [both] apparent and unapparent? But of the people is he who disputes about Allāh without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening Book [from Him].

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Follow what Allāh has revealed," they say, "Rather, we will follow that upon which we found our fathers." Even if Satan was inviting them to the punishment of the Blaze?

entries.text: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever submits his face [i.e., self] to Allāh while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allāh will be the outcome of [all] matters.

entries.text: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever has disbelieved - let not his disbelief grieve you. To Us is their return, and We will inform them of what they did. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.text: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.
entries.originalHtml: We grant them enjoyment for a little; then We will force them to a massive punishment.

entries.text: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.
entries.originalHtml: And if you asked them, "Who created the heavens and earth?" they would surely say, "Allāh." Say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allāh"; but most of them do not know.

entries.text: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: To Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

entries.text: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And if whatever trees upon the earth were pens and the sea [was ink], replenished thereafter by seven [more] seas, the words<sup foot_note=197064>1</sup> of Allāh would not be exhausted. Indeed, Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: Your creation and your resurrection will not be but as that of a single soul.<sup foot_note=197065>1</sup> Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

entries.text: Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?
entries.originalHtml: Do you not see [i.e., know] that Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term, and that Allāh, of whatever you do, is Aware?

entries.text: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
entries.originalHtml: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that what they call upon<sup foot_note=197066>1</sup> other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.

entries.text: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
entries.originalHtml: Do you not see that ships sail through the sea by the favor of Allāh that He may show you of His signs? Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

entries.text: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
entries.originalHtml: And when waves come over them like canopies, they supplicate Allāh, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith]. But when He delivers them to the land, there are [some] of them who are moderate [in faith]. And none rejects Our signs except everyone treacherous and ungrateful.

entries.text: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].
entries.originalHtml: O mankind, fear your Lord and fear a Day when no father will avail his son, nor will a son avail his father at all. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allāh by the Deceiver [i.e., Satan].

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs. And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh [alone] has knowledge of the Hour and sends down the rain and knows what is in the wombs.<sup foot_note=197067>1</sup> And no soul perceives what it will earn tomorrow, and no soul perceives in what land it will die. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.

entries.text: Alif, Lām, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Alif, Lām, Meem.<sup foot_note=197068>1</sup>

entries.text: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.
entries.originalHtml: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.

entries.text: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne. You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne.<sup foot_note=197069>1</sup> You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?

entries.text: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
entries.originalHtml: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.

entries.text: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
entries.originalHtml: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

entries.text: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.
entries.originalHtml: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.

entries.text: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
entries.originalHtml: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.

entries.text: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
entries.originalHtml: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul<sup foot_note=197070>1</sup> and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.

entries.text: And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.

entries.text: Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."

entries.text: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
entries.originalHtml: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."

entries.text: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
entries.originalHtml: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word<sup foot_note=197071>1</sup> from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.

entries.text: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
entries.originalHtml: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."

entries.text: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
entries.originalHtml: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.

entries.text: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
entries.originalHtml: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.<sup foot_note=197072>1</sup>

entries.text: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.

entries.text: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
entries.originalHtml: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.

entries.text: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.

entries.text: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."
entries.originalHtml: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."

entries.text: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].
entries.originalHtml: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment<sup foot_note=197073>1</sup> short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].

entries.text: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
entries.originalHtml: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.

entries.text: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting. And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.
entries.originalHtml: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting.<sup foot_note=197074>1</sup> And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.

entries.text: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.
entries.originalHtml: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.

entries.text: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

entries.text: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?
entries.originalHtml: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?

entries.text: Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?
entries.originalHtml: Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?

entries.text: And they say, "When will be this conquest, if you should be truthful?"
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "When will be this conquest,<sup foot_note=197075>1</sup> if you should be truthful?"

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."

entries.text: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
entries.originalHtml: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, fear Allāh and do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.
entries.originalHtml: And follow that which is revealed to you from your Lord. Indeed Allāh is ever, of what you do, Aware.

entries.text: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
entries.originalHtml: And rely upon Allāh; and sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.<sup foot_note=197076>1</sup>

entries.text: Allāh has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful your mothers. And He has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allāh says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has not made for a man two hearts in his interior. And He has not made your wives whom you declare unlawful<sup foot_note=197077>1</sup> your mothers. And He has not made your claimed [i.e., adopted] sons your [true] sons. That is [merely] your saying by your mouths, but Allāh says the truth, and He guides to the [right] way.

entries.text: Call them by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Call them<sup foot_note=197078>1</sup> by [the names of] their fathers; it is more just in the sight of Allāh. But if you do not know their fathers - then they are [still] your brothers in religion and those entrusted to you. And there is no blame upon you for that in which you have erred but [only for] what your hearts intended. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves, and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book inscribed.
entries.originalHtml: The Prophet is more worthy of the believers than themselves,<sup foot_note=197080>1</sup> and his wives are [in the position of] their mothers. And those of [blood] relationship are more entitled [to inheritance] in the decree of Allāh than the [other] believers and the emigrants, except that you may do to your close associates a kindness [through bequest]. That was in the Book<sup foot_note=197079>2</sup> inscribed.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We took from the prophets their covenant and from you and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus, the son of Mary; and We took from them a solemn covenant

entries.text: That He may question the truthful about their truth. And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: That He may question the truthful about their truth.<sup foot_note=197081>1</sup> And He has prepared for the disbelievers a painful punishment.

entries.text: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, remember the favor of Allāh upon you when armies came to [attack] you and We sent upon them a wind and armies [of angels] you did not see. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

entries.text: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allāh [various] assumptions.
entries.originalHtml: [Remember] when they came at you from above you and from below you, and when eyes shifted [in fear], and hearts reached the throats, and you assumed about Allāh [various] assumptions.

entries.text: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.
entries.originalHtml: There the believers were tested and shaken with a severe shaking.

entries.text: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allāh and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"
entries.originalHtml: And [remember] when the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease said, "Allāh and His Messenger did not promise us except delusion,"

entries.text: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib, there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed [i.e., unprotected]," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.
entries.originalHtml: And when a faction of them said, "O people of Yathrib,<sup foot_note=197082>1</sup> there is no stability for you [here], so return [home]." And a party of them asked permission of the Prophet, saying, "Indeed, our houses are exposed [i.e., unprotected]," while they were not exposed. They did not intend except to flee.

entries.text: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah [i.e., disbelief] had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.
entries.originalHtml: And if they had been entered upon from all its [surrounding] regions and fitnah [i.e., disbelief] had been demanded of them, they would have done it and not hesitated over it except briefly.

entries.text: And they had already promised Allāh before not to turn their backs [i.e., flee]. And ever is the promise to Allāh [that about which one will be] questioned.
entries.originalHtml: And they had already promised Allāh before not to turn their backs [i.e., flee]. And ever is the promise to Allāh [that about which one will be] questioned.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Never will fleeing benefit you if you should flee from death or killing; and then [if you did], you would not be given enjoyment [of life] except for a little."

entries.text: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allāh if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allāh any protector or any helper.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Who is it that can protect you from Allāh<sup foot_note=197083>1</sup> if He intends for you an ill or intends for you a mercy?" And they will not find for themselves besides Allāh any protector or any helper.

entries.text: Already Allāh knows the hinderers among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us," and do not go to battle, except for a few,
entries.originalHtml: Already Allāh knows the hinderers<sup foot_note=197086>1</sup> among you and those [hypocrites] who say to their brothers, "Come to us,"<sup foot_note=197085>2</sup> and do not go to battle, except for a few,<sup foot_note=197084>3</sup>

entries.text: Indisposed toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allāh has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.
entries.originalHtml: Indisposed<sup foot_note=197087>1</sup> toward you. And when fear comes, you see them looking at you, their eyes revolving like one being overcome by death. But when fear departs, they lash you with sharp tongues, indisposed toward [any] good. Those have not believed, so Allāh has rendered their deeds worthless, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

entries.text: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn. And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.
entries.originalHtml: They think the companies have not [yet] withdrawn.<sup foot_note=197088>1</sup> And if the companies should come [again], they would wish they were in the desert among the bedouins, inquiring [from afar] about your news. And if they should be among you, they would not fight except for a little.

entries.text: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.
entries.originalHtml: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allāh an excellent pattern<sup foot_note=197089>1</sup> for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allāh often.

entries.text: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allāh and His Messenger had promised us, and Allāh and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.
entries.originalHtml: And when the believers saw the companies, they said, "This is what Allāh and His Messenger had promised us, and Allāh and His Messenger spoke the truth." And it increased them only in faith and acceptance.

entries.text: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration -
entries.originalHtml: Among the believers are men true to what they promised Allāh. Among them is he who has fulfilled his vow [to the death], and among them is he who awaits [his chance]. And they did not alter [the terms of their commitment] by any alteration -

entries.text: That Allāh may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: That Allāh may reward the truthful for their truth and punish the hypocrites if He wills or accept their repentance. Indeed, Allāh is ever Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh repelled those who disbelieved, in their rage, not having obtained any good. And sufficient was Allāh for the believers in battle, and ever is Allāh Powerful and Exalted in Might.

entries.text: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party [i.e., their men] you killed, and you took captive a party [i.e., the women and children].
entries.originalHtml: And He brought down those who supported them among the People of the Scripture<sup foot_note=197090>1</sup> from their fortresses and cast terror into their hearts [so that] a party [i.e., their men] you killed, and you took captive a party [i.e., the women and children].

entries.text: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.
entries.originalHtml: And He caused you to inherit their land and their homes and their properties and a land which you have not trodden.<sup foot_note=197091>1</sup> And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

entries.text: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, say to your wives, "If you should desire the worldly life and its adornment, then come, I will provide for you and give you a gracious release.

entries.text: But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."
entries.originalHtml: But if you should desire Allāh and His Messenger and the home of the Hereafter - then indeed, Allāh has prepared for the doers of good among you a great reward."

entries.text: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.
entries.originalHtml: O wives of the Prophet, whoever of you should commit a clear immorality - for her the punishment would be doubled two fold, and ever is that, for Allāh, easy.

entries.text: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allāh and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever of you devoutly obeys Allāh and His Messenger and does righteousness - We will give her her reward twice; and We have prepared for her a noble provision.

entries.text: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allāh, then do not be soft in speech [to men], lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech.
entries.originalHtml: O wives of the Prophet, you are not like anyone among women. If you fear Allāh, then do not be soft in speech [to men],<sup foot_note=197092>1</sup> lest he in whose heart is disease should covet, but speak with appropriate speech.

entries.text: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.
entries.originalHtml: And abide in your houses and do not display yourselves as [was] the display of the former times of ignorance. And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. Allāh intends only to remove from you the impurity [of sin], O people of the [Prophet's] household, and to purify you with [extensive] purification.

entries.text: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allāh and wisdom. Indeed, Allāh is ever Subtle and Aware.
entries.originalHtml: And remember what is recited in your houses of the verses of Allāh and wisdom.<sup foot_note=197094>1</sup> Indeed, Allāh is ever Subtle<sup foot_note=197093>2</sup> and Aware.

entries.text: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so - for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the Muslim men and Muslim women, the believing men and believing women, the obedient men and obedient women, the truthful men and truthful women, the patient men and patient women, the humble men and humble women, the charitable men and charitable women, the fasting men and fasting women, the men who guard their private parts and the women who do so, and the men who remember Allāh often and the women who do so - for them Allāh has prepared forgiveness and a great reward.

entries.text: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allāh and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.
entries.originalHtml: It is not for a believing man or a believing woman, when Allāh and His Messenger have decided a matter, that they should [thereafter] have any choice about their affair. And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly strayed into clear error.

entries.text: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.
entries.originalHtml: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor,<sup foot_note=197098>1</sup> "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose.<sup foot_note=197097>2</sup> And you feared the people,<sup foot_note=197096>3</sup> while Allāh has more right that you fear Him.<sup foot_note=197095>4</sup> So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.

entries.text: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allāh has imposed upon him. [This is] the established way of Allāh with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allāh a destiny decreed.
entries.originalHtml: There is not to be upon the Prophet any discomfort concerning that which Allāh has imposed upon him.<sup foot_note=197099>1</sup> [This is] the established way of Allāh with those [prophets] who have passed on before. And ever is the command of Allāh a destiny decreed.

entries.text: [Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh praises] those who convey the messages of Allāh<sup foot_note=197100>1</sup> and fear Him and do not fear anyone but Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Accountant.

entries.text: Muḥammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allāh and seal [i.e., last] of the prophets. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: Muḥammad is not the father of [any] one of your men, but [he is] the Messenger of Allāh and seal [i.e., last] of the prophets. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

entries.text: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, remember Allāh with much remembrance

entries.text: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.
entries.originalHtml: And exalt Him morning and afternoon.

entries.text: It is He who confers blessing upon you, and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who confers blessing upon you,<sup foot_note=197101>1</sup> and His angels [ask Him to do so] that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And ever is He, to the believers, Merciful.

entries.text: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
entries.originalHtml: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.

entries.text: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

entries.text: And one who invites to Allāh, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.
entries.originalHtml: And one who invites to Allāh, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp.

entries.text: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allāh great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allāh great bounty.

entries.text: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.
entries.originalHtml: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allāh. And sufficient is Allāh as Disposer of affairs.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when you marry believing women and then divorce them before you have touched them [i.e., consummated the marriage], then there is not for you any waiting period to count concerning them. So provide for them and give them a gracious release.

entries.text: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation and those your right hand possesses from what Allāh has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her; [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort [i.e., difficulty]. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, indeed We have made lawful to you your wives to whom you have given their due compensation<sup foot_note=197102>1</sup> and those your right hand possesses from what Allāh has returned to you [of captives] and the daughters of your paternal uncles and the daughters of your paternal aunts and the daughters of your maternal uncles and the daughters of your maternal aunts who emigrated with you and a believing woman if she gives herself to the Prophet [and] if the Prophet wishes to marry her; [this is] only for you, excluding the [other] believers. We certainly know what We have made obligatory upon them concerning their wives and those their right hands possess, [but this is for you] in order that there will be upon you no discomfort [i.e., difficulty]. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: You, [O Muḥammad], may put aside whom you will of them or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allāh knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Forbearing.
entries.originalHtml: You, [O Muḥammad], may put aside whom you will of them<sup foot_note=197103>1</sup> or take to yourself whom you will. And any that you desire of those [wives] from whom you had [temporarily] separated - there is no blame upon you [in returning her]. That is more suitable that they should be content and not grieve and that they should be satisfied with what you have given them - all of them. And Allāh knows what is in your hearts. And ever is Allāh Knowing and Forbearing.

entries.text: Not lawful to you, [O Muḥammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allāh, over all things, an Observer.
entries.originalHtml: Not lawful to you, [O Muḥammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allāh, over all things, an Observer.<sup foot_note=197104>1</sup>

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allāh is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allāh or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allāh an enormity.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not enter the houses of the Prophet except when you are permitted for a meal, without awaiting its readiness. But when you are invited, then enter; and when you have eaten, disperse without seeking to remain for conversation. Indeed, that [behavior] was troubling the Prophet, and he is shy of [dismissing] you. But Allāh is not shy of the truth. And when you ask [his wives] for something, ask them from behind a partition. That is purer for your hearts and their hearts. And it is not [conceivable or lawful] for you to harm the Messenger of Allāh or to marry his wives after him, ever. Indeed, that would be in the sight of Allāh an enormity.

entries.text: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: Whether you reveal a thing or conceal it, indeed Allāh is ever, of all things, Knowing.

entries.text: There is no blame upon them [i.e., women] concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess [i.e., slaves]. And fear Allāh. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, Witness.
entries.originalHtml: There is no blame upon them [i.e., women] concerning their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their brothers' sons or their sisters' sons or their women or those their right hands possess [i.e., slaves].<sup foot_note=197105>1</sup> And fear Allāh. Indeed Allāh is ever, over all things, Witness.

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh confers blessing upon the Prophet, and His angels [ask Him to do so]. O you who have believed, ask [Allāh to confer] blessing upon him and ask [Allāh to grant him] peace.

entries.text: Indeed, those who abuse Allāh and His Messenger - Allāh has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who abuse Allāh and His Messenger - Allāh has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.

entries.text: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.
entries.originalHtml: And those who harm believing men and believing women for [something] other than what they have earned [i.e., deserved] have certainly borne upon themselves a slander and manifest sin.

entries.text: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments. That is more suitable that they will be known and not be abused. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, tell your wives and your daughters and the women of the believers to bring down over themselves [part] of their outer garments.<sup foot_note=197108>1</sup> That is more suitable that they will be known<sup foot_note=197107>2</sup> and not be abused. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.<sup foot_note=197106>3</sup>

entries.text: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease and those who spread rumors in al-Madīnah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little,
entries.originalHtml: If the hypocrites and those in whose hearts is disease<sup foot_note=197109>1</sup> and those who spread rumors in al-Madīnah do not cease, We will surely incite you against them; then they will not remain your neighbors therein except for a little,

entries.text: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.
entries.originalHtml: Accursed wherever they are found, [being] seized and massacred completely.

entries.text: [This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] the established way of Allāh with those who passed on before; and you will not find in the way of Allāh any change.

entries.text: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."
entries.originalHtml: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh has cursed the disbelievers and prepared for them a Blaze.

entries.text: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
entries.originalHtml: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.

entries.text: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."
entries.originalHtml: The Day their faces will be turned about in the Fire, they will say, "How we wish we had obeyed Allāh and obeyed the Messenger."

entries.text: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries, and they led us astray from the [right] way.
entries.originalHtml: And they will say, "Our Lord, indeed we obeyed our masters and our dignitaries,<sup foot_note=197110>1</sup> and they led us astray from the [right] way.

entries.text: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."
entries.originalHtml: Our Lord, give them double the punishment and curse them with a great curse."

entries.text: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, be not like those who abused Moses; then Allāh cleared him of what they said. And he, in the sight of Allāh, was distinguished.

entries.text: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and speak words of appropriate justice.

entries.text: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.
entries.originalHtml: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.

entries.text: Indeed, We offered the Trust to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We offered the Trust<sup foot_note=197112>1</sup> to the heavens and the earth and the mountains, and they declined to bear it and feared it; but man [undertook to] bear it. Indeed, he was unjust and ignorant.<sup foot_note=197111>2</sup>

entries.text: [It was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: [It<sup foot_note=197113>1</sup> was] so that Allāh may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women and the men and women who associate others with Him and that Allāh may accept repentance from the believing men and believing women. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
