entries.text: Yā, Seen.
entries.originalHtml: Yā, Seen.<sup foot_note=197154>1</sup>

entries.text: By the wise Qur’ān,
entries.originalHtml: By the wise<sup foot_note=197155>1</sup> Qur’ān,

entries.text: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,

entries.text: On a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: On a straight path.

entries.text: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
entries.originalHtml: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

entries.text: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
entries.originalHtml: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

entries.text: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
entries.originalHtml: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

entries.text: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

entries.text: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
entries.originalHtml: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

entries.text: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
entries.originalHtml: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

entries.text: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
entries.originalHtml: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

entries.text: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

entries.text: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
entries.originalHtml: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

entries.text: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
entries.originalHtml: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

entries.text: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

entries.text: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

entries.text: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
entries.originalHtml: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

entries.text: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

entries.text: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it<sup foot_note=197156>1</sup> because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

entries.text: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
entries.originalHtml: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

entries.text: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
entries.originalHtml: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

entries.text: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
entries.originalHtml: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

entries.text: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
entries.originalHtml: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

entries.text: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

entries.text: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

entries.text: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
entries.originalHtml: It was said, "Enter Paradise."<sup foot_note=197157>1</sup> He said, "I wish my people could know

entries.text: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
entries.originalHtml: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

entries.text: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

entries.text: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
entries.originalHtml: It was not but one shout,<sup foot_note=197158>1</sup> and immediately they were extinguished.

entries.text: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
entries.originalHtml: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

entries.text: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
entries.originalHtml: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them<sup foot_note=197159>1</sup> will not return?

entries.text: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

entries.text: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
entries.originalHtml: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

entries.text: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
entries.originalHtml: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

entries.text: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
entries.originalHtml: That they may eat of His fruit.<sup foot_note=197161>1</sup> And their hands have not produced it,<sup foot_note=197160>2</sup> so will they not be grateful?

entries.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
entries.originalHtml: Exalted is He who created all pairs<sup foot_note=197162>1</sup> - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

entries.text: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
entries.originalHtml: And a sign for them is the night. We remove<sup foot_note=197163>1</sup> from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

entries.text: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

entries.text: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
entries.originalHtml: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

entries.text: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
entries.originalHtml: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

entries.text: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
entries.originalHtml: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers<sup foot_note=197164>1</sup> in a laden ship.

entries.text: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
entries.originalHtml: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

entries.text: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
entries.originalHtml: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

entries.text: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
entries.originalHtml: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

entries.text: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy..."
entries.originalHtml: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;<sup foot_note=197166>1</sup> perhaps you will receive mercy..."<sup foot_note=197165>2</sup>

entries.text: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
entries.originalHtml: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

entries.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

entries.text: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
entries.originalHtml: They do not await except one blast<sup foot_note=197167>1</sup> which will seize them while they are disputing.

entries.text: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
entries.originalHtml: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

entries.text: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
entries.originalHtml: And the Horn will be blown;<sup foot_note=197168>1</sup> and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

entries.text: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

entries.text: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
entries.originalHtml: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

entries.text: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
entries.originalHtml: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

entries.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
entries.originalHtml: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

entries.text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
entries.originalHtml: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

entries.text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
entries.originalHtml: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

entries.text: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
entries.originalHtml: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

entries.text: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
entries.originalHtml: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.<sup foot_note=197169>1</sup>

entries.text: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
entries.originalHtml: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

entries.text: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

entries.text: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
entries.originalHtml: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

entries.text: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
entries.originalHtml: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

entries.text: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
entries.originalHtml: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."<sup foot_note=197170>1</sup>

entries.text: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
entries.originalHtml: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

entries.text: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
entries.originalHtml: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?<sup foot_note=197171>1</sup>

entries.text: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
entries.originalHtml: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.<sup foot_note=197172>1</sup>

entries.text: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
entries.originalHtml: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;<sup foot_note=197173>1</sup> so will they not understand?

entries.text: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
entries.originalHtml: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān

entries.text: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: To warn whoever is alive<sup foot_note=197174>1</sup> and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.

entries.text: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
entries.originalHtml: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands<sup foot_note=197175>1</sup> have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

entries.text: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
entries.originalHtml: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

entries.text: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
entries.originalHtml: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

entries.text: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
entries.originalHtml: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

entries.text: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
entries.originalHtml: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.<sup foot_note=197176>1</sup>

entries.text: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
entries.originalHtml: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

entries.text: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
entries.originalHtml: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once<sup foot_note=197177>1</sup> he is a clear adversary?

entries.text: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
entries.originalHtml: And he presents for Us an example<sup foot_note=197178>1</sup> and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

entries.text: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

entries.text: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

entries.text: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
entries.originalHtml: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

entries.text: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
entries.originalHtml: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

entries.text: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
entries.originalHtml: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows
entries.originalHtml: By those [angels] lined up in rows

entries.text: And those who drive [the clouds]
entries.originalHtml: And those who drive [the clouds]

entries.text: And those who recite the message,
entries.originalHtml: And those who recite the message,<sup foot_note=197179>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, your God is One,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, your God is One,

entries.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
entries.originalHtml: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.<sup foot_note=197180>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

entries.text: And as protection against every rebellious devil
entries.originalHtml: And as protection against every rebellious devil

entries.text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
entries.originalHtml: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,<sup foot_note=197181>1</sup>

entries.text: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
entries.originalHtml: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

entries.text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
entries.originalHtml: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

entries.text: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
entries.originalHtml: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.

entries.text: But you wonder, while they mock,
entries.originalHtml: But you wonder, while they mock,

entries.text: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
entries.originalHtml: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

entries.text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
entries.originalHtml: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

entries.text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
entries.originalHtml: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

entries.text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
entries.originalHtml: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

entries.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"
entries.originalHtml: And our forefathers [as well]?"

entries.text: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

entries.text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
entries.originalHtml: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

entries.text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

entries.text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
entries.originalHtml: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

entries.text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
entries.originalHtml: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,<sup foot_note=197182>1</sup> and what they used to worship

entries.text: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
entries.originalHtml: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

entries.text: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
entries.originalHtml: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

entries.text: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
entries.originalHtml: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

entries.text: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
entries.originalHtml: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

entries.text: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
entries.originalHtml: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

entries.text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."<sup foot_note=197183>1</sup>

entries.text: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
entries.originalHtml: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

entries.text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
entries.originalHtml: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

entries.text: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
entries.originalHtml: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

entries.text: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
entries.originalHtml: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

entries.text: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
entries.originalHtml: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

entries.text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

entries.text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
entries.originalHtml: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant

entries.text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
entries.originalHtml: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

entries.text: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
entries.originalHtml: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

entries.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

entries.text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
entries.originalHtml: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

entries.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

entries.text: Those will have a provision determined -
entries.originalHtml: Those will have a provision determined -

entries.text: Fruits; and they will be honored
entries.originalHtml: Fruits;<sup foot_note=197184>1</sup> and they will be honored

entries.text: In gardens of pleasure
entries.originalHtml: In gardens of pleasure

entries.text: On thrones facing one another.
entries.originalHtml: On thrones facing one another.

entries.text: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
entries.originalHtml: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

entries.text: White and delicious to the drinkers;
entries.originalHtml: White and delicious to the drinkers;

entries.text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
entries.originalHtml: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

entries.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
entries.originalHtml: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances,<sup foot_note=197185>1</sup> with large, [beautiful] eyes,

entries.text: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
entries.originalHtml: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

entries.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
entries.originalHtml: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

entries.text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
entries.originalHtml: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

entries.text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
entries.originalHtml: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

entries.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
entries.originalHtml: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

entries.text: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
entries.originalHtml: He will say,<sup foot_note=197186>1</sup> "Would you [care to] look?"

entries.text: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: And he will look and see him<sup foot_note=197187>1</sup> in the midst of the Hellfire.

entries.text: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.
entries.originalHtml: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

entries.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
entries.originalHtml: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

entries.text: Then, are we not to die
entries.originalHtml: Then, are we not to die

entries.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
entries.originalHtml: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

entries.text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

entries.text: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
entries.originalHtml: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

entries.text: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
entries.originalHtml: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

entries.text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

entries.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

entries.text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
entries.originalHtml: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

entries.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

entries.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
entries.originalHtml: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

entries.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

entries.text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

entries.text: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
entries.originalHtml: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

entries.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
entries.originalHtml: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

entries.text: And We had already sent among them warners.
entries.originalHtml: And We had already sent among them warners.

entries.text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
entries.originalHtml: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

entries.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

entries.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
entries.originalHtml: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

entries.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
entries.originalHtml: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

entries.text: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
entries.originalHtml: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

entries.text: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
entries.originalHtml: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

entries.text: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
entries.originalHtml: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

entries.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

entries.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

entries.text: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
entries.originalHtml: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

entries.text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

entries.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
entries.originalHtml: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

entries.text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
entries.originalHtml: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

entries.text: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?
entries.originalHtml: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

entries.text: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
entries.originalHtml: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

entries.text: And he cast a look at the stars.
entries.originalHtml: And he cast a look at the stars.

entries.text: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
entries.originalHtml: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

entries.text: So they turned away from him, departing.
entries.originalHtml: So they turned away from him, departing.

entries.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
entries.originalHtml: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?<sup foot_note=197188>1</sup>

entries.text: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".
entries.originalHtml: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".

entries.text: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
entries.originalHtml: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

entries.text: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
entries.originalHtml: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

entries.text: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

entries.text: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"
entries.originalHtml: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

entries.text: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

entries.text: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.
entries.originalHtml: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

entries.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
entries.originalHtml: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

entries.text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
entries.originalHtml: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

entries.text: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
entries.originalHtml: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

entries.text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
entries.originalHtml: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion,<sup foot_note=197189>1</sup> he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."

entries.text: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
entries.originalHtml: And when they had both submitted<sup foot_note=197190>1</sup> and he put him down upon his forehead,

entries.text: We called to him, "O Abraham,
entries.originalHtml: We called to him, "O Abraham,

entries.text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

entries.text: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

entries.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
entries.originalHtml: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,<sup foot_note=197191>1</sup>

entries.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
entries.originalHtml: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

entries.text: "Peace upon Abraham."
entries.originalHtml: "Peace upon Abraham."

entries.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

entries.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

entries.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.<sup foot_note=197192>1</sup>

entries.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
entries.originalHtml: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

entries.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
entries.originalHtml: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

entries.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
entries.originalHtml: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

entries.text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
entries.originalHtml: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

entries.text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],
entries.originalHtml: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

entries.text: And We guided them on the straight path.
entries.originalHtml: And We guided them on the straight path.

entries.text: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
entries.originalHtml: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

entries.text: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
entries.originalHtml: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

entries.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

entries.text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

entries.text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

entries.text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?
entries.originalHtml: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

entries.text: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -
entries.originalHtml: Do you call upon Baʿl<sup foot_note=197193>1</sup> and leave the best of creators -

entries.text: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
entries.originalHtml: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

entries.text: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
entries.originalHtml: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

entries.text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

entries.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
entries.originalHtml: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

entries.text: "Peace upon Elias."
entries.originalHtml: "Peace upon Elias."<sup foot_note=197194>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

entries.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

entries.text: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

entries.text: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
entries.originalHtml: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

entries.text: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
entries.originalHtml: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

entries.text: Then We destroyed the others.
entries.originalHtml: Then We destroyed the others.

entries.text: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

entries.text: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
entries.originalHtml: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

entries.text: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

entries.text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
entries.originalHtml: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

entries.text: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
entries.originalHtml: And he drew lots<sup foot_note=197195>1</sup> and was among the losers.

entries.text: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
entries.originalHtml: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.<sup foot_note=197196>1</sup>

entries.text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,
entries.originalHtml: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

entries.text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
entries.originalHtml: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.<sup foot_note=197197>1</sup>

entries.text: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
entries.originalHtml: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

entries.text: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
entries.originalHtml: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.<sup foot_note=197198>1</sup>

entries.text: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
entries.originalHtml: And We sent him<sup foot_note=197199>1</sup> to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

entries.text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
entries.originalHtml: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

entries.text: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
entries.originalHtml: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?<sup foot_note=197200>1</sup>

entries.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
entries.originalHtml: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

entries.text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
entries.originalHtml: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

entries.text: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
entries.originalHtml: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

entries.text: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
entries.originalHtml: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

entries.text: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
entries.originalHtml: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

entries.text: Then will you not be reminded?
entries.originalHtml: Then will you not be reminded?

entries.text: Or do you have a clear authority?
entries.originalHtml: Or do you have a clear authority?<sup foot_note=197201>1</sup>

entries.text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
entries.originalHtml: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

entries.text: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
entries.originalHtml: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].

entries.text: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,
entries.originalHtml: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

entries.text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].
entries.originalHtml: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

entries.text: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
entries.originalHtml: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

entries.text: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
entries.originalHtml: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

entries.text: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.<sup foot_note=197202>1</sup>

entries.text: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
entries.originalHtml: [The angels say],<sup foot_note=197204>1</sup> "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.<sup foot_note=197203>2</sup>

entries.text: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

entries.text: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

entries.text: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,<sup foot_note=197205>1</sup>

entries.text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
entries.originalHtml: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

entries.text: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."
entries.originalHtml: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

entries.text: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
entries.originalHtml: But they disbelieved in it,<sup foot_note=197206>1</sup> so they are going to know.

entries.text: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
entries.originalHtml: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

entries.text: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
entries.originalHtml: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

entries.text: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.
entries.originalHtml: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.<sup foot_note=197207>1</sup>

entries.text: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.
entries.originalHtml: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

entries.text: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
entries.originalHtml: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

entries.text: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
entries.originalHtml: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

entries.text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
entries.originalHtml: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

entries.text: And leave them for a time.
entries.originalHtml: And leave them for a time.

entries.text: And see, for they are going to see.
entries.originalHtml: And see, for they are going to see.

entries.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
entries.originalHtml: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

entries.text: And peace upon the messengers.
entries.originalHtml: And peace upon the messengers.

entries.text: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
entries.originalHtml: Ṣād.<sup foot_note=197209>1</sup> By the Qur’ān containing reminder...<sup foot_note=197208>2</sup>

entries.text: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
entries.originalHtml: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

entries.text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
entries.originalHtml: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

entries.text: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
entries.originalHtml: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

entries.text: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
entries.originalHtml: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

entries.text: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
entries.originalHtml: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.<sup foot_note=197210>1</sup>

entries.text: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
entries.originalHtml: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.<sup foot_note=197211>1</sup> This is not but a fabrication.

entries.text: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

entries.text: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
entries.originalHtml: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?<sup foot_note=197212>1</sup>

entries.text: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
entries.originalHtml: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.<sup foot_note=197213>1</sup>

entries.text: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
entries.originalHtml: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

entries.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
entries.originalHtml: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,<sup foot_note=197214>1</sup>

entries.text: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
entries.originalHtml: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.<sup foot_note=197215>1</sup>

entries.text: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
entries.originalHtml: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

entries.text: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
entries.originalHtml: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.<sup foot_note=197216>1</sup>

entries.text: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."

entries.text: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].

entries.text: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

entries.text: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
entries.originalHtml: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

entries.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
entries.originalHtml: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

entries.text: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
entries.originalHtml: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

entries.text: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
entries.originalHtml: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

entries.text: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

entries.text: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord<sup foot_note=197217>1</sup> and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].

entries.text: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
entries.originalHtml: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

entries.text: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
entries.originalHtml: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

entries.text: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

entries.text: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
entries.originalHtml: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?

entries.text: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

entries.text: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].

entries.text: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
entries.originalHtml: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

entries.text: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
entries.originalHtml: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

entries.text: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
entries.originalHtml: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking<sup foot_note=197218>1</sup> [their] legs and necks.

entries.text: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
entries.originalHtml: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body;<sup foot_note=197220>1</sup> then he returned.<sup foot_note=197219>2</sup>

entries.text: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

entries.text: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
entries.originalHtml: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

entries.text: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
entries.originalHtml: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.

entries.text: And others bound together in irons.
entries.originalHtml: And others bound together in irons.

entries.text: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
entries.originalHtml: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

entries.text: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

entries.text: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
entries.originalHtml: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

entries.text: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
entries.originalHtml: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."

entries.text: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
entries.originalHtml: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

entries.text: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."<sup foot_note=197221>1</sup> Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].

entries.text: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
entries.originalHtml: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

entries.text: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

entries.text: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

entries.text: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
entries.originalHtml: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

entries.text: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
entries.originalHtml: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -

entries.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
entries.originalHtml: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

entries.text: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
entries.originalHtml: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

entries.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
entries.originalHtml: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances<sup foot_note=197222>1</sup> and of equal age.

entries.text: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
entries.originalHtml: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

entries.text: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

entries.text: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
entries.originalHtml: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

entries.text: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
entries.originalHtml: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

entries.text: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
entries.originalHtml: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

entries.text: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
entries.originalHtml: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

entries.text: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
entries.originalHtml: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

entries.text: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

entries.text: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

entries.text: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
entries.originalHtml: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?<sup foot_note=197223>1</sup>

entries.text: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
entries.originalHtml: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

entries.text: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,<sup foot_note=197224>1</sup>

entries.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
entries.originalHtml: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,<sup foot_note=197226>1</sup> the Perpetual Forgiver."<sup foot_note=197225>2</sup>

entries.text: Say, "It is great news
entries.originalHtml: Say, "It is great news

entries.text: From which you turn away.
entries.originalHtml: From which you turn away.

entries.text: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
entries.originalHtml: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

entries.text: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
entries.originalHtml: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

entries.text: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
entries.originalHtml: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

entries.text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
entries.originalHtml: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,<sup foot_note=197227>1</sup> then fall down to him in prostration."

entries.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
entries.originalHtml: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

entries.text: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: Except Iblees;<sup foot_note=197228>1</sup> he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?<sup foot_note=197229>1</sup> Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

entries.text: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.

entries.text: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

entries.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

entries.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."
entries.originalHtml: Until the Day of the time well-known."

entries.text: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
entries.originalHtml: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.

entries.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
entries.originalHtml: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

entries.text: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

entries.text: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
entries.originalHtml: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.

entries.text: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

entries.text: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
entries.originalHtml: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
