entries.text: Ḥā, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197270>1</sup>

entries.text: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -
entries.originalHtml: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -

entries.text: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who know,
entries.originalHtml: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān<sup foot_note=197271>1</sup> for a people who know,

entries.text: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.
entries.originalHtml: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.

entries.text: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working."
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work;<sup foot_note=197272>1</sup> indeed, we are working."

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness." And woe to those who associate others with Allāh

entries.text: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.

entries.text: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds - for them is a reward uninterrupted.

entries.text: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds."

entries.text: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction - for [the information of] those who ask.
entries.originalHtml: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures'] sustenance in four days without distinction<sup foot_note=197273>1</sup> - for [the information of] those who ask.

entries.text: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."
entries.originalHtml: Then He directed Himself<sup foot_note=197275>1</sup> to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, "Come [into being],<sup foot_note=197274>2</sup> willingly or by compulsion." They said, "We have come willingly."

entries.text: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection.<sup foot_note=197276>1</sup> That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

entries.text: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.
entries.originalHtml: But if they turn away, then say, "I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ʿAad and Thamūd.

entries.text: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allāh." They said, "If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."
entries.originalHtml: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], "Worship not except Allāh." They said, "If our Lord had willed,<sup foot_note=197277>1</sup> He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers."

entries.text: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.
entries.originalHtml: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.

entries.text: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.
entries.originalHtml: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.

entries.text: And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.
entries.originalHtml: And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.

entries.text: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allāh.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when the enemies of Allāh will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], the Day when the enemies of Allāh will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,

entries.text: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.

entries.text: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allāh, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.
entries.originalHtml: And they will say to their skins, "Why have you testified against us?" They will say, "We were made to speak by Allāh, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.

entries.text: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves,<sup foot_note=197278>1</sup> lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that Allāh does not know much of what you do.

entries.text: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."
entries.originalHtml: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers."

entries.text: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.
entries.originalHtml: So [even] if they are patient, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [Allāh], they will not be of those who are allowed to appease.

entries.text: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
entries.originalHtml: And We appointed for them companions<sup foot_note=197279>1</sup> who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

entries.text: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur’ān and speak noisily<sup foot_note=197280>1</sup> during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."

entries.text: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.
entries.originalHtml: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.

entries.text: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allāh - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.
entries.originalHtml: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allāh - the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.

entries.text: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet that they will be among the lowest."
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, "Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we may put them under our feet<sup foot_note=197281>1</sup> that they will be among the lowest."

entries.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh" and then remained on a right course - the angels will descend upon them, [saying], "Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.

entries.text: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
entries.originalHtml: We [angels] were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]

entries.text: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

entries.text: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
entries.originalHtml: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."

entries.text: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
entries.originalHtml: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.

entries.text: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
entries.originalHtml: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].

entries.text: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

entries.text: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allāh, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostrate to Allāh, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.<sup foot_note=197282>1</sup>

entries.text: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.
entries.originalHtml: But if they are arrogant - then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.

entries.text: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

entries.text: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who inject deviation into Our verses<sup foot_note=197283>1</sup> are not concealed from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.

entries.text: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] after it has come to them... And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the message [i.e., the Qur’ān]<sup foot_note=197286>1</sup> after it has come to them...<sup foot_note=197285>2</sup> And indeed, it is a mighty<sup foot_note=197284>3</sup> Book.

entries.text: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.

entries.text: Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.
entries.originalHtml: Nothing is said to you, [O Muḥammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful penalty.

entries.text: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.
entries.originalHtml: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, "Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?" Say, "It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure." And those who do not believe - in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.<sup foot_note=197287>1</sup>

entries.text: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word [i.e., decree] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.
entries.originalHtml: And We had already given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement.<sup foot_note=197289>1</sup> And if not for a word [i.e., decree]<sup foot_note=197288>2</sup> that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are, concerning it [i.e., the Qur’ān], in disquieting doubt.

entries.text: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever does righteousness - it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.

entries.text: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."
entries.originalHtml: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, "Where are My 'partners'?" they will say, "We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that]."

entries.text: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.
entries.originalHtml: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.

entries.text: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
entries.originalHtml: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.

entries.text: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, "This is [due] to me,<sup foot_note=197290>1</sup> and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best." But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.

entries.text: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.
entries.originalHtml: And when We bestow favor upon man, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.

entries.text: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"

entries.text: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?
entries.originalHtml: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.<sup foot_note=197292>1</sup> But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?<sup foot_note=197291>2</sup>

entries.text: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.
entries.originalHtml: Unquestionably, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Unquestionably He is, of all things, encompassing.

entries.text: Ḥā, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ḥā, Meem.

entries.text: ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.
entries.originalHtml: ʿAyn, Seen, Qāf.<sup foot_note=197293>1</sup>

entries.text: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and to those before you - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.
entries.originalHtml: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.<sup foot_note=197294>1</sup>

entries.text: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: The heavens almost break from above them,<sup foot_note=197295>1</sup> and the angels exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Unquestionably, it is Allāh who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

entries.text: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager.
entries.originalHtml: And those who take as allies other than Him - Allāh is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muḥammad], are not over them a manager.

entries.text: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
entries.originalHtml: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it<sup foot_note=197296>1</sup> and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.

entries.text: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
entries.originalHtml: And if Allāh willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills<sup foot_note=197297>1</sup> into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.

entries.text: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides Him? But Allāh - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.

entries.text: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."
entries.originalHtml: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allāh. [Say], "That is Allāh, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."<sup foot_note=197298>1</sup>

entries.text: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,<sup foot_note=197300>1</sup> and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.<sup foot_note=197299>2</sup>

entries.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.

entries.text: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
entries.originalHtml: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with Allāh is that to which you invite them. Allāh chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].

entries.text: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.
entries.originalHtml: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word<sup foot_note=197301>1</sup> that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

entries.text: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad], and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no [need for] argument between us and you. Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."
entries.originalHtml: So to that [religion of Allāh] invite, [O Muḥammad],<sup foot_note=197304>1</sup> and remain on a right course as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, "I have believed in what Allāh has revealed of scripture [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. Allāh is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds.<sup foot_note=197303>2</sup> There is no [need for] argument between us and you.<sup foot_note=197302>3</sup> Allāh will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination."

entries.text: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And those who argue concerning Allāh after He has been responded to<sup foot_note=197305>1</sup> - their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.

entries.text: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.

entries.text: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
entries.originalHtml: Those who do not believe in it are impatient for it,<sup foot_note=197306>1</sup> but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Unquestionably, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.

entries.text: Allāh is Subtle with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh is Subtle<sup foot_note=197307>1</sup> with His servants; He gives provision to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

entries.text: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.

entries.text: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which Allāh has not consented? But if not for the decisive word,<sup foot_note=197308>1</sup> it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.

entries.text: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.

entries.text: It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.
entries.originalHtml: It is that of which Allāh gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship." And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Appreciative.<sup foot_note=197309>1</sup>

entries.text: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart. And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
entries.originalHtml: Or do they say, "He has invented about Allāh a lie"? But if Allāh willed, He could seal over your heart.<sup foot_note=197310>1</sup> And Allāh eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.text: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

entries.text: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.

entries.text: And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: And if Allāh had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Aware and Seeing.

entries.text: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

entries.text: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.

entries.text: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
entries.originalHtml: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.

entries.text: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.
entries.originalHtml: And you will not cause failure [to Allāh]<sup foot_note=197311>1</sup> upon the earth. And you have not besides Allāh any protector or helper.

entries.text: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
entries.originalHtml: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.

entries.text: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
entries.originalHtml: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.

entries.text: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
entries.originalHtml: Or He could destroy them<sup foot_note=197312>1</sup> for what they earned; but He pardons much.

entries.text: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
entries.originalHtml: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.

entries.text: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
entries.originalHtml: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allāh is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely

entries.text: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
entries.originalHtml: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,

entries.text: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,
entries.originalHtml: And those who have responded to their Lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,

entries.text: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].
entries.originalHtml: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they retaliate [in a just manner].<sup foot_note=197313>1</sup>

entries.text: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allāh. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.

entries.text: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
entries.originalHtml: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].

entries.text: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.

entries.text: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.<sup foot_note=197314>1</sup>

entries.text: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
entries.originalHtml: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"

entries.text: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
entries.originalHtml: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."

entries.text: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
entries.originalHtml: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.

entries.text: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.
entries.originalHtml: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.<sup foot_note=197315>1</sup>

entries.text: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
entries.originalHtml: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.

entries.text: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
entries.originalHtml: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.

entries.text: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
entries.originalHtml: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.

entries.text: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.

entries.text: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
entries.originalHtml: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -

entries.text: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
entries.originalHtml: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].

entries.text: Ḥā, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197316>1</sup>

entries.text: By the clear Book,
entries.originalHtml: By the clear Book,

entries.text: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.

entries.text: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book<sup foot_note=197318>1</sup> with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.<sup foot_note=197317>2</sup>

entries.text: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
entries.originalHtml: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?

entries.text: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
entries.originalHtml: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,

entries.text: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
entries.originalHtml: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.

entries.text: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
entries.originalHtml: And We destroyed greater than them<sup foot_note=197319>1</sup> in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.

entries.text: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
entries.originalHtml: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"

entries.text: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
entries.originalHtml: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided

entries.text: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
entries.originalHtml: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -

entries.text: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
entries.originalHtml: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount

entries.text: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
entries.originalHtml: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.<sup foot_note=197320>1</sup>

entries.text: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
entries.originalHtml: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."

entries.text: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
entries.originalHtml: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.<sup foot_note=197321>1</sup> Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.

entries.text: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
entries.originalHtml: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?

entries.text: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
entries.originalHtml: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

entries.text: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?
entries.originalHtml: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident<sup foot_note=197322>1</sup> [attributed to Allāh]?

entries.text: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
entries.originalHtml: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

entries.text: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
entries.originalHtml: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.

entries.text: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
entries.originalHtml: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?

entries.text: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
entries.originalHtml: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."

entries.text: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
entries.originalHtml: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."

entries.text: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
entries.originalHtml: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."

entries.text: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
entries.originalHtml: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship

entries.text: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
entries.originalHtml: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."

entries.text: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
entries.originalHtml: And he made it<sup foot_note=197323>1</sup> a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].

entries.text: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
entries.originalHtml: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers<sup foot_note=197325>1</sup> until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.<sup foot_note=197324>2</sup>

entries.text: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
entries.originalHtml: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."

entries.text: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
entries.originalHtml: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"<sup foot_note=197326>1</sup>

entries.text: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
entries.originalHtml: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.

entries.text: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
entries.originalHtml: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers],<sup foot_note=197327>1</sup> We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.

entries.text: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
entries.originalHtml: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

entries.text: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

entries.text: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.

entries.text: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided

entries.text: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
entries.originalHtml: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."

entries.text: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.

entries.text: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
entries.originalHtml: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?

entries.text: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
entries.originalHtml: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.

entries.text: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
entries.originalHtml: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.

entries.text: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.

entries.text: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it is a remembrance<sup foot_note=197328>1</sup> for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.

entries.text: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
entries.originalHtml: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?

entries.text: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
entries.originalHtml: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."

entries.text: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
entries.originalHtml: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.

entries.text: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
entries.originalHtml: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].

entries.text: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
entries.originalHtml: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."

entries.text: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
entries.originalHtml: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.

entries.text: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
entries.originalHtml: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?

entries.text: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
entries.originalHtml: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?<sup foot_note=197329>1</sup>

entries.text: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
entries.originalHtml: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"

entries.text: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].

entries.text: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
entries.originalHtml: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.

entries.text: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
entries.originalHtml: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.

entries.text: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
entries.originalHtml: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example,<sup foot_note=197330>1</sup> immediately your people laughed aloud.

entries.text: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
entries.originalHtml: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"<sup foot_note=197331>1</sup> They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.

entries.text: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
entries.originalHtml: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

entries.text: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
entries.originalHtml: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another]<sup foot_note=197332>1</sup> on the earth.

entries.text: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.<sup foot_note=197333>1</sup> This is a straight path.

entries.text: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
entries.originalHtml: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.

entries.text: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."

entries.text: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
entries.originalHtml: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.

entries.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
entries.originalHtml: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?

entries.text: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
entries.originalHtml: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous

entries.text: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
entries.originalHtml: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,

entries.text: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
entries.originalHtml: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.

entries.text: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
entries.originalHtml: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,<sup foot_note=197334>1</sup> delighted."

entries.text: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
entries.originalHtml: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.

entries.text: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
entries.originalHtml: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.

entries.text: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
entries.originalHtml: For you therein is much fruit<sup foot_note=197335>1</sup> from which you will eat.

entries.text: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.

entries.text: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
entries.originalHtml: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.

entries.text: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.

entries.text: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
entries.originalHtml: And they will call, "O Mālik,<sup foot_note=197336>1</sup> let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."

entries.text: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
entries.originalHtml: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.

entries.text: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
entries.originalHtml: Or have they devised [some] affair?<sup foot_note=197337>1</sup> But indeed, We are devising [a plan].

entries.text: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
entries.originalHtml: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."<sup foot_note=197338>1</sup>

entries.text: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
entries.originalHtml: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

entries.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
entries.originalHtml: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.

entries.text: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.

entries.text: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
entries.originalHtml: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.

entries.text: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
entries.originalHtml: And those they invoke<sup foot_note=197340>1</sup> besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.<sup foot_note=197339>2</sup>

entries.text: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
entries.originalHtml: And if you asked them<sup foot_note=197341>1</sup> who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?

entries.text: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
entries.originalHtml: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying,<sup foot_note=197342>1</sup> "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."

entries.text: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
entries.originalHtml: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."<sup foot_note=197343>1</sup> But they are going to know.

entries.text: Ḥā, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197344>1</sup>

entries.text: By the clear Book,
entries.originalHtml: By the clear Book,

entries.text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night.<sup foot_note=197345>1</sup> Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

entries.text: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -
entries.originalHtml: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct<sup foot_note=197346>1</sup> every precise matter -

entries.text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
entries.originalHtml: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

entries.text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
entries.originalHtml: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,

entries.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
entries.originalHtml: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

entries.text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
entries.originalHtml: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

entries.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
entries.originalHtml: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

entries.text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
entries.originalHtml: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke

entries.text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
entries.originalHtml: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

entries.text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
entries.originalHtml: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

entries.text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
entries.originalHtml: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

entries.text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
entries.originalHtml: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

entries.text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

entries.text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
entries.originalHtml: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

entries.text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
entries.originalHtml: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],

entries.text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
entries.originalHtml: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh.<sup foot_note=197347>1</sup> Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

entries.text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
entries.originalHtml: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.

entries.text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.<sup foot_note=197348>1</sup>

entries.text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
entries.originalHtml: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

entries.text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
entries.originalHtml: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

entries.text: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

entries.text: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
entries.originalHtml: And leave the sea in stillness.<sup foot_note=197349>1</sup> Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

entries.text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
entries.originalHtml: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

entries.text: And crops and noble sites
entries.originalHtml: And crops and noble sites

entries.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.
entries.originalHtml: And comfort wherein they were amused.

entries.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
entries.originalHtml: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

entries.text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
entries.originalHtml: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

entries.text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
entries.originalHtml: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

entries.text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
entries.originalHtml: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

entries.text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

entries.text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
entries.originalHtml: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

entries.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

entries.text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
entries.originalHtml: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

entries.text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
entries.originalHtml: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ<sup foot_note=197350>1</sup> and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

entries.text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
entries.originalHtml: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

entries.text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
entries.originalHtml: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

entries.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

entries.text: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
entries.originalHtml: The Day when no relation<sup foot_note=197351>1</sup> will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

entries.text: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

entries.text: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm

entries.text: Is food for the sinful.
entries.originalHtml: Is food for the sinful.

entries.text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
entries.originalHtml: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

entries.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.
entries.originalHtml: Like the boiling of scalding water.

entries.text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
entries.originalHtml: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

entries.text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
entries.originalHtml: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

entries.text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
entries.originalHtml: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!<sup foot_note=197352>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

entries.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:

entries.text: Within gardens and springs,
entries.originalHtml: Within gardens and springs,

entries.text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
entries.originalHtml: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

entries.text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
entries.originalHtml: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

entries.text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
entries.originalHtml: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

entries.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
entries.originalHtml: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

entries.text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
entries.originalHtml: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

entries.text: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.

entries.text: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
entries.originalHtml: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
