entries.text: Ḥā, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197353>1</sup>

entries.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.

entries.text: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].

entries.text: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
entries.originalHtml: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

entries.text: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?
entries.originalHtml: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?

entries.text: Woe to every sinful liar
entries.originalHtml: Woe to every sinful liar

entries.text: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.

entries.text: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.

entries.text: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Before them<sup foot_note=197354>1</sup> is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.

entries.text: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
entries.originalHtml: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.

entries.text: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

entries.text: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
entries.originalHtml: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people<sup foot_note=197355>1</sup> for what they used to earn.

entries.text: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.

entries.text: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement<sup foot_note=197356>1</sup> and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.

entries.text: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
entries.originalHtml: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

entries.text: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
entries.originalHtml: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.

entries.text: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.

entries.text: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
entries.originalHtml: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].

entries.text: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
entries.originalHtml: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death?<sup foot_note=197357>1</sup> Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].

entries.text: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.

entries.text: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
entries.originalHtml: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge<sup foot_note=197358>1</sup> and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?

entries.text: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live,<sup foot_note=197359>1</sup> and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.

entries.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."

entries.text: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.

entries.text: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
entries.originalHtml: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.

entries.text: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
entries.originalHtml: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed<sup foot_note=197360>1</sup> whatever you used to do."

entries.text: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
entries.originalHtml: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.

entries.text: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?
entries.originalHtml: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?

entries.text: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
entries.originalHtml: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"

entries.text: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
entries.originalHtml: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

entries.text: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
entries.originalHtml: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.

entries.text: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].

entries.text: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: Ḥā, Meem.
entries.originalHtml: Ḥā, Meem.<sup foot_note=197361>1</sup>

entries.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
entries.originalHtml: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
entries.originalHtml: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.

entries.text: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
entries.originalHtml: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.

entries.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
entries.originalHtml: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."

entries.text: Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: Or do they say, "He has invented it"? Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allāh at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved.<sup foot_note=197362>1</sup> Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

entries.text: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers,<sup foot_note=197363>1</sup> nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."

entries.text: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from Allāh, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar<sup foot_note=197365>1</sup> and believed while you were arrogant...?"<sup foot_note=197364>2</sup> Indeed, Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

entries.text: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
entries.originalHtml: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."

entries.text: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.

entries.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allāh," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.

entries.text: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.

entries.text: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
entries.originalHtml: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me<sup foot_note=197366>1</sup> to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."

entries.text: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.

entries.text: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -
entries.originalHtml: But one who says to his parents, "Uff<sup foot_note=197367>1</sup> to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allāh for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former peoples" -

entries.text: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
entries.originalHtml: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.

entries.text: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
entries.originalHtml: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.

entries.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
entries.originalHtml: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."

entries.text: And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
entries.originalHtml: And mention, [O Muḥammad], the brother of ʿAad,<sup foot_note=197369>1</sup> when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Aḥqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allāh. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."<sup foot_note=197368>2</sup>

entries.text: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."

entries.text: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
entries.originalHtml: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allāh, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."

entries.text: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
entries.originalHtml: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient:<sup foot_note=197370>1</sup> a wind, within it a painful punishment,

entries.text: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
entries.originalHtml: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.

entries.text: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
entries.originalHtml: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allāh; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

entries.text: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
entries.originalHtml: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].

entries.text: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
entries.originalHtml: Then why did those they took besides Allāh as deities by which to approach [Him]<sup foot_note=197371>1</sup> not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen attentively." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.

entries.text: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.

entries.text: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of Allāh<sup foot_note=197372>1</sup> and believe in him; He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.

entries.text: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
entries.originalHtml: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allāh will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."

entries.text: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: Do they not see that Allāh, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.

entries.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."
entries.originalHtml: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment for what you used to deny."<sup foot_note=197373>1</sup>

entries.text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
entries.originalHtml: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them.<sup foot_note=197374>1</sup> It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.
entries.originalHtml: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allāh - He will waste their deeds.<sup foot_note=197375>1</sup>

entries.text: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
entries.originalHtml: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muḥammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

entries.text: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allāh present to the people their comparisons.
entries.originalHtml: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allāh present to the people their comparisons.<sup foot_note=197376>1</sup>

entries.text: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.
entries.originalHtml: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure [their] bonds,<sup foot_note=197379>1</sup> and either [confer] favor<sup foot_note=197378>2</sup> afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens.<sup foot_note=197377>3</sup> That [is the command]. And if Allāh had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allāh - never will He waste their deeds.

entries.text: He will guide them and amend their condition
entries.originalHtml: He will guide them and amend their condition

entries.text: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
entries.originalHtml: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

entries.text: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, if you support Allāh, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

entries.text: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.
entries.originalHtml: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

entries.text: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
entries.originalHtml: That is because they disliked what Allāh revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

entries.text: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allāh destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
entries.originalHtml: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allāh destroyed [everything] over them,<sup foot_note=197380>1</sup> and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

entries.text: That is because Allāh is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.
entries.originalHtml: That is because Allāh is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

entries.text: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.
entries.originalHtml: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

entries.text: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
entries.originalHtml: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

entries.text: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
entries.originalHtml: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered,<sup foot_note=197381>1</sup> rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord... [Are its inhabitants] like those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

entries.text: And among them, [O Muḥammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allāh has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
entries.originalHtml: And among them, [O Muḥammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge,<sup foot_note=197382>1</sup> "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allāh has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

entries.text: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
entries.originalHtml: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.<sup foot_note=197383>1</sup>

entries.text: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?
entries.originalHtml: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

entries.text: So know, [O Muḥammad], that there is no deity except Allāh and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allāh knows of your movement and your resting place.
entries.originalHtml: So know, [O Muḥammad], that there is no deity except Allāh and ask forgiveness for your sin<sup foot_note=197384>1</sup> and for the believing men and believing women. And Allāh knows of your movement and your resting place.

entries.text: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]
entries.originalHtml: Those who believe say, "Why has a sūrah<sup foot_note=197386>1</sup> not been sent down?" But when a precise sūrah is revealed and battle is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them<sup foot_note=197385>2</sup> [would have been]

entries.text: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.
entries.originalHtml: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allāh, it would have been better for them.

entries.text: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
entries.originalHtml: So would you perhaps, if you turned away,<sup foot_note=197387>1</sup> cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

entries.text: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
entries.originalHtml: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allāh has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

entries.text: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
entries.originalHtml: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

entries.text: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

entries.text: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allāh knows what they conceal.
entries.originalHtml: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allāh sent down,<sup foot_note=197388>1</sup> "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allāh knows what they conceal.

entries.text: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
entries.originalHtml: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

entries.text: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
entries.originalHtml: That is because they followed what angered Allāh and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

entries.text: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
entries.originalHtml: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allāh would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

entries.text: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.
entries.originalHtml: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allāh knows your deeds.

entries.text: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
entries.originalHtml: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allāh] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

entries.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allāh at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allāh at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.

entries.text: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, obey Allāh and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

entries.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allāh forgive them.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allāh and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allāh forgive them.

entries.text: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
entries.originalHtml: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allāh is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

entries.text: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allāh, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.
entries.originalHtml: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allāh, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

entries.text: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].
entries.originalHtml: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your hatred [i.e., unwillingness].

entries.text: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
entries.originalHtml: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allāh - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allāh is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muḥammad], a clear conquest<sup foot_note=197389>1</sup>

entries.text: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
entries.originalHtml: That Allāh may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path

entries.text: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.
entries.originalHtml: And [that] Allāh may aid you with a mighty victory.

entries.text: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who sent down tranquility into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allāh Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment
entries.originalHtml: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allāh, a great attainment

entries.text: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
entries.originalHtml: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allāh an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allāh has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.

entries.text: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner

entries.text: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.
entries.originalHtml: That you [people] may believe in Allāh and His Messenger and honor him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] and exalt Him [i.e., Allāh] morning and afternoon.

entries.text: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand of Allāh is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allāh. The hand<sup foot_note=197391>1</sup> of Allāh is over their hands.<sup foot_note=197390>2</sup> So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allāh - He will give him a great reward.

entries.text: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.
entries.originalHtml: Those who remained behind<sup foot_note=197392>1</sup> of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allāh at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allāh, of what you do, Aware.

entries.text: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."
entries.originalHtml: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."

entries.text: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever has not believed in Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.

entries.text: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.
entries.originalHtml: Those who remained<sup foot_note=197394>1</sup> behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allāh. Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allāh say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.<sup foot_note=197393>2</sup>

entries.text: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
entries.originalHtml: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit.<sup foot_note=197395>1</sup> So if you obey, Allāh will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."

entries.text: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allāh and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.

entries.text: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
entries.originalHtml: Certainly was Allāh pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muḥammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquility upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest<sup foot_note=197396>1</sup>

entries.text: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allāh Exalted in Might and Wise.

entries.text: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.

entries.text: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed. And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.
entries.originalHtml: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allāh has already encompassed.<sup foot_note=197397>1</sup> And ever is Allāh, over all things, competent.

entries.text: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
entries.originalHtml: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.

entries.text: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] the established way of Allāh which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allāh any change.

entries.text: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

entries.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
entries.originalHtml: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering<sup foot_note=197398>1</sup> was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

entries.text: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

entries.text: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
entries.originalHtml: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened,<sup foot_note=197399>1</sup> not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].

entries.text: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.

entries.text: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allāh; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] pleasure. Their sign is in their faces from the effect of prostration [i.e., prayer]. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that He [i.e., Allāh] may enrage by them<sup foot_note=197400>1</sup> the disbelievers. Allāh has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
