entries.text: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allāh and His Messenger<sup foot_note=197401>1</sup> but fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.

entries.text: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allāh - they are the ones whose hearts Allāh has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.

entries.text: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muḥammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.

entries.text: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.

entries.text: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
entries.originalHtml: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allāh. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allāh has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.

entries.text: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] as bounty from Allāh and favor. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.
entries.originalHtml: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allāh. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

entries.text: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.
entries.originalHtml: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allāh that you may receive mercy.

entries.text: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

entries.text: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Merciful.

entries.text: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.
entries.originalHtml: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allāh is the most righteous<sup foot_note=197402>1</sup> of you. Indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Aware.

entries.text: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allāh and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds<sup foot_note=197403>1</sup> of anything. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful."

entries.text: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.
entries.originalHtml: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allāh and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allāh. It is those who are the truthful.

entries.text: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Would you acquaint Allāh with your religion while Allāh knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allāh is Knowing of all things?"

entries.text: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, "Do not consider your Islām a favor to me. Rather, Allāh has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh is Seeing of what you do.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Qāf. By the honored Qur’ān...
entries.originalHtml: Qāf.<sup foot_note=197405>1</sup> By the honored Qur’ān...<sup foot_note=197404>2</sup>

entries.text: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
entries.originalHtml: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

entries.text: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
entries.originalHtml: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."

entries.text: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
entries.originalHtml: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

entries.text: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
entries.originalHtml: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

entries.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
entries.originalHtml: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

entries.text: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
entries.originalHtml: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

entries.text: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].

entries.text: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
entries.originalHtml: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

entries.text: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
entries.originalHtml: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

entries.text: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
entries.originalHtml: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].

entries.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
entries.originalHtml: The people of Noah denied before them,<sup foot_note=197407>1</sup> and the companions of the well<sup foot_note=197406>2</sup> and Thamūd

entries.text: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
entries.originalHtml: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot

entries.text: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
entries.originalHtml: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

entries.text: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
entries.originalHtml: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

entries.text: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
entries.originalHtml: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer<sup foot_note=197408>1</sup> to him than [his] jugular vein.

entries.text: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
entries.originalHtml: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,<sup foot_note=197409>1</sup> seated on the right and on the left.

entries.text: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
entries.originalHtml: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

entries.text: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
entries.originalHtml: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

entries.text: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
entries.originalHtml: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

entries.text: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
entries.originalHtml: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.<sup foot_note=197410>1</sup>

entries.text: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
entries.originalHtml: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,<sup foot_note=197411>1</sup> so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

entries.text: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
entries.originalHtml: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

entries.text: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

entries.text: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
entries.originalHtml: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

entries.text: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
entries.originalHtml: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

entries.text: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
entries.originalHtml: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

entries.text: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].

entries.text: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
entries.originalHtml: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

entries.text: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
entries.originalHtml: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

entries.text: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
entries.originalHtml: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

entries.text: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
entries.originalHtml: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].

entries.text: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
entries.originalHtml: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

entries.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
entries.originalHtml: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

entries.text: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
entries.originalHtml: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

entries.text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
entries.originalHtml: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

entries.text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

entries.text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
entries.originalHtml: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

entries.text: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
entries.originalHtml: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

entries.text: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
entries.originalHtml: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

entries.text: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
entries.originalHtml: And listen on the Day when the Caller<sup foot_note=197412>1</sup> will call out from a place that is near -

entries.text: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
entries.originalHtml: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

entries.text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

entries.text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
entries.originalHtml: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

entries.text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
entries.originalHtml: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.<sup foot_note=197413>1</sup> But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]
entries.originalHtml: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

entries.text: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
entries.originalHtml: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

entries.text: And the ships sailing with ease
entries.originalHtml: And the ships sailing with ease

entries.text: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
entries.originalHtml: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

entries.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

entries.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

entries.text: By the heaven containing pathways,
entries.originalHtml: By the heaven containing pathways,<sup foot_note=197414>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, you are in differing speech.<sup foot_note=197415>1</sup>

entries.text: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
entries.originalHtml: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

entries.text: Destroyed are the misinformers
entries.originalHtml: Destroyed are the misinformers<sup foot_note=197416>1</sup>

entries.text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
entries.originalHtml: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

entries.text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
entries.originalHtml: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

entries.text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

entries.text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
entries.originalHtml: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

entries.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

entries.text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
entries.originalHtml: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

entries.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,
entries.originalHtml: They used to sleep but little of the night,<sup foot_note=197417>1</sup>

entries.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
entries.originalHtml: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

entries.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
entries.originalHtml: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

entries.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
entries.originalHtml: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

entries.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
entries.originalHtml: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

entries.text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
entries.originalHtml: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

entries.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
entries.originalHtml: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

entries.text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
entries.originalHtml: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham?<sup foot_note=197418>1</sup> -

entries.text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
entries.originalHtml: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

entries.text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
entries.originalHtml: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

entries.text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
entries.originalHtml: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

entries.text: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
entries.originalHtml: And he felt from them apprehension.<sup foot_note=197419>1</sup> They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

entries.text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
entries.originalHtml: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

entries.text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

entries.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
entries.originalHtml: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

entries.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals<sup foot_note=197420>1</sup>

entries.text: To send down upon them stones of clay,
entries.originalHtml: To send down upon them stones of clay,

entries.text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
entries.originalHtml: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

entries.text: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
entries.originalHtml: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

entries.text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
entries.originalHtml: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.<sup foot_note=197421>1</sup>

entries.text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

entries.text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
entries.originalHtml: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.<sup foot_note=197422>1</sup>

entries.text: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
entries.originalHtml: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

entries.text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
entries.originalHtml: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

entries.text: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
entries.originalHtml: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.<sup foot_note=197423>1</sup>

entries.text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
entries.originalHtml: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

entries.text: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
entries.originalHtml: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

entries.text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
entries.originalHtml: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

entries.text: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
entries.originalHtml: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

entries.text: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
entries.originalHtml: And the heaven We constructed with strength,<sup foot_note=197424>1</sup> and indeed, We are [its] expander.

entries.text: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
entries.originalHtml: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

entries.text: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
entries.originalHtml: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

entries.text: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
entries.originalHtml: So flee to Allāh.<sup foot_note=197425>1</sup> Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

entries.text: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
entries.originalHtml: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

entries.text: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
entries.originalHtml: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

entries.text: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
entries.originalHtml: Did they suggest it to them?<sup foot_note=197426>1</sup> Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

entries.text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
entries.originalHtml: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

entries.text: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
entries.originalHtml: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

entries.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
entries.originalHtml: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

entries.text: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
entries.originalHtml: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

entries.text: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider,<sup foot_note=197427>1</sup> the firm possessor of strength.

entries.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

entries.text: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
entries.originalHtml: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: By the mount
entries.originalHtml: By the mount

entries.text: And [by] a Book inscribed
entries.originalHtml: And [by] a Book inscribed<sup foot_note=197428>1</sup>

entries.text: In parchment spread open
entries.originalHtml: In parchment spread open

entries.text: And [by] the frequented House
entries.originalHtml: And [by] the frequented House<sup foot_note=197429>1</sup>

entries.text: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
entries.originalHtml: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

entries.text: And [by] the sea set on fire,
entries.originalHtml: And [by] the sea set on fire,<sup foot_note=197430>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

entries.text: Of it there is no preventer.
entries.originalHtml: Of it there is no preventer.

entries.text: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
entries.originalHtml: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

entries.text: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
entries.originalHtml: And the mountains will pass on, departing<sup foot_note=197431>1</sup> -

entries.text: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
entries.originalHtml: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

entries.text: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
entries.originalHtml: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

entries.text: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
entries.originalHtml: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

entries.text: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
entries.originalHtml: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

entries.text: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
entries.originalHtml: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

entries.text: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
entries.originalHtml: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

entries.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

entries.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

entries.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
entries.originalHtml: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

entries.text: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
entries.originalHtml: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

entries.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
entries.originalHtml: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.<sup foot_note=197433>1</sup> Every person, for what he earned, is retained.<sup foot_note=197432>2</sup>

entries.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
entries.originalHtml: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

entries.text: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
entries.originalHtml: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

entries.text: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
entries.originalHtml: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

entries.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
entries.originalHtml: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

entries.text: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

entries.text: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
entries.originalHtml: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

entries.text: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, we used to supplicate<sup foot_note=197434>1</sup> Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

entries.text: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
entries.originalHtml: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

entries.text: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?
entries.originalHtml: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?<sup foot_note=197435>1</sup>

entries.text: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

entries.text: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
entries.originalHtml: Or do their minds<sup foot_note=197436>1</sup> command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

entries.text: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
entries.originalHtml: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

entries.text: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
entries.originalHtml: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

entries.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
entries.originalHtml: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

entries.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
entries.originalHtml: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

entries.text: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
entries.originalHtml: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

entries.text: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
entries.originalHtml: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

entries.text: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
entries.originalHtml: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

entries.text: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
entries.originalHtml: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

entries.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
entries.originalHtml: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

entries.text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
entries.originalHtml: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

entries.text: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
entries.originalHtml: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

entries.text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
entries.originalHtml: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling,<sup foot_note=197437>1</sup> they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

entries.text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
entries.originalHtml: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

entries.text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
entries.originalHtml: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

entries.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment<sup foot_note=197438>1</sup> before that, but most of them do not know.

entries.text: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
entries.originalHtml: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

entries.text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
entries.originalHtml: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: By the star when it descends,
entries.originalHtml: By the star when it descends,

entries.text: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
entries.originalHtml: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

entries.text: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
entries.originalHtml: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

entries.text: It is not but a revelation revealed,
entries.originalHtml: It is not but a revelation revealed,

entries.text: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
entries.originalHtml: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

entries.text: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
entries.originalHtml: One of soundness.<sup foot_note=197440>1</sup> And he rose to [his] true form<sup foot_note=197439>2</sup>

entries.text: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
entries.originalHtml: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.<sup foot_note=197441>1</sup>

entries.text: Then he approached and descended
entries.originalHtml: Then he approached and descended

entries.text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
entries.originalHtml: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

entries.text: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
entries.originalHtml: And he revealed to His Servant<sup foot_note=197442>1</sup> what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

entries.text: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
entries.originalHtml: The heart<sup foot_note=197443>1</sup> did not lie [about] what it saw.

entries.text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
entries.originalHtml: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

entries.text: And he certainly saw him in another descent
entries.originalHtml: And he certainly saw him in another descent<sup foot_note=197444>1</sup>

entries.text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
entries.originalHtml: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

entries.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
entries.originalHtml: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

entries.text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
entries.originalHtml: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].<sup foot_note=197445>1</sup>

entries.text: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
entries.originalHtml: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

entries.text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
entries.originalHtml: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

entries.text: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?
entries.originalHtml: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

entries.text: And Manāt, the third - the other one?
entries.originalHtml: And Manāt, the third - the other one?<sup foot_note=197446>1</sup>

entries.text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
entries.originalHtml: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

entries.text: That, then, is an unjust division.
entries.originalHtml: That, then, is an unjust division.<sup foot_note=197447>1</sup>

entries.text: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
entries.originalHtml: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

entries.text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
entries.originalHtml: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

entries.text: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
entries.originalHtml: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

entries.text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
entries.originalHtml: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

entries.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

entries.text: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
entries.originalHtml: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

entries.text: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
entries.originalHtml: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

entries.text: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
entries.originalHtml: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

entries.text: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
entries.originalHtml: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

entries.text: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
entries.originalHtml: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

entries.text: Have you seen the one who turned away
entries.originalHtml: Have you seen the one who turned away

entries.text: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
entries.originalHtml: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

entries.text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
entries.originalHtml: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?<sup foot_note=197448>1</sup>

entries.text: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
entries.originalHtml: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

entries.text: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
entries.originalHtml: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

entries.text: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
entries.originalHtml: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

entries.text: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
entries.originalHtml: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

entries.text: And that his effort is going to be seen -
entries.originalHtml: And that his effort is going to be seen -

entries.text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -
entries.originalHtml: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

entries.text: And that to your Lord is the finality
entries.originalHtml: And that to your Lord is the finality

entries.text: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
entries.originalHtml: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

entries.text: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
entries.originalHtml: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

entries.text: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
entries.originalHtml: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

entries.text: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
entries.originalHtml: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

entries.text: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.
entries.originalHtml: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

entries.text: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
entries.originalHtml: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

entries.text: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.
entries.originalHtml: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius<sup foot_note=197449>1</sup>.

entries.text: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.
entries.originalHtml: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.

entries.text: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -
entries.originalHtml: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

entries.text: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
entries.originalHtml: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

entries.text: And the overturned towns He hurled down.
entries.originalHtml: And the overturned towns<sup foot_note=197450>1</sup> He hurled down.

entries.text: And covered them by that which He covered.
entries.originalHtml: And covered them by that which He covered.<sup foot_note=197451>1</sup>

entries.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
entries.originalHtml: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

entries.text: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
entries.originalHtml: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

entries.text: The Approaching Day has approached.
entries.originalHtml: The Approaching Day has approached.

entries.text: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
entries.originalHtml: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

entries.text: Then at this statement do you wonder?
entries.originalHtml: Then at this statement do you wonder?

entries.text: And you laugh and do not weep
entries.originalHtml: And you laugh and do not weep

entries.text: While you are proudly sporting?
entries.originalHtml: While you are proudly sporting?<sup foot_note=197452>1</sup>

entries.text: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].
entries.originalHtml: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
entries.originalHtml: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].<sup foot_note=197453>1</sup>

entries.text: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
entries.originalHtml: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."<sup foot_note=197454>1</sup>

entries.text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
entries.originalHtml: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

entries.text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
entries.originalHtml: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

entries.text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
entries.originalHtml: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

entries.text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
entries.originalHtml: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller<sup foot_note=197455>1</sup> calls to something forbidding,

entries.text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
entries.originalHtml: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

entries.text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
entries.originalHtml: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

entries.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
entries.originalHtml: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

entries.text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
entries.originalHtml: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

entries.text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
entries.originalHtml: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

entries.text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
entries.originalHtml: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

entries.text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
entries.originalHtml: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

entries.text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
entries.originalHtml: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

entries.text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
entries.originalHtml: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

entries.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
entries.originalHtml: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.<sup foot_note=197456>1</sup>

entries.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

entries.text: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
entries.originalHtml: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

entries.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

entries.text: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
entries.originalHtml: Extracting the people<sup foot_note=197457>1</sup> as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

entries.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
entries.originalHtml: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

entries.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

entries.text: Thamūd denied the warning.
entries.originalHtml: Thamūd denied the warning.

entries.text: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
entries.originalHtml: And said, "Is it one human being<sup foot_note=197458>1</sup> among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

entries.text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
entries.originalHtml: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

entries.text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
entries.originalHtml: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

entries.text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.<sup foot_note=197459>1</sup>

entries.text: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
entries.originalHtml: And inform them that the water is shared between them,<sup foot_note=197460>1</sup> each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

entries.text: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
entries.originalHtml: But they called their companion,<sup foot_note=197462>1</sup> and he dared<sup foot_note=197461>2</sup> and hamstrung [her].

entries.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
entries.originalHtml: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

entries.text: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

entries.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

entries.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.
entries.originalHtml: The people of Lot denied the warning.

entries.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

entries.text: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
entries.originalHtml: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

entries.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
entries.originalHtml: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

entries.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
entries.originalHtml: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

entries.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

entries.text: So taste My punishment and warning.
entries.originalHtml: So taste My punishment and warning.

entries.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

entries.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
entries.originalHtml: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

entries.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
entries.originalHtml: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

entries.text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
entries.originalHtml: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

entries.text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
entries.originalHtml: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

entries.text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
entries.originalHtml: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].<sup foot_note=197463>1</sup>

entries.text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
entries.originalHtml: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

entries.text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.<sup foot_note=197464>1</sup>.

entries.text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
entries.originalHtml: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."<sup foot_note=197465>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

entries.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
entries.originalHtml: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

entries.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
entries.originalHtml: And We have already destroyed your kinds,<sup foot_note=197466>1</sup> so is there any who will remember?

entries.text: And everything they did is in written records.
entries.originalHtml: And everything they did is in written records.

entries.text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
entries.originalHtml: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

entries.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

entries.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
entries.originalHtml: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.<sup foot_note=197467>1</sup>

entries.text: The Most Merciful
entries.originalHtml: The Most Merciful

entries.text: Taught the Qur’ān,
entries.originalHtml: Taught the Qur’ān,

entries.text: Created man,
entries.originalHtml: Created man,

entries.text: [And] taught him eloquence.
entries.originalHtml: [And] taught him eloquence.

entries.text: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
entries.originalHtml: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

entries.text: And the stars and trees prostrate.
entries.originalHtml: And the stars and trees prostrate.<sup foot_note=197468>1</sup>

entries.text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
entries.originalHtml: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

entries.text: That you not transgress within the balance.
entries.originalHtml: That you not transgress within the balance.

entries.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
entries.originalHtml: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

entries.text: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
entries.originalHtml: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

entries.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
entries.originalHtml: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

entries.text: And grain having husks and scented plants.
entries.originalHtml: And grain having husks and scented plants.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?<sup foot_note=197469>1</sup>

entries.text: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
entries.originalHtml: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

entries.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
entries.originalHtml: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
entries.originalHtml: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.<sup foot_note=197470>1</sup>

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];
entries.originalHtml: He released the two seas,<sup foot_note=197471>1</sup> meeting [one another];

entries.text: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
entries.originalHtml: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
entries.originalHtml: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
entries.originalHtml: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
entries.originalHtml: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

entries.text: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
entries.originalHtml: And there will remain the Face<sup foot_note=197472>1</sup> of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
entries.originalHtml: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.<sup foot_note=197473>1</sup>

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
entries.originalHtml: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.<sup foot_note=197474>1</sup>

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].
entries.originalHtml: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
entries.originalHtml: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke,<sup foot_note=197475>1</sup> and you will not defend yourselves.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
entries.originalHtml: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil<sup foot_note=197476>1</sup> -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
entries.originalHtml: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.<sup foot_note=197477>1</sup>

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
entries.originalHtml: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
entries.originalHtml: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

entries.text: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
entries.originalHtml: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
entries.originalHtml: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord<sup foot_note=197478>1</sup> are two gardens -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: Having [spreading] branches.
entries.originalHtml: Having [spreading] branches.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
entries.originalHtml: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
entries.originalHtml: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
entries.originalHtml: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
entries.originalHtml: In them are women limiting [their] glances,<sup foot_note=197480>1</sup> untouched<sup foot_note=197479>2</sup> before them by man or jinnī -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: As if they were rubies and coral.
entries.originalHtml: As if they were rubies and coral.<sup foot_note=197481>1</sup>

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
entries.originalHtml: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
entries.originalHtml: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: Dark green [in color].
entries.originalHtml: Dark green [in color].

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
entries.originalHtml: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
entries.originalHtml: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: In them are good and beautiful women -
entries.originalHtml: In them are good and beautiful women -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
entries.originalHtml: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
entries.originalHtml: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

entries.text: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
entries.originalHtml: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

entries.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
entries.originalHtml: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

entries.text: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
entries.originalHtml: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
