entries.text: When the Occurrence occurs,
entries.originalHtml: When the Occurrence occurs,

entries.text: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
entries.originalHtml: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

entries.text: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
entries.originalHtml: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].<sup foot_note=197482>1</sup>

entries.text: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
entries.originalHtml: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

entries.text: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
entries.originalHtml: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

entries.text: And become dust dispersing,
entries.originalHtml: And become dust dispersing,

entries.text: And you become [of] three kinds:
entries.originalHtml: And you become [of] three kinds:

entries.text: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
entries.originalHtml: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?<sup foot_note=197483>1</sup>

entries.text: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?
entries.originalHtml: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?<sup foot_note=197484>1</sup>

entries.text: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
entries.originalHtml: And the forerunners, the forerunners<sup foot_note=197485>1</sup> -

entries.text: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]
entries.originalHtml: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

entries.text: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
entries.originalHtml: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

entries.text: A [large] company of the former peoples
entries.originalHtml: A [large] company of the former peoples

entries.text: And a few of the later peoples,
entries.originalHtml: And a few of the later peoples,

entries.text: On thrones woven [with ornament],
entries.originalHtml: On thrones woven [with ornament],

entries.text: Reclining on them, facing each other.
entries.originalHtml: Reclining on them, facing each other.

entries.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.
entries.originalHtml: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.

entries.text: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
entries.originalHtml: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

entries.text: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
entries.originalHtml: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

entries.text: And fruit of what they select
entries.originalHtml: And fruit of what they select

entries.text: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
entries.originalHtml: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

entries.text: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
entries.originalHtml: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

entries.text: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
entries.originalHtml: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

entries.text: As reward for what they used to do.
entries.originalHtml: As reward for what they used to do.

entries.text: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
entries.originalHtml: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

entries.text: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.
entries.originalHtml: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.

entries.text: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
entries.originalHtml: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

entries.text: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.
entries.originalHtml: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.

entries.text: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].
entries.originalHtml: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].

entries.text: And shade extended.
entries.originalHtml: And shade extended.

entries.text: And water poured out
entries.originalHtml: And water poured out

entries.text: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
entries.originalHtml: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

entries.text: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
entries.originalHtml: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

entries.text: And [upon] beds raised high.
entries.originalHtml: And [upon] beds raised high.

entries.text: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation

entries.text: And made them virgins,
entries.originalHtml: And made them virgins,

entries.text: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
entries.originalHtml: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

entries.text: For the companions of the right [who are]
entries.originalHtml: For the companions of the right [who are]

entries.text: A company of the former peoples
entries.originalHtml: A company of the former peoples

entries.text: And a company of the later peoples.
entries.originalHtml: And a company of the later peoples.

entries.text: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
entries.originalHtml: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

entries.text: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
entries.originalHtml: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

entries.text: And a shade of black smoke,
entries.originalHtml: And a shade of black smoke,

entries.text: Neither cool nor beneficial.
entries.originalHtml: Neither cool nor beneficial.

entries.text: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

entries.text: And they used to persist in the great violation,
entries.originalHtml: And they used to persist in the great violation,<sup foot_note=197486>1</sup>

entries.text: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
entries.originalHtml: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

entries.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"
entries.originalHtml: And our forefathers [as well]?"

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples

entries.text: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
entries.originalHtml: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

entries.text: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
entries.originalHtml: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

entries.text: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
entries.originalHtml: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

entries.text: And filling with it your bellies
entries.originalHtml: And filling with it your bellies

entries.text: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.
entries.originalHtml: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.

entries.text: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
entries.originalHtml: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

entries.text: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
entries.originalHtml: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

entries.text: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
entries.originalHtml: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

entries.text: Have you seen that which you emit?
entries.originalHtml: Have you seen that which you emit?<sup foot_note=197487>1</sup>

entries.text: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
entries.originalHtml: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

entries.text: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
entries.originalHtml: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

entries.text: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
entries.originalHtml: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.<sup foot_note=197488>1</sup>

entries.text: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
entries.originalHtml: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

entries.text: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
entries.originalHtml: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

entries.text: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
entries.originalHtml: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

entries.text: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
entries.originalHtml: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,<sup foot_note=197489>1</sup>

entries.text: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
entries.originalHtml: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

entries.text: Rather, we have been deprived."
entries.originalHtml: Rather, we have been deprived."

entries.text: And have you seen the water that you drink?
entries.originalHtml: And have you seen the water that you drink?

entries.text: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
entries.originalHtml: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

entries.text: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
entries.originalHtml: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

entries.text: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
entries.originalHtml: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

entries.text: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
entries.originalHtml: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

entries.text: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
entries.originalHtml: We have made it a reminder<sup foot_note=197491>1</sup> and provision for the travelers,<sup foot_note=197490>2</sup>

entries.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
entries.originalHtml: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

entries.text: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
entries.originalHtml: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,<sup foot_note=197492>1</sup>

entries.text: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

entries.text: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.

entries.text: In a Register well-protected;.
entries.originalHtml: In a Register well-protected;<sup foot_note=197493>1</sup>.

entries.text: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
entries.originalHtml: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].

entries.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
entries.originalHtml: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

entries.text: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
entries.originalHtml: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

entries.text: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
entries.originalHtml: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat

entries.text: And you are at that time looking on -
entries.originalHtml: And you are at that time looking on -

entries.text: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
entries.originalHtml: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

entries.text: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
entries.originalHtml: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

entries.text: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
entries.originalHtml: Bring it back,<sup foot_note=197494>1</sup> if you should be truthful?

entries.text: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],
entries.originalHtml: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],

entries.text: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
entries.originalHtml: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

entries.text: And if he was of the companions of the right,
entries.originalHtml: And if he was of the companions of the right,

entries.text: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
entries.originalHtml: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

entries.text: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
entries.originalHtml: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

entries.text: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
entries.originalHtml: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

entries.text: And burning in Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: And burning in Hellfire.

entries.text: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

entries.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
entries.originalHtml: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

entries.text: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh,<sup foot_note=197495>1</sup> and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.

entries.text: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: He is the First<sup foot_note=197499>1</sup> and the Last,<sup foot_note=197498>2</sup> the Ascendant<sup foot_note=197497>3</sup> and the Intimate,<sup foot_note=197496>4</sup> and He is, of all things, Knowing.

entries.text: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne.<sup foot_note=197501>1</sup> He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you<sup foot_note=197500>2</sup> wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

entries.text: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
entries.originalHtml: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.

entries.text: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
entries.originalHtml: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.text: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent,<sup foot_note=197502>1</sup> there will be a great reward.

entries.text: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
entries.originalHtml: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?

entries.text: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.

entries.text: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.
entries.originalHtml: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.

entries.text: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
entries.originalHtml: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?

entries.text: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
entries.originalHtml: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.

entries.text: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
entries.originalHtml: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you<sup foot_note=197503>1</sup> and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.

entries.text: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.
entries.originalHtml: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves<sup foot_note=197504>1</sup> and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.

entries.text: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."
entries.originalHtml: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."

entries.text: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
entries.originalHtml: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.<sup foot_note=197505>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.

entries.text: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
entries.originalHtml: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light.<sup foot_note=197506>1</sup> But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.

entries.text: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
entries.originalHtml: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.

entries.text: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

entries.text: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -
entries.originalHtml: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register<sup foot_note=197507>1</sup> before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -

entries.text: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
entries.originalHtml: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -

entries.text: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away<sup foot_note=197508>1</sup> - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

entries.text: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
entries.originalHtml: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

entries.text: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: Then We sent following their footsteps [i.e., traditions] Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allāh. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: Then We sent following their footsteps [i.e., traditions] Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allāh. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allāh and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allāh<sup foot_note=197510>1</sup> and that [all] bounty is in the hand<sup foot_note=197509>2</sup> of Allāh; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

entries.text: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

entries.text: Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
entries.originalHtml: Those who pronounce ẓihār<sup foot_note=197511>1</sup> among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

entries.text: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.

entries.text: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively<sup foot_note=197512>1</sup> before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.

entries.text: Indeed, those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

entries.text: On the Day when Allāh will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allāh had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allāh is, over all things, Witness.
entries.originalHtml: On the Day when Allāh will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allāh had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allāh is, over all things, Witness.<sup foot_note=197513>1</sup>

entries.text: Have you not considered that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them,<sup foot_note=197514>1</sup> nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.

entries.text: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation [i.e., ridicule and conspiracy] and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allāh does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allāh not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation [i.e., ridicule and conspiracy] and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allāh does not greet you<sup foot_note=197515>1</sup> and say among themselves, "Why does Allāh not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allāh, to whom you will be gathered.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allāh, to whom you will be gathered.

entries.text: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
entries.originalHtml: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed,<sup foot_note=197516>1</sup> but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you.<sup foot_note=197518>1</sup> And when you are told, "Arise,"<sup foot_note=197517>2</sup> then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allāh has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allāh has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

entries.text: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

entries.text: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

entries.text: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
entries.originalHtml: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

entries.text: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
entries.originalHtml: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allāh at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally

entries.text: On the Day Allāh will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars.
entries.originalHtml: On the Day Allāh will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something.<sup foot_note=197519>1</sup> Unquestionably, it is they who are the liars.

entries.text: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allāh. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.
entries.originalHtml: Satan has overcome them and made them forget the remembrance of Allāh. Those are the party of Satan. Unquestionably, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.

entries.text: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allāh and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the ones who oppose Allāh and His Messenger - those will be among the most humbled.

entries.text: Allāh has written [i.e., decreed], "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has written [i.e., decreed], "I will surely overcome, I and My messengers." Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

entries.text: You will not find a people who believe in Allāh and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allāh is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allāh. Unquestionably, the party of Allāh - they are the successful.
entries.originalHtml: You will not find a people who believe in Allāh and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit<sup foot_note=197520>1</sup> from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Allāh is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of Allāh. Unquestionably, the party of Allāh - they are the successful.

entries.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh,<sup foot_note=197521>1</sup> and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allāh; but [the decree of] Allāh came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture<sup foot_note=197523>1</sup> from their homes at the first gathering.<sup foot_note=197522>2</sup> You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from Allāh; but [the decree of] Allāh came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the believers. So take warning, O people of vision.

entries.text: And if not that Allāh had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.
entries.originalHtml: And if not that Allāh had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.

entries.text: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
entries.originalHtml: That is because they opposed Allāh and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allāh - then indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

entries.text: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of Allāh and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: And what Allāh restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but Allāh gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: And what Allāh restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels,<sup foot_note=197524>1</sup> but Allāh gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and Allāh is over all things competent.

entries.text: And what Allāh restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allāh and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the needy and the [stranded] traveler - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.
entries.originalHtml: And what Allāh restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for Allāh and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives<sup foot_note=197526>1</sup> and orphans and the needy and the [stranded] traveler<sup foot_note=197525>2</sup> - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you - take; and what he has forbidden you - refrain from. And fear Allāh; indeed, Allāh is severe in penalty.

entries.text: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] approval and supporting [the cause of] Allāh and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.
entries.originalHtml: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from Allāh and [His] approval and supporting [the cause of] Allāh and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.

entries.text: And [also for] those who were settled in the Home [i.e.,al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
entries.originalHtml: And [also for] those who were settled in the Home [i.e.,al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them.<sup foot_note=197527>1</sup> They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

entries.text: And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."
entries.originalHtml: And [there is a share for] those who come after them, saying, "Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful."

entries.text: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers [i.e., associates] who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allāh testifies that they are liars.
entries.originalHtml: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers [i.e., associates] who have disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, "If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you." But Allāh testifies that they are liars.

entries.text: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided.
entries.originalHtml: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be aided.

entries.text: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allāh. That is because they are a people who do not understand.
entries.originalHtml: You [believers] are more fearful within their breasts than Allāh. That is because they are a people who do not understand.

entries.text: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence [i.e., enmity] among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason.
entries.originalHtml: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence [i.e., enmity] among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason.

entries.text: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

entries.text: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
entries.originalHtml: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to man, "Disbelieve." But when he disbelieves, he says, "Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear Allāh, Lord of the worlds."

entries.text: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.

entries.text: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, fear Allāh. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Aware of what you do.

entries.text: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.
entries.originalHtml: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.

entries.text: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].
entries.originalHtml: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].

entries.text: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
entries.originalHtml: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and splitting from fear of Allāh. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.

entries.text: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed.<sup foot_note=197528>1</sup> He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

entries.text: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Grantor of Security, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
entries.originalHtml: He is Allāh, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign,<sup foot_note=197536>1</sup> the Pure,<sup foot_note=197535>2</sup> the Perfection,<sup foot_note=197534>3</sup> the Grantor of Security,<sup foot_note=197533>4</sup> the Overseer,<sup foot_note=197532>5</sup> the Exalted in Might,<sup foot_note=197531>6</sup> the Compeller,<sup foot_note=197530>7</sup> the Superior.<sup foot_note=197529>8</sup> Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

entries.text: He is Allāh, the Creator, the Producer, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: He is Allāh, the Creator,<sup foot_note=197541>1</sup> the Producer,<sup foot_note=197540>2</sup> the Fashioner;<sup foot_note=197539>3</sup> to Him belong the best names.<sup foot_note=197538>4</sup> Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.<sup foot_note=197537>5</sup>

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allāh, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection [i.e., instruction], but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies,<sup foot_note=197542>1</sup> extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in Allāh, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My approval, [take them not as friends]. You confide to them affection [i.e., instruction], but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.

entries.text: If they gain dominance over you, they would be [i.e., behave] to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve.
entries.originalHtml: If they gain dominance over you, they would be [i.e., behave] to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve.

entries.text: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

entries.text: There has already been for you an excellent pattern in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allāh. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allāh alone" - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allāh. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: There has already been for you an excellent pattern<sup foot_note=197543>1</sup> in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, "Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than Allāh. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in Allāh alone" - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, "I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against Allāh. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.

entries.text: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
entries.originalHtml: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."

entries.text: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

entries.text: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent, and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Perhaps Allāh will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And Allāh is competent,<sup foot_note=197544>1</sup> and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Allāh does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, Allāh loves those who act justly.

entries.text: Allāh only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies<sup foot_note=197545>1</sup> of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers.

entries.text: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them. Allāh is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give them [i.e., the disbelievers] what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation [i.e., mahr]. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them [i.e., the disbelievers] ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of Allāh; He judges between you. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them. Allāh is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give them [i.e., the disbelievers] what they have spent.<sup foot_note=197547>1</sup> And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation [i.e., mahr]. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them [i.e., the disbelievers] ask for what they have spent.<sup foot_note=197546>2</sup> That is the judgement of Allāh; He judges between you. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.

entries.text: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.
entries.originalHtml: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something],<sup foot_note=197548>1</sup> then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.

entries.text: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allāh, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with Allāh, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs,<sup foot_note=197549>1</sup> nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the companions [i.e., inhabitants] of the graves.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry. They have despaired of [reward in] the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of [meeting] the companions [i.e., inhabitants] of the graves.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts Allāh,<sup foot_note=197550>1</sup> and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?

entries.text: Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.
entries.originalHtml: Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.

entries.text: Indeed, Allāh loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, Allāh loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.

entries.text: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allāh to you?" And when they deviated, Allāh caused their hearts to deviate. And Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
entries.originalHtml: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Moses said to his people, "O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of Allāh to you?" And when they deviated, Allāh caused their hearts to deviate. And Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

entries.text: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."
entries.originalHtml: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad."<sup foot_note=197552>1</sup> But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic."<sup foot_note=197551>2</sup>

entries.text: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
entries.originalHtml: And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allāh untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

entries.text: They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.
entries.originalHtml: They want to extinguish the light of Allāh with their mouths, but Allāh will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.

entries.text: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allāh dislike it.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with Allāh dislike it.

entries.text: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?

entries.text: [It is that] you believe in Allāh and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allāh with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew.
entries.originalHtml: [It is that] you believe in Allāh and His Messenger and strive in the cause of Allāh with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you only knew.

entries.text: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.
entries.originalHtml: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.

entries.text: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.
entries.originalHtml: And [you will obtain] another [favor] that you love - victory from Allāh and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the believers.

entries.text: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.

entries.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh,<sup foot_note=197554>1</sup> the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.<sup foot_note=197553>2</sup>

entries.text: It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -
entries.originalHtml: It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -

entries.text: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

entries.text: That is the bounty of Allāh, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
entries.originalHtml: That is the bounty of Allāh, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

entries.text: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.
entries.originalHtml: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on<sup foot_note=197556>1</sup> is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books].<sup foot_note=197555>2</sup> Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

entries.text: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

entries.text: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
entries.originalHtml: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

entries.text: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."

entries.text: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumuʿah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allāh and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumuʿah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allāh and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.

entries.text: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.
entries.originalHtml: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.

entries.text: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."
entries.originalHtml: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.
entries.originalHtml: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muḥammad], they say, "We testify that you are the Messenger of Allāh." And Allāh knows that you are His Messenger, and Allāh testifies that the hypocrites are liars.

entries.text: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
entries.originalHtml: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

entries.text: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.
entries.originalHtml: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.

entries.text: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allāh destroy them; how are they deluded?
entries.originalHtml: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up<sup foot_note=197557>1</sup> - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May Allāh destroy them; how are they deluded?

entries.text: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.
entries.originalHtml: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Messenger of Allāh will ask forgiveness for you," they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.

entries.text: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allāh forgive them. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
entries.originalHtml: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will Allāh forgive them. Indeed, Allāh does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.

entries.text: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband." And to Allāh belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.
entries.originalHtml: They are the ones who say, "Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of Allāh until they disband." And to Allāh belong the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.

entries.text: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
entries.originalHtml: They say, "If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honored [for power] will surely expel therefrom the more humble." And to Allāh belongs [all] honor, and to His Messenger, and to the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.

entries.text: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from the remembrance of Allāh. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.

entries.text: And spend [in the way of Allāh] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous."
entries.originalHtml: And spend [in the way of Allāh] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be of the righteous."

entries.text: But never will Allāh delay a soul when its time has come. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: But never will Allāh delay a soul when its time has come. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
entries.originalHtml: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh.<sup foot_note=197558>1</sup> To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.

entries.text: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

entries.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
entries.originalHtml: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

entries.text: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.
entries.originalHtml: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.text: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
entries.originalHtml: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

entries.text: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
entries.originalHtml: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

entries.text: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."
entries.originalHtml: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."

entries.text: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.
entries.originalHtml: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

entries.text: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
entries.originalHtml: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.<sup foot_note=197559>1</sup> And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.

entries.text: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

entries.text: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.
entries.originalHtml: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

entries.text: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
entries.originalHtml: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

entries.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

entries.text: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
