entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.

entries.text: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
entries.originalHtml: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

entries.text: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative and Forbearing,
entries.originalHtml: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative<sup foot_note=197561>1</sup> and Forbearing,<sup foot_note=197560>2</sup>

entries.text: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period,<sup foot_note=197563>1</sup> and fear Allāh, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And whoever transgresses the limits of Allāh has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allāh will bring about after that a [different] matter.<sup foot_note=197562>2</sup>

entries.text: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out
entries.originalHtml: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allāh. That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him a way out<sup foot_note=197564>1</sup>

entries.text: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
entries.originalHtml: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allāh - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allāh will accomplish His purpose. Allāh has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.

entries.text: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.
entries.originalHtml: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth.<sup foot_note=197565>1</sup> And whoever fears Allāh - He will make for him of his matter ease.

entries.text: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
entries.originalHtml: That is the command of Allāh, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allāh - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.

entries.text: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.
entries.originalHtml: Lodge them<sup foot_note=197568>1</sup> [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them.<sup foot_note=197567>2</sup> And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.<sup foot_note=197566>3</sup>

entries.text: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].
entries.originalHtml: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allāh has given him. Allāh does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allāh will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].

entries.text: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
entries.originalHtml: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.

entries.text: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.
entries.originalHtml: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.

entries.text: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allāh, O you of understanding who have believed. Allāh has sent down to you a message [i.e., the Qur’ān].<sup foot_note=197569>1</sup>

entries.text: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.
entries.originalHtml: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allāh that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allāh will have perfected for him a provision.

entries.text: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.
entries.originalHtml: It is Allāh who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them.<sup foot_note=197570>1</sup> [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allāh is over all things competent and that Allāh has encompassed all things in knowledge.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allāh has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
entries.originalHtml: Allāh has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths.<sup foot_note=197571>1</sup> And Allāh is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.

entries.text: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."
entries.originalHtml: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allāh showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Aware."

entries.text: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.
entries.originalHtml: If you two [wives] repent to Allāh, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allāh is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.

entries.text: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
entries.originalHtml: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allāh], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling<sup foot_note=197572>1</sup> - [ones] previously married and virgins.

entries.text: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allāh in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.

entries.text: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
entries.originalHtml: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.

entries.text: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
entries.originalHtml: O you who have believed, repent to Allāh with sincere repentance. Perhaps<sup foot_note=197573>1</sup> your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allāh will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."

entries.text: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

entries.text: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
entries.originalHtml: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them,<sup foot_note=197574>1</sup> so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."

entries.text: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

entries.text: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
entries.originalHtml: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
entries.originalHtml: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

entries.text: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
entries.originalHtml: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

entries.text: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
entries.originalHtml: [And] who created seven heavens in layers.<sup foot_note=197575>1</sup> You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

entries.text: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
entries.originalHtml: Then return [your] vision twice again.<sup foot_note=197576>1</sup> [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

entries.text: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
entries.originalHtml: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils<sup foot_note=197577>1</sup> and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

entries.text: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
entries.originalHtml: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

entries.text: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
entries.originalHtml: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

entries.text: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
entries.originalHtml: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

entries.text: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

entries.text: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
entries.originalHtml: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

entries.text: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
entries.originalHtml: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation<sup foot_note=197578>1</sup> for the companions of the Blaze.

entries.text: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

entries.text: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
entries.originalHtml: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

entries.text: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
entries.originalHtml: Does He who created not know,<sup foot_note=197579>1</sup> while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

entries.text: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
entries.originalHtml: It is He who made the earth tame<sup foot_note=197580>1</sup> for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

entries.text: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
entries.originalHtml: Do you feel secure that He who is above<sup foot_note=197582>1</sup> would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?<sup foot_note=197581>2</sup>

entries.text: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
entries.originalHtml: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

entries.text: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
entries.originalHtml: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

entries.text: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
entries.originalHtml: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

entries.text: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
entries.originalHtml: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

entries.text: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
entries.originalHtml: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

entries.text: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
entries.originalHtml: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

entries.text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

entries.text: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

entries.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
entries.originalHtml: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

entries.text: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

entries.text: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
entries.originalHtml: But when they see it<sup foot_note=197584>1</sup> approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."<sup foot_note=197583>2</sup>

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered:<sup foot_note=197585>1</sup> whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

entries.text: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

entries.text: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,
entries.originalHtml: Nūn.<sup foot_note=197586>1</sup> By the pen and what they inscribe,

entries.text: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
entries.originalHtml: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

entries.text: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

entries.text: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

entries.text: So you will see and they will see.
entries.originalHtml: So you will see and they will see.

entries.text: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
entries.originalHtml: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

entries.text: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

entries.text: Then do not obey the deniers.
entries.originalHtml: Then do not obey the deniers.

entries.text: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
entries.originalHtml: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

entries.text: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
entries.originalHtml: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

entries.text: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
entries.originalHtml: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

entries.text: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
entries.originalHtml: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

entries.text: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
entries.originalHtml: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.<sup foot_note=197587>1</sup>

entries.text: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
entries.originalHtml: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

entries.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
entries.originalHtml: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

entries.text: We will brand him upon the snout.
entries.originalHtml: We will brand him upon the snout.<sup foot_note=197588>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

entries.text: Without making exception.
entries.originalHtml: Without making exception.<sup foot_note=197589>1</sup>

entries.text: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
entries.originalHtml: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

entries.text: And it became as though reaped.
entries.originalHtml: And it became as though reaped.

entries.text: And they called one another at morning,
entries.originalHtml: And they called one another at morning,

entries.text: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
entries.originalHtml: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

entries.text: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
entries.originalHtml: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

entries.text: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
entries.originalHtml: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

entries.text: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
entries.originalHtml: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.<sup foot_note=197590>1</sup>

entries.text: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
entries.originalHtml: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

entries.text: Rather, we have been deprived."
entries.originalHtml: Rather, we have been deprived."

entries.text: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"
entries.originalHtml: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"<sup foot_note=197591>1</sup>

entries.text: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
entries.originalHtml: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

entries.text: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
entries.originalHtml: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

entries.text: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
entries.originalHtml: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

entries.text: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
entries.originalHtml: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."<sup foot_note=197592>1</sup>

entries.text: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
entries.originalHtml: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

entries.text: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

entries.text: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
entries.originalHtml: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

entries.text: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
entries.originalHtml: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

entries.text: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
entries.originalHtml: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

entries.text: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
entries.originalHtml: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

entries.text: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
entries.originalHtml: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

entries.text: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
entries.originalHtml: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

entries.text: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
entries.originalHtml: Or do they have partners?<sup foot_note=197593>1</sup> Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

entries.text: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
entries.originalHtml: The Day the shin will be uncovered<sup foot_note=197594>1</sup> and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,

entries.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
entries.originalHtml: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.<sup foot_note=197595>1</sup>

entries.text: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
entries.originalHtml: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.<sup foot_note=197596>1</sup>

entries.text: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
entries.originalHtml: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

entries.text: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
entries.originalHtml: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

entries.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
entries.originalHtml: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

entries.text: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
entries.originalHtml: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.

entries.text: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
entries.originalHtml: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.<sup foot_note=197597>1</sup>

entries.text: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

entries.text: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

entries.text: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: The Inevitable Reality -
entries.originalHtml: The Inevitable Reality -

entries.text: What is the Inevitable Reality?
entries.originalHtml: What is the Inevitable Reality?

entries.text: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
entries.originalHtml: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

entries.text: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
entries.originalHtml: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

entries.text: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
entries.originalHtml: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

entries.text: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
entries.originalHtml: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming,<sup foot_note=197598>1</sup> violent wind

entries.text: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
entries.originalHtml: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

entries.text: Then do you see of them any remains?
entries.originalHtml: Then do you see of them any remains?

entries.text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
entries.originalHtml: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities<sup foot_note=197599>1</sup> with sin.

entries.text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
entries.originalHtml: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

entries.text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship<sup foot_note=197600>1</sup>

entries.text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
entries.originalHtml: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

entries.text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
entries.originalHtml: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

entries.text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
entries.originalHtml: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

entries.text: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
entries.originalHtml: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

entries.text: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
entries.originalHtml: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.<sup foot_note=197601>1</sup>

entries.text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
entries.originalHtml: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

entries.text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
entries.originalHtml: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.<sup foot_note=197602>1</sup>

entries.text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
entries.originalHtml: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

entries.text: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

entries.text: So he will be in a pleasant life -
entries.originalHtml: So he will be in a pleasant life -

entries.text: In an elevated garden,
entries.originalHtml: In an elevated garden,

entries.text: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
entries.originalHtml: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

entries.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
entries.originalHtml: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth<sup foot_note=197603>1</sup> in the days past."

entries.text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
entries.originalHtml: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

entries.text: And had not known what is my account.
entries.originalHtml: And had not known what is my account.

entries.text: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
entries.originalHtml: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.<sup foot_note=197604>1</sup>

entries.text: My wealth has not availed me.
entries.originalHtml: My wealth has not availed me.

entries.text: Gone from me is my authority."
entries.originalHtml: Gone from me is my authority."<sup foot_note=197605>1</sup>

entries.text: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
entries.originalHtml: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

entries.text: Then into Hellfire drive him.
entries.originalHtml: Then into Hellfire drive him.

entries.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
entries.originalHtml: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

entries.text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

entries.text: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
entries.originalHtml: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

entries.text: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
entries.originalHtml: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

entries.text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
entries.originalHtml: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

entries.text: None will eat it except the sinners.
entries.originalHtml: None will eat it except the sinners.

entries.text: So I swear by what you see
entries.originalHtml: So I swear by what you see

entries.text: And what you do not see
entries.originalHtml: And what you do not see

entries.text: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
entries.originalHtml: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

entries.text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
entries.originalHtml: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

entries.text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
entries.originalHtml: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

entries.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

entries.text: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
entries.originalHtml: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

entries.text: We would have seized him by the right hand;
entries.originalHtml: We would have seized him by the right hand;<sup foot_note=197606>1</sup>

entries.text: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
entries.originalHtml: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.<sup foot_note=197607>1</sup>

entries.text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
entries.originalHtml: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

entries.text: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

entries.text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

entries.text: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

entries.text: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

entries.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
entries.originalHtml: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
entries.originalHtml: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen<sup foot_note=197608>1</sup>

entries.text: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
entries.originalHtml: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

entries.text: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.
entries.originalHtml: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

entries.text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
entries.originalHtml: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

entries.text: So be patient with gracious patience.
entries.originalHtml: So be patient with gracious patience.

entries.text: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

entries.text: But We see it [as] near.
entries.originalHtml: But We see it [as] near.

entries.text: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
entries.originalHtml: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,<sup foot_note=197609>1</sup>

entries.text: And the mountains will be like wool,
entries.originalHtml: And the mountains will be like wool,<sup foot_note=197610>1</sup>

entries.text: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
entries.originalHtml: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

entries.text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
entries.originalHtml: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

entries.text: And his wife and his brother
entries.originalHtml: And his wife and his brother

entries.text: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.
entries.originalHtml: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.

entries.text: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
entries.originalHtml: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

entries.text: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
entries.originalHtml: No!<sup foot_note=197611>1</sup> Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

entries.text: A remover of exteriors.
entries.originalHtml: A remover of exteriors.<sup foot_note=197612>1</sup>

entries.text: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
entries.originalHtml: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

entries.text: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
entries.originalHtml: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

entries.text: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

entries.text: When evil touches him, impatient,
entries.originalHtml: When evil touches him, impatient,

entries.text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
entries.originalHtml: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

entries.text: Except the observers of prayer -
entries.originalHtml: Except the observers of prayer -

entries.text: Those who are constant in their prayer
entries.originalHtml: Those who are constant in their prayer

entries.text: And those within whose wealth is a known right
entries.originalHtml: And those within whose wealth is a known right<sup foot_note=197613>1</sup>

entries.text: For the petitioner and the deprived -
entries.originalHtml: For the petitioner and the deprived -

entries.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
entries.originalHtml: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

entries.text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
entries.originalHtml: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

entries.text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

entries.text: And those who guard their private parts
entries.originalHtml: And those who guard their private parts

entries.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
entries.originalHtml: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,<sup foot_note=197614>1</sup> for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

entries.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
entries.originalHtml: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

entries.text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.
entries.originalHtml: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.

entries.text: And those who are in their testimonies upright
entries.originalHtml: And those who are in their testimonies upright

entries.text: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
entries.originalHtml: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

entries.text: They will be in gardens, honored.
entries.originalHtml: They will be in gardens,<sup foot_note=197615>1</sup> honored.

entries.text: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],
entries.originalHtml: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

entries.text: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
entries.originalHtml: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?<sup foot_note=197616>1</sup>

entries.text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
entries.originalHtml: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

entries.text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
entries.originalHtml: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.<sup foot_note=197617>1</sup>

entries.text: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
entries.originalHtml: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings<sup foot_note=197618>1</sup> that indeed We are able

entries.text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
entries.originalHtml: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

entries.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
entries.originalHtml: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

entries.text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
entries.originalHtml: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.<sup foot_note=197619>1</sup>

entries.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
entries.originalHtml: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

entries.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
entries.originalHtml: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

entries.text: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
entries.originalHtml: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

entries.text: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
entries.originalHtml: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

entries.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
entries.originalHtml: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

entries.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
entries.originalHtml: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

entries.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
entries.originalHtml: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments,<sup foot_note=197620>1</sup> persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

entries.text: Then I invited them publicly.
entries.originalHtml: Then I invited them publicly.

entries.text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
entries.originalHtml: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

entries.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
entries.originalHtml: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

entries.text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
entries.originalHtml: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

entries.text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
entries.originalHtml: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

entries.text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
entries.originalHtml: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

entries.text: While He has created you in stages?
entries.originalHtml: While He has created you in stages?<sup foot_note=197621>1</sup>

entries.text: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers
entries.originalHtml: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers<sup foot_note=197622>1</sup>

entries.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
entries.originalHtml: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

entries.text: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

entries.text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
entries.originalHtml: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

entries.text: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
entries.originalHtml: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

entries.text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
entries.originalHtml: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

entries.text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
entries.originalHtml: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

entries.text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
entries.originalHtml: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

entries.text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'
entries.originalHtml: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'<sup foot_note=197623>1</sup>

entries.text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
entries.originalHtml: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

entries.text: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
entries.originalHtml: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

entries.text: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
entries.originalHtml: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

entries.text: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

entries.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
entries.originalHtml: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

entries.text: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
entries.originalHtml: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

entries.text: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
entries.originalHtml: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

entries.text: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
entries.originalHtml: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees]<sup foot_note=197624>1</sup> has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.

entries.text: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
entries.originalHtml: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

entries.text: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
entries.originalHtml: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].

entries.text: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
entries.originalHtml: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].

entries.text: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
entries.originalHtml: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

entries.text: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
entries.originalHtml: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing,<sup foot_note=197625>1</sup> but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

entries.text: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
entries.originalHtml: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

entries.text: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
entries.originalHtml: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.<sup foot_note=197626>1</sup>

entries.text: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
entries.originalHtml: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

entries.text: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
entries.originalHtml: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.<sup foot_note=197627>1</sup>

entries.text: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
entries.originalHtml: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust.<sup foot_note=197628>1</sup> And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

entries.text: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
entries.originalHtml: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

entries.text: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
entries.originalHtml: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].

entries.text: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
entries.originalHtml: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord<sup foot_note=197629>1</sup> He will put into arduous punishment.

entries.text: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
entries.originalHtml: And [He revealed] that the masjids<sup foot_note=197631>1</sup> are for Allāh, so do not invoke<sup foot_note=197630>2</sup> with Allāh anyone.

entries.text: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
entries.originalHtml: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."<sup foot_note=197632>1</sup>

entries.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
entries.originalHtml: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

entries.text: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

entries.text: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
entries.originalHtml: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

entries.text: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
entries.originalHtml: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

entries.text: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
entries.originalHtml: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

entries.text: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
entries.originalHtml: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

entries.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
entries.originalHtml: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

entries.text: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
entries.originalHtml: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers<sup foot_note=197633>1</sup>

entries.text: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
entries.originalHtml: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know<sup foot_note=197634>1</sup> that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

reviewNote: Imported text with explicit database verse keys. Not specialist reviewed. Missing verse anchors are not inferred. Translation footnote markers omitted from plain text; original HTML preserved.

entries.text: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
entries.originalHtml: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]<sup foot_note=197635>1</sup>

entries.text: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
entries.originalHtml: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

entries.text: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
entries.originalHtml: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

entries.text: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
entries.originalHtml: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.

entries.text: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.<sup foot_note=197636>1</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue]<sup foot_note=197638>1</sup> and more suitable for words.<sup foot_note=197637>2</sup>

entries.text: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

entries.text: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
entries.originalHtml: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

entries.text: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
entries.originalHtml: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.<sup foot_note=197639>1</sup>

entries.text: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
entries.originalHtml: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

entries.text: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
entries.originalHtml: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

entries.text: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.

entries.text: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
entries.originalHtml: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

entries.text: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
entries.originalHtml: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

entries.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

entries.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
entries.originalHtml: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

entries.text: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
entries.originalHtml: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?<sup foot_note=197640>1</sup>

entries.text: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
entries.originalHtml: The heaven will break apart therefrom;<sup foot_note=197641>1</sup> ever is His promise fulfilled.

entries.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

entries.text: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it<sup foot_note=197643>1</sup> and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.<sup foot_note=197642>2</sup> And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

entries.text: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
entries.originalHtml: O you who covers himself [with a garment],<sup foot_note=197644>1</sup>

entries.text: Arise and warn.
entries.originalHtml: Arise and warn.

entries.text: And your Lord glorify.
entries.originalHtml: And your Lord glorify.

entries.text: And your clothing purify.
entries.originalHtml: And your clothing purify.

entries.text: And uncleanliness avoid.
entries.originalHtml: And uncleanliness<sup foot_note=197645>1</sup> avoid.

entries.text: And do not confer favor to acquire more.
entries.originalHtml: And do not confer favor to acquire more<sup foot_note=197646>1</sup>.

entries.text: But for your Lord be patient.
entries.originalHtml: But for your Lord be patient.

entries.text: And when the trumpet is blown,
entries.originalHtml: And when the trumpet is blown,

entries.text: That Day will be a difficult day
entries.originalHtml: That Day will be a difficult day

entries.text: For the disbelievers - not easy.
entries.originalHtml: For the disbelievers - not easy.

entries.text: Leave Me with the one I created alone
entries.originalHtml: Leave Me with the one I created alone<sup foot_note=197647>1</sup>

entries.text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
entries.originalHtml: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

entries.text: And children present [with him]
entries.originalHtml: And children present [with him]

entries.text: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
entries.originalHtml: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

entries.text: Then he desires that I should add more.
entries.originalHtml: Then he desires that I should add more.

entries.text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
entries.originalHtml: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

entries.text: I will cover him with arduous torment.
entries.originalHtml: I will cover him with arduous torment.

entries.text: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.<sup foot_note=197648>1</sup>

entries.text: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
entries.originalHtml: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

entries.text: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
entries.originalHtml: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

entries.text: Then he considered [again];
entries.originalHtml: Then he considered [again];

entries.text: Then he frowned and scowled;
entries.originalHtml: Then he frowned and scowled;

entries.text: Then he turned back and was arrogant
entries.originalHtml: Then he turned back and was arrogant

entries.text: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
entries.originalHtml: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

entries.text: This is not but the word of a human being."
entries.originalHtml: This is not but the word of a human being."

entries.text: I will drive him into Saqar.
entries.originalHtml: I will drive him into Saqar.<sup foot_note=197649>1</sup>

entries.text: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
entries.originalHtml: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

entries.text: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
entries.originalHtml: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

entries.text: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
entries.originalHtml: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.

entries.text: Over it are nineteen [angels].
entries.originalHtml: Over it are nineteen [angels].

entries.text: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
entries.originalHtml: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

entries.text: No! By the moon.
entries.originalHtml: No! By the moon.

entries.text: And [by] the night when it departs.
entries.originalHtml: And [by] the night when it departs.

entries.text: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
entries.originalHtml: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

entries.text: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].
entries.originalHtml: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].

entries.text: As a warning to humanity -
entries.originalHtml: As a warning to humanity -

entries.text: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
entries.originalHtml: To whoever wills among you to proceed<sup foot_note=197650>1</sup> or stay behind.

entries.text: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.
entries.originalHtml: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained<sup foot_note=197651>1</sup>.

entries.text: Except the companions of the right,.
entries.originalHtml: Except the companions of the right,<sup foot_note=197652>1</sup>.

entries.text: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
entries.originalHtml: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

entries.text: About the criminals,
entries.originalHtml: About the criminals,

entries.text: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
entries.originalHtml: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

entries.text: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
entries.originalHtml: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

entries.text: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
entries.originalHtml: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

entries.text: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
entries.originalHtml: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

entries.text: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
entries.originalHtml: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

entries.text: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."
entries.originalHtml: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

entries.text: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
entries.originalHtml: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

entries.text: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.
entries.originalHtml: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.

entries.text: As if they were alarmed donkeys.
entries.originalHtml: As if they were alarmed donkeys.

entries.text: Fleeing from a lion?
entries.originalHtml: Fleeing from a lion?

entries.text: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
entries.originalHtml: Rather, every person among them desires that he<sup foot_note=197654>1</sup> would be given scriptures spread about.<sup foot_note=197653>2</sup>

entries.text: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
entries.originalHtml: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

entries.text: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.
entries.originalHtml: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.

entries.text: Then whoever wills will remember it.
entries.originalHtml: Then whoever wills will remember it.

entries.text: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
entries.originalHtml: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
